if not game:IsLoaded() then
    local deadline = os.clock() + 30
    repeat task.wait(0.1) until game:IsLoaded() or os.clock() >= deadline
end
task.wait()
    local loadinggate = {
        Enabled = true,
        MaxWait = 90,        
        ClearConfirmTime = 0.35, 
    }

    if loadinggate.Enabled then
        local players  = game:GetService("Players")
        local lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
        local lp = players.LocalPlayer

        while not lp do
            players:GetPropertyChangedSignal("LocalPlayer"):Wait()
            lp = players.LocalPlayer
        end

        local playergui  = lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 30)
        local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

        local function shown(o)
            if not o then return false end
            if o:IsA("GuiObject") then return o.Visible end
            return o.Enabled ~= false
        end

        local function hasgameloadingscreen()
            return shown(playergui and playergui:FindFirstChild("LoadingScreen", true))
                or shown(lighting:FindFirstChild("LoadingScreen"))
        end

        if not rs:FindFirstChild("Modules") then rs:WaitForChild("Modules", 30) end

        local starttime = os.clock()
        local sawloading = false
        local clearstarted = nil

        while os.clock() - starttime < loadinggate.MaxWait do
            local loadingvisible = hasgameloadingscreen()

            if loadingvisible then
                sawloading = true
                clearstarted = nil
            else
                if not sawloading then
                    break 
                end

                if not clearstarted then
                    clearstarted = os.clock()
                end

                if os.clock() - clearstarted >= loadinggate.ClearConfirmTime then
                    break 
                end
            end

            task.wait(0.1)
        end
    end

if getgenv().KiciaRebuild and getgenv().KiciaRebuild.Unload then
    pcall(getgenv().KiciaRebuild.Unload)
end
if not game:IsLoaded() then
    local deadline = os.clock() + 30
    repeat task.wait(0.1) until game:IsLoaded() or os.clock() >= deadline
end

local Signal = {}
Signal.__index = Signal
function Signal.new() return setmetatable({ _handlers = {} }, Signal) end
function Signal:Connect(fn)
    local h = { fn = fn, connected = true }
    table.insert(self._handlers, h)
    local sig = self
    return {
        Connected = true,
        Disconnect = function(c)
            if not h.connected then return end
            h.connected = false
            c.Connected = false
            local i = table.find(sig._handlers, h)
            if i then table.remove(sig._handlers, i) end
        end,
    }
end
function Signal:Once(fn)
    local c
    c = self:Connect(function(...) c:Disconnect(); fn(...) end)
    return c
end
function Signal:Fire(...)
    local list = table.clone(self._handlers)
    for _, h in ipairs(list) do
        if h.connected then task.spawn(h.fn, ...) end
    end
end
function Signal:FireSync(...)
    for _, h in ipairs(table.clone(self._handlers)) do
        if h.connected then h.fn(...) end
    end
end
function Signal:Destroy() table.clear(self._handlers) end
K.Signal = Signal

local Trove = {}
Trove.__index = Trove
function Trove.new(name) return setmetatable({ _name = name, _items = {} }, Trove) end
local function cleanItem(o)
    local t = typeof(o)
    if t == "RBXScriptConnection" then o:Disconnect()
    elseif t == "Instance" then pcall(function() o:Destroy() end)
    elseif t == "thread" then pcall(task.cancel, o)
    elseif type(o) == "function" then pcall(o)
    elseif type(o) == "table" then
        local function member(k)
            local ok, v = pcall(function() return o[k] end)
            return ok and type(v) == "function" and v or nil
        end
        local cancel, getStatus = member("cancel"), member("getStatus")
        if cancel and getStatus then pcall(cancel, o); return end
        local destroy = member("Destroy")
        if destroy then pcall(destroy, o); return end
        local disconnect = member("Disconnect")
        if disconnect then pcall(disconnect, o) end
    end
end
function Trove:Add(o) table.insert(self._items, o); return o end
function Trove:Connect(sig, fn) return self:Add(sig:Connect(fn)) end
function Trove:Extend() return self:Add(Trove.new(self._name)) end
function Trove:Remove(o, keep)
    local i = table.find(self._items, o)
    if i then
        table.remove(self._items, i)
        if not keep then cleanItem(o) end
    end
end
function Trove:AddPromise(promise)
    if tostring(promise:getStatus()) == "Started" then
        self:Add(promise)
        promise:finally(function()
            if not self._cleaning then self:Remove(promise, true) end
        end)
    end
    return promise
end
function Trove:AttachExtend(instance)
    local sub = self:Extend()
    sub:Connect(instance.Destroying, function() self:Remove(sub) end)
    return sub
end
function Trove:Clean()
    local items = self._items
    self._items = {}
    self._cleaning = true
    for i = #items, 1, -1 do cleanItem(items[i]) end
    self._cleaning = false
end
Trove.Destroy = Trove.Clean
K.Trove = Trove

do
    local UIS = UserInputService
    local _GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
    local function camera() return workspace.CurrentCamera end
    local W = {}
    function W.appendPath(path, key)
        local p = table.clone(path)
        table.insert(p, key)
        return p
    end
    function W.currentViewportSize()
        local c = camera()
        return c and c.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
    end
    function W.connectCurrentCameraViewport(trove, cb)
        local inner = trove:Extend()
        local function bind()
            inner:Clean()
            local c = camera()
            if c == nil then return end
            inner:Connect(c:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"), function() cb(c.ViewportSize) end)
            cb(c.ViewportSize)
        end
        trove:Connect(workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"), bind)
        bind()
    end
    function W.absoluteToLayerOffset(layer, pos)
        return pos - layer.AbsolutePosition
    end
    function W.clampOffsetToViewport(x, y, size)
        local vp = W.currentViewportSize()
        return math.clamp(x, 0, math.max(0, vp.X - size.X)), math.clamp(y, 0, math.max(0, vp.Y - size.Y))
    end
    function W.clampGuiToViewport(gui)
        local vp = W.currentViewportSize()
        local ap, as = gui.AbsolutePosition, gui.AbsoluteSize
        local dx = math.clamp(ap.X, 0, math.max(0, vp.X - as.X)) - ap.X
        local dy = math.clamp(ap.Y, 0, math.max(0, vp.Y - as.Y)) - ap.Y
        if dx ~= 0 or dy ~= 0 then
            local p = gui.Position
            gui.Position = UDim2.new(p.X.Scale, p.X.Offset + dx, p.Y.Scale, p.Y.Offset + dy)
        end
    end
    function W.snapPosition(u)
        return UDim2.new(u.X.Scale, math.round(u.X.Offset), u.Y.Scale, math.round(u.Y.Offset))
    end
    function W.onScreenKeyboardTop()
        local ok, visible = pcall(function() return UIS.OnScreenKeyboardVisible end)
        if not ok or not visible then return nil end
        local ok2, pos = pcall(function() return UIS.OnScreenKeyboardPosition end)
        return ok2 and pos and pos.Y or nil
    end
    function W.connectOnScreenKeyboard(trove, cb)
        pcall(function() trove:Connect(UIS:GetPropertyChangedSignal("OnScreenKeyboardVisible"), cb) end)
        pcall(function() trove:Connect(UIS:GetPropertyChangedSignal("OnScreenKeyboardPosition"), cb) end)
    end
    function W.getPointerPosition()
        return UIS:GetMouseLocation()
    end
    function W.matchesPointerDrag(input, started, movement)
        if started ~= nil and started.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return input == started end
        return input.UserInputType == movement
    end
    function W.round(v, step)
        if step == nil or step == 0 then return v end
        return math.round(v / step) * step
    end
    W.KeyNames = {
        [Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1] = "MB1", [Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2] = "MB2",
        [Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3] = "MB3", [Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift] = "LShift",
        [Enum.KeyCode.RightShift] = "RShift", [Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl] = "LCtrl",
        [Enum.KeyCode.RightControl] = "RCtrl", [Enum.KeyCode.LeftAlt] = "LAlt", [Enum.KeyCode.RightAlt] = "RAlt",
    }
    function W.serializeKey(key)
        if typeof(key) ~= "EnumItem" then return nil end
        return tostring(key.EnumType) .. "." .. key.Name
    end
    function W.deserializeKey(s)
        if type(s) ~= "string" then return nil end
        local kind, name = s:match("^(%w+)%.(%w+)$")
        if kind == nil then return nil end
        local ok, v = pcall(function() return Enum[kind][name] end)
        return ok and v or nil
    end
    function W.findScrollingAncestor(inst)
        local p = inst and inst.Parent
        while p ~= nil do
            if p:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then return p end
            p = p.Parent
        end
        return nil
    end
    function W.isEffectivelyVisible(gui)
        local p = gui
        while p ~= nil and p ~= game do
            if p:IsA("GuiObject") and not p.Visible then return false end
            if p:IsA("LayerCollector") then return p.Enabled end
            p = p.Parent
        end
        return false
    end
    function W.ensureStorageDirectories(dir)
        local isf, mkf = K.fn("isfolder"), K.fn("makefolder")
        if not (isf and mkf) or type(dir) ~= "string" then return end
        local function make(path)
            local acc
            for part in path:gmatch("[^/]+") do
                acc = acc and (acc .. "/" .. part) or part
                pcall(function() if not isf(acc) then mkf(acc) end end)
            end
        end
        make(dir)
        make(dir .. "/configs")
    end
    tbl17.w = function() return W end
end

do
    local P = {}
    function P.bind(trove, config, control, path, opts)
        local debounce = opts ~= nil and opts.Debounce == true
        local writeBack = opts ~= nil and opts.WriteBack or nil
        control:Set(config:Get(path), true)
        trove:Connect(config:Changed(path), function(v) control:Set(v, true) end)
        local pending, scheduled = nil, false
        local function write(v)
            if writeBack then writeBack(v) else config:Set(path, v) end
        end
        trove:Connect(control.Changed, function(v)
            if not debounce then write(v); return end
            pending = v
            if scheduled then return end
            scheduled = true
            task.delay(0.05, function()
                scheduled = false
                write(pending)
            end)
        end)
    end
    tbl17.P = function() return P end
end

do
    local Spring = {}
    local function posVel(self, now)
        local p0, v0, p1, d, s = self._p0, self._v0, self._target, self._damper, self._speed
        local t = s * (now - self._t0)
        local d2 = d * d
        local h, si, co
        if d2 < 1 then
            h = math.sqrt(1 - d2)
            local ep = math.exp(-d * t) / h
            co, si = ep * math.cos(h * t), ep * math.sin(h * t)
        elseif d2 == 1 then
            h = 1
            local ep = math.exp(-d * t) / h
            co, si = ep, ep * t
        else
            h = math.sqrt(d2 - 1)
            local u, v = math.exp((-d + h) * t) / (2 * h), math.exp((-d - h) * t) / (2 * h)
            co, si = u + v, u - v
        end
        local a0, a1 = h * co + d * si, 1 - (h * co + d * si)
        local a2 = si / s
        local b0, b1, b2 = -s * si, s * si, h * co - d * si
        return a0 * p0 + a1 * p1 + a2 * v0, b0 * p0 + b1 * p1 + b2 * v0
    end
    function Spring.new(initial, clock)
        initial = initial or 0
        clock = clock or os.clock
        return setmetatable({ _clock = clock, _t0 = clock(), _p0 = initial, _v0 = 0 * initial, _target = initial,
            _damper = 1, _speed = 1 }, Spring)
    end
    function Spring:Impulse(v) self.Velocity = self.Velocity + v end
    function Spring:SetTarget(value, doNotAnimate)
        if doNotAnimate then
            self._p0, self._v0, self._target, self._t0 = value, 0 * value, value, self._clock()
        else
            self.Target = value
        end
    end
    function Spring:TimeSkip(delta)
        local now = self._clock()
        local p, v = posVel(self, now + delta)
        self._p0, self._v0, self._t0 = p, v, now
    end
    Spring.__index = function(self, k)
        if Spring[k] then return Spring[k] end
        if k == "Value" or k == "Position" or k == "p" then local p = posVel(self, self._clock()); return p
        elseif k == "Velocity" or k == "v" then local _, v = posVel(self, self._clock()); return v
        elseif k == "Target" or k == "t" then return self._target
        elseif k == "Damper" or k == "d" then return self._damper
        elseif k == "Speed" or k == "s" then return self._speed
        elseif k == "Clock" then return self._clock end
        return nil
    end
    Spring.__newindex = function(self, k, v)
        local now = self._clock()
        if k == "Value" or k == "Position" or k == "p" then
            local _, vel = posVel(self, now)
            self._p0, self._v0 = v, vel
        elseif k == "Velocity" or k == "v" then
            local pos = posVel(self, now)
            self._p0, self._v0 = pos, v
        elseif k == "Target" or k == "t" then
            local pos, vel = posVel(self, now)
            self._p0, self._v0, self._target = pos, vel, v
        elseif k == "Damper" or k == "d" then
            local pos, vel = posVel(self, now)
            self._p0, self._v0, self._damper = pos, vel, v
        elseif k == "Speed" or k == "s" then
            local pos, vel = posVel(self, now)
            self._p0, self._v0, self._speed = pos, vel, v < 0 and 0 or v
        elseif k == "Clock" then
            local pos, vel = posVel(self, now)
            self._clock, self._t0, self._p0, self._v0 = v, v(), pos, vel
            return
        else
            rawset(self, k, v)
            return
        end
        self._t0 = now
    end

local GlobalTrove = tbl17.n()

do
    local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
    local map = {}
    for i = 1, 64 do map[alphabet:byte(i)] = i - 1 end
    local function decode(s)
        local out = buffer.create(#s * 3 // 4 + 3)
        local n = 0
        for i = 1, #s, 4 do
            local a, b, c, d = s:byte(i, i + 3)
            local vc, vd = map[c], map[d]
            local v = map[a] * 262144 + map[b] * 4096 + (vc or 0) * 64 + (vd or 0)
            buffer.writeu8(out, n, bit32.rshift(v, 16))
            n += 1
            if vc then buffer.writeu8(out, n, bit32.band(bit32.rshift(v, 8), 255)); n += 1 end
            if vd then buffer.writeu8(out, n, bit32.band(v, 255)); n += 1 end
        end
        return buffer.readstring(out, 0, n)
    end
    local wrf, gca = K.fn("writefile"), K.fn("getcustomasset") or K.fn("getsynasset")
    if wrf and gca then
        local path = "shako.win Premium/logo.png"
        local _ok = pcall(wrf, path, decode(LITHIUM_LOGO_B64))
        local _ok2, _id = pcall(gca, path)
    end
end

local boot = (function()
    local store = tbl17.bG()
    local profiles = GlobalTrove:Add(tbl17.bN().new(store))
    store:UseMiddleware(profiles)
    local fonts = tbl17.az()
    GlobalTrove:Add(tbl17.aB().use(store, { "Notifications" }, { "Theme" }, function(f) return fonts:Get(f) end,
        tbl17.bI().Notifications))

    local reporter = GlobalTrove:Add(tbl17.ad().new())
    local state = GlobalTrove:Add(tbl17.ae().new("shako.win Premium"))
    local stateData = state:Load()
    if stateData.AutoLoad and stateData.AutoLoadConfigName ~= nil then
        local r = reporter:ReportResult(store:LoadFromFile(stateData.AutoLoadConfigName))
        if not r.Ok then
            local text = "Failed to auto-load the selected config"
            if string.find(r.Error.Detail, "newer than current version", 1, true) ~= nil then
                text = "Your selected config was saved by a newer version - update or pick another config"
            end
            tbl17.aB().get():Notify(text)
        elseif #tbl17.bc().takeDroppedPaths() > 0 then
            tbl17.aB().get():Notify("Some saved settings could not be restored and were reset to defaults")
        end
    end

    local Theme = tbl17.A()
    local theme = store.Data.Theme
    if theme ~= nil then
        for k, v in next, theme do
            if Theme.Tokens[k] ~= nil and typeof(v) == "Color3" then Theme.refresh(k, v) end
        end
    end

    local registry = GlobalTrove:Add(tbl17.bK().new())
    local identities = GlobalTrove:Add(tbl17.bL().new(registry))
    local tags = GlobalTrove:Add(tbl17.bM().new(registry))
    GlobalTrove:Add(tbl17.bR().new(tags, registry))
    GlobalTrove:Add(tbl17.bZ().new(identities))
    local avatar = GlobalTrove:Add(tbl17.b6().new(registry))

    return {
        StoreProfiles = profiles,
        PlayerRegistry = registry,
        PlayerIdentities = identities,
        PlayerTags = tags,
        DecoratorFactory = avatar ~= nil and avatar:GetDecoratorFactory() or nil,
        ArmAvatarSpoofer = function() avatar:Arm() end,
        GeneralState = state,
        GeneralStateData = stateData,
    }
end)()

function K.Unload()
    if K.destroyed then return end
    K.destroyed = true
    for _, f in ipairs(K.cleanups) do pcall(f) end
    pcall(function() GlobalTrove:Destroy() end)

    -- Destruir Target Hub, Counter HUD y cualquier GUI residual de Shako
    local function shouldDestroy(inst)
        if not inst then return false end
        local n = tostring(inst.Name or "")
        if n == "ShakoTargetHub" or n == "ShakoCounterHUD" or n == "ShakoWaifuSHK" then return true end
        if n:find("Shako", 1, true) == 1 then return true end
        if n:find("KiciaRebuild", 1, true) then return true end
        return false
    end
    local function nuke(parent)
        if not parent then return end
        for _, ch in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
            if shouldDestroy(ch) then
                pcall(function() ch:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
        -- por si quedaron anidados
        for _, d in ipairs(parent:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("ScreenGui") and shouldDestroy(d) then
                pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
    end
    pcall(function()
        local core = game:GetService("CoreGui")
        nuke(core)
    end)
    pcall(function()
        if gethui then nuke(gethui()) end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        local lp = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
        if lp then nuke(lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")) end
    end)
    -- desconectar connections trackeadas
    for _, c in ipairs(K.connections or {}) do
        pcall(function() if c and c.Disconnect then c:Disconnect() end end)
    end
    K.connections = {}

    if getgenv().KiciaRebuild == K then getgenv().KiciaRebuild = nil end
end

-- Underground + Fake Position (from shako), Ragebot > Evasion
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
	local ugSpinAngle = 0
	local lastNc = 0
	local lastFpNc = 0
	local ghost = nil
	local FakePosState = { original = nil, basePos = nil, prevAutoRotate = nil, prevPlatformStand = nil }

	local function cleanupGhost()
		if ghost then
			pcall(function() ghost:Destroy() end)
			ghost = nil
		end
	end

	local function getEvasion()
		local ok, data = pcall(function() return tbl17.bG().Data end)
		if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return nil end
		local rb = data.Ragebot
		return rb and rb.Evasion
	end

	local function stopFakePosition()
		local char = LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then
			pcall(function()
				hum.AutoRotate = FakePosState.prevAutoRotate ~= false
				hum.PlatformStand = FakePosState.prevPlatformStand == true
				hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
			end)
		end
		local evasion = getEvasion()
		local ugOn = evasion and evasion.Underground and evasion.Underground.Enabled
		if char and not ugOn then
			pcall(function()
				for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
					if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
						p.CanCollide = true
					end
				end
			end)
		end
		if hrp and FakePosState.original then
			hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			hrp.CFrame = FakePosState.original
		end
		FakePosState.original = nil
		FakePosState.basePos = nil
	end

	local wasFp = false
	local function applyFakePosition(fp)
		local char = LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not hrp then return end
		if not FakePosState.original then
			FakePosState.original = hrp.CFrame
			FakePosState.basePos = hrp.Position
			if hum then
				FakePosState.prevAutoRotate = hum.AutoRotate
				FakePosState.prevPlatformStand = hum.PlatformStand
			end
		end
		if not FakePosState.basePos then
			FakePosState.basePos = FakePosState.original.Position
		end
		if hum then
			pcall(function()
				hum.AutoRotate = false
				hum.PlatformStand = true
				hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
			end)
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - lastFpNc > 0.25 then
			lastFpNc = now
			for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
				if p:IsA("BasePart") then
					p.CanCollide = false
				end
			end
		end
		local surface = FakePosState.basePos
		if fp.WalkRestore and hum then
			local moveDir = hum.MoveDirection
			if moveDir.Magnitude > 0.05 then
				local speed = (hum.WalkSpeed > 0 and hum.WalkSpeed) or 16
				surface = surface + moveDir * speed * (1 / 60)
				FakePosState.basePos = surface
			end
		end
		if fp.Panic then
			local minX = tonumber(fp.PanicXMin) or -8
			local maxX = tonumber(fp.PanicXMax) or 8
			if maxX < minX then minX, maxX = maxX, minX end
			surface = Vector3.new(
				FakePosState.basePos.X + (minX + math.random() * (maxX - minX)),
				surface.Y,
				FakePosState.basePos.Z
			)
		end
		local depth = tonumber(fp.Depth) or 5.8
		local underPos = Vector3.new(surface.X, surface.Y - depth, surface.Z)
		local pitch = math.rad(tonumber(fp.Pitch) or 90)
		local yawOff = math.rad(tonumber(fp.Yaw) or 0)
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local look = cam and cam.CFrame.LookVector or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
		local yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z) + yawOff
		hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(underPos) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(pitch, 0, 0)
		pcall(function()
			local lower = char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")
			local root = lower and lower:FindFirstChild("Root")
			if root and root:IsA("Motor6D") then
				root.Transform = CFrame.new()
			end
		end)
	end

	local function applyUnderground(ug)
		local char = LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not hrp then return end
		local depth = tonumber(ug.Depth) or 3.5
		local pitchDeg = tonumber(ug.Pitch) or 90
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - lastNc > 0.35 then
			lastNc = now
			for _, p in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
				if p:IsA("BasePart") then
					p.CanCollide = false
				end
			end
		end
		local origin = Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X, hrp.Position.Y + 250, hrp.Position.Z)
		local rp = RaycastParams.new()
		rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, Vector3.new(0, -800, 0), rp)
		local groundY = hit and hit.Position.Y or hrp.Position.Y
		local underPos = Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X, groundY - depth, hrp.Position.Z)
		local pitch = math.rad(pitchDeg)
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local look = cam and cam.CFrame.LookVector or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
		local yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
		-- Spin bajo tierra
		if ug.Spin then
			local spd = tonumber(ug.SpinSpeed) or 360
			ugSpinAngle = (ugSpinAngle or 0) + math.rad(spd) * (1/60)
			if ugSpinAngle > math.pi * 2 then ugSpinAngle = ugSpinAngle - math.pi * 2 end
			yaw = ugSpinAngle
		else
			ugSpinAngle = yaw
		end
		hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(underPos) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(pitch, 0, 0)
		hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, 0, hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z)
		hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		if ug.Visualise then
			pcall(function()
				if not ghost or not ghost.Parent then
					ghost = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
					ghost.Name = "_KiciaUGGhost"
					ghost.Size = Vector3.new(2, 5, 1)
					ghost.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255)
					ghost.Transparency = 0.4
					ghost.AlwaysOnTop = true
					ghost.ZIndex = 8
					ghost.Adornee = workspace.Terrain
					ghost.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui")
				end
				ghost.CFrame = CFrame.new(underPos)
			end)
		else
			cleanupGhost()
		end
	end

	K.onUnload(function()
		cleanupGhost()
		stopFakePosition()
	end)

	local lastUe = 0
	local conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if K.destroyed then return end
		local evasion = getEvasion()
		if not evasion then return end
		local mode = evasion.Mode
		local fp = evasion.FakePosition or {}
		local ug = evasion.Underground or {}
		local ue = evasion.UECounter or {}
		local fpOn = mode == "FakePosition"
		-- Underground: SOLO toggle + keybind (Always/Toggle/Hold). NO por Evasion Mode.
		local ugOn = false
		if ug.Enabled == true then
			local kb = ug.Keybind
			if type(kb) == "table" then
				ugOn = kb.State == true
			else
				ugOn = false
			end
		end
		if not ugOn then
			-- force stop residual
		end
		local ueOn = false
		if type(ue) == "table" then
			local kb = ue.Keybind
			if type(kb) == "table" then
				if kb.Kind == "Always" then ueOn = true
				elseif kb.State == true then ueOn = true end
			elseif ue.Enabled == true then
				ueOn = true
			end
		end
		if mode == "UECounter" then ueOn = true end
		if fpOn then
			wasFp = true
			applyFakePosition(fp)
		elseif wasFp then
			wasFp = false
			stopFakePosition()
		end
		if ugOn and not fpOn and not ueOn and not getgenv()._ShakoTranslocateNM then
			applyUnderground(ug)
		elseif not ugOn then
			cleanupGhost()
		end
		-- UE Counter handled by dedicated Hyper/Normal fly module (evita double apply)
		if ueOn and not fpOn then
			-- no-op aquí
		end
	end)
	K.track(conn)
end


-- Void Spam (Lua x paid), Ragebot > Activation
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
	local SCALE = 1e9
	local elapsed, voidPos, voidDriftDir, basePos, voidEvadeCD, intendedVoidPos =
		0, Vector3.new(0, 1e10, 0), Vector3.new(1, 0, 0), Vector3.new(0, 1e10, 0), 0, Vector3.new(0, 1e10, 0)

	local function getVS()
		local ok, data = pcall(function() return tbl17.bG().Data end)
		if not ok or not data or not data.Ragebot then return nil end
		return data.Ragebot.VoidSpam
	end

	local function computeDriftDir(t)
		local nx, ny, nz, amp, freq = 0, 0, 0, 1, 0.0001
		for _ = 1, 4 do
			nx = nx + math.noise(t * freq, 0, 0) * amp
			ny = ny + math.noise(0, t * freq, 0) * amp
			nz = nz + math.noise(0, 0, t * freq) * amp
			freq = freq * 2.37
			amp = amp * 0.5
		end
		local len = math.sqrt(nx * nx + ny * ny + nz * nz)
		if len < 0.001 then return Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
		return Vector3.new(nx / len, ny / len, nz / len)
	end

	local function stepVoid(cfg, dt)
		local speed = (tonumber(cfg.Speed) or 1) * SCALE
		local chaos = tonumber(cfg.Chaos) or 0.98
		local radius = (tonumber(cfg.Radius) or 200) * SCALE
		local m = cfg.Method or "Quantum"
		if m == "Drift" then
			local dir = computeDriftDir(elapsed)
			voidDriftDir = voidDriftDir:Lerp(dir, chaos * dt * 10)
			voidPos = voidPos + voidDriftDir * speed * dt
			if (voidPos - basePos).Magnitude > radius then
				voidPos = basePos + (voidPos - basePos).Unit * radius
				voidDriftDir = -voidDriftDir
			end
			return voidPos
		elseif m == "Chaos" then
			voidPos = voidPos + Vector3.new(
				(math.random() - 0.5) * speed * dt * 5,
				(math.random() - 0.5) * speed * dt * 5,
				(math.random() - 0.5) * speed * dt * 5
			)
			if (voidPos - basePos).Magnitude > radius then
				voidPos = basePos + (voidPos - basePos).Unit * radius
			end
			return voidPos
		elseif m == "Loop" then
			local r = math.min(radius * 0.8, 1e9 + (elapsed % 100) * 1e7)
			return basePos + Vector3.new(math.cos(elapsed * 2) * r, math.sin(elapsed * 1.3) * r * 0.2, math.sin(elapsed * 2) * r)
		elseif m == "Spiral" then
			local r = math.min(radius * 0.9, (elapsed % 50) * 2e9)
			return basePos + Vector3.new(math.cos(elapsed * 3) * r, math.sin(elapsed * 0.5) * r * 0.3, math.sin(elapsed * 3) * r)
		else -- Quantum
			local r = radius * (math.random() > 0.5 and 1 or -1)
			return basePos + Vector3.new(r, (math.random() - 0.5) * radius * 0.2, r)
				+ Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * radius, 0, (math.random() - 0.5) * radius)
		end
	end

	local function checkEvade(cfg)
		if not cfg.Evade or voidEvadeCD > 0 then return end
		local evadeR = (tonumber(cfg.EvadeRadius) or 8) * SCALE
		local evadeSpd = (tonumber(cfg.EvadeSpeed) or 6) * SCALE
		local trigger = tonumber(cfg.EvadeTrigger) or 1
		local strength = tonumber(cfg.EvadeStrength) or 1
		local radius = (tonumber(cfg.Radius) or 200) * SCALE
		local minDist, threatVec = math.huge, Vector3.new()
		for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
				local hrp = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local hum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
					local pred = hrp.Position + hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity * 0.5
					local d = (pred - intendedVoidPos).Magnitude
					if d < minDist then
						minDist = d
						threatVec = (pred - intendedVoidPos).Unit
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if minDist < evadeR * trigger then
			voidPos = voidPos - threatVec * evadeSpd * (1 + (1 - minDist / (evadeR * trigger)) * 2) * strength * 0.5
			if (voidPos - basePos).Magnitude > radius then
				voidPos = basePos + (voidPos - basePos).Unit * radius
			end
			voidEvadeCD = tonumber(cfg.EvadeCooldown) or 0.05
		end
	end

	local wasOn = false
	local visualCF, visualVel, visualRot = nil, nil, nil
	local DESYNC_NAME = "__kicia_void_desync"

	local function clearDesyncBind()
		pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(DESYNC_NAME) end)
	end

	-- Client-side CFrame reconstruction: server sees void, you stay where you were looking
	local function applyVoidDesync(hrp, goalCF)
		-- capture current visual pose BEFORE server write
		visualCF = hrp.CFrame
		visualVel = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		visualRot = hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity
		-- write void position (replicates / hitreg)
		hrp.CFrame = goalCF
		hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		if math.random(1, 10) == 1 then
			hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
				(math.random() - 0.5) * 2e7,
				(math.random() - 0.5) * 2e7,
				(math.random() - 0.5) * 2e7
			)
		end
		-- same-frame reconstruct so camera/body don't show the TP
		clearDesyncBind()
		RunService:BindToRenderStep(DESYNC_NAME, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value - 1, function()
			if hrp and hrp.Parent and visualCF then
				hrp.CFrame = visualCF
				hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = visualVel or Vector3.zero
				hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = visualRot or Vector3.zero
			end
			clearDesyncBind()
		end)
	end

	K.onUnload(clearDesyncBind)

	local conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		if K.destroyed then return end
		local cfg = getVS()
		local vsActive = false
		if type(cfg) == "table" and cfg.Enabled == true then
			local kb = cfg.Keybind
			if type(kb) == "table" then
				vsActive = kb.State == true
			else
				vsActive = true -- sin keybind legacy
			end
		end
		if not vsActive then
			if wasOn then
				wasOn = false
				clearDesyncBind()
			end
			return
		end
		local hrp = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not hrp then return end
		if not wasOn then
			wasOn = true
			local alt = (tonumber(cfg.BaseAltitude) or 10) * SCALE
			voidPos = Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X, alt, hrp.Position.Z)
			basePos = Vector3.new(0, alt, 0)
			intendedVoidPos = voidPos
			elapsed = 0
		end
		elapsed = elapsed + dt
		if voidEvadeCD > 0 then voidEvadeCD = voidEvadeCD - dt end
		checkEvade(cfg)
		intendedVoidPos = stepVoid(cfg, dt)
		-- capture local pose each tick, write void, reconstruct same frame (no visible TP)
		pcall(applyVoidDesync, hrp, CFrame.new(intendedVoidPos))
	end)
	K.track(conn)
end

-- Health Void Spam (win by HP): low health -> void with CFrame desync reconstruction
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
	local SCALE = 1e9
	local elapsed, voidPos, voidDriftDir, basePos =
		0, Vector3.new(0, 1e10, 0), Vector3.new(1, 0, 0), Vector3.new(0, 1e10, 0)
	local wasActive = false
	local visualCF, visualVel, visualRot = nil, nil, nil
	local DESYNC_NAME = "__kicia_health_void_desync"

	local function getHV()
		local ok, data = pcall(function() return tbl17.bG().Data end)
		if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" or not data.Ragebot then return nil, nil end
		local ev = data.Ragebot.Evasion
		if type(ev) ~= "table" then return nil, nil end
		return ev.HealthVoid, ev.Mode
	end

	local function clearDesync()
		pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(DESYNC_NAME) end)
	end

	local function applyDesync(hrp, goalCF)
		visualCF = hrp.CFrame
		visualVel = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		visualRot = hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity
		hrp.CFrame = goalCF
		hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		clearDesync()
		RunService:BindToRenderStep(DESYNC_NAME, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value - 1, function()
			if hrp and hrp.Parent and visualCF then
				hrp.CFrame = visualCF
				hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = visualVel or Vector3.zero
				hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = visualRot or Vector3.zero
			end
			clearDesync()
		end)
	end

	local function computeDriftDir(t)
		local nx, ny, nz, amp, freq = 0, 0, 0, 1, 0.0001
		for _ = 1, 4 do
			nx = nx + math.noise(t * freq, 0, 0) * amp
			ny = ny + math.noise(0, t * freq, 0) * amp
			nz = nz + math.noise(0, 0, t * freq) * amp
			freq = freq * 2.37
			amp = amp * 0.5
		end
		local len = math.sqrt(nx * nx + ny * ny + nz * nz)
		if len < 0.001 then return Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
		return Vector3.new(nx / len, ny / len, nz / len)
	end

	local function stepVoid(cfg, dt)
		local speed = (tonumber(cfg.Speed) or 1) * SCALE
		local chaos = tonumber(cfg.Chaos) or 0.9
		local radius = (tonumber(cfg.Radius) or 200) * SCALE
		local m = cfg.Method or "Quantum"
		if m == "Drift" then
			local dir = computeDriftDir(elapsed)
			voidDriftDir = voidDriftDir:Lerp(dir, chaos * dt * 10)
			voidPos = voidPos + voidDriftDir * speed * dt
			if (voidPos - basePos).Magnitude > radius then
				voidPos = basePos + (voidPos - basePos).Unit * radius
				voidDriftDir = -voidDriftDir
			end
			return voidPos
		elseif m == "Chaos" then
			voidPos = voidPos + Vector3.new(
				(math.random() - 0.5) * speed * dt * 5,
				(math.random() - 0.5) * speed * dt * 5,
				(math.random() - 0.5) * speed * dt * 5
			)
			if (voidPos - basePos).Magnitude > radius then
				voidPos = basePos + (voidPos - basePos).Unit * radius
			end
			return voidPos
		elseif m == "Loop" then
			local r = math.min(radius * 0.8, 1e9 + (elapsed % 100) * 1e7)
			return basePos + Vector3.new(math.cos(elapsed * 2) * r, math.sin(elapsed * 1.3) * r * 0.2, math.sin(elapsed * 2) * r)
		elseif m == "Spiral" then
			local r = math.min(radius * 0.9, (elapsed % 50) * 2e9)
			return basePos + Vector3.new(math.cos(elapsed * 3) * r, math.sin(elapsed * 0.5) * r * 0.3, math.sin(elapsed * 3) * r)
		else -- Quantum
			local r = radius * (math.random() > 0.5 and 1 or -1)
			return basePos + Vector3.new(r, (math.random() - 0.5) * radius * 0.2, r)
				+ Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * radius, 0, (math.random() - 0.5) * radius)
		end
	end

	K.onUnload(clearDesync)

	local conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		if K.destroyed then return end
		local cfg, mode = getHV()
		if mode ~= "HealthVoid" or type(cfg) ~= "table" then
			if wasActive then
				wasActive = false
				clearDesync()
			end
			return
		end
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not hum or not hrp or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
		local maxH = hum.MaxHealth > 0 and hum.MaxHealth or 100
		local pct = (hum.Health / maxH) * 100
		local thresh = tonumber(cfg.HPThreshold) or 50
		if pct > thresh then
			if wasActive then
				wasActive = false
				clearDesync()
			end
			return
		end
		-- low HP -> void
		if not wasActive then
			wasActive = true
			local alt = (tonumber(cfg.BaseAltitude) or 15) * SCALE
			voidPos = Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X, alt, hrp.Position.Z)
			basePos = Vector3.new(0, alt, 0)
			elapsed = 0
		end
		elapsed = elapsed + dt
		local goal = stepVoid(cfg, dt)
		local goalCF = CFrame.new(goal)
		if cfg.Desync ~= false then
			pcall(applyDesync, hrp, goalCF)
		else
			hrp.CFrame = goalCF
			hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end
	end)
	K.track(conn)
end

-- ============================================================
-- RAGE: track REAL player positions (ignore void/desync coords)
-- No new options — always on for rage hitreg quality
-- ============================================================
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

	-- last sane world position of enemy (head preferred)
	local lastReal = {} -- [userId] = { pos = Vector3, t = number, name = string }
	local MAP_MAX = 4500 -- studs from origin; void spam is usually 1e7+
	local MAX_FRAME_DELTA = 350 -- studs/frame; void jumps exceed this
	local MAX_AGE = 2.5 -- seconds to trust last real pos

	local function isSane(pos)
		if typeof(pos) ~= "Vector3" then return false end
		if pos ~= pos then return false end -- NaN
		local m = pos.Magnitude
		if m > MAP_MAX or m ~= m then return false end
		if pos.Y < -800 or pos.Y > 2500 then return false end
		return true
	end

	local function track()
		if K.destroyed then return end
		local now = os.clock()
		for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if plr == LocalPlayer then continue end
			local char = plr.Character
			if not char then continue end
			local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then continue end
			local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
			local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local part = head or hrp
			if not part then continue end
			local pos = part.Position
			local prev = lastReal[plr.UserId]
			if isSane(pos) then
				if prev and (pos - prev.pos).Magnitude > MAX_FRAME_DELTA then
					-- jump too large = void flicker; keep previous real
				else
					lastReal[plr.UserId] = { pos = pos, t = now, name = plr.Name }
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local function resolveRealPos(part, plr)
		if part and isSane(part.Position) then
			return part.Position, part
		end
		local uid = plr and plr.UserId
		if not uid and part then
			local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			local p = model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
			uid = p and p.UserId
			plr = p
		end
		if uid and lastReal[uid] then
			local e = lastReal[uid]
			if os.clock() - e.t <= MAX_AGE then
				return e.pos, part
			end
		end
		return part and part.Position or nil, part
	end

	K.track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(track))

	-- Rewrite StartShooting aim toward last real position when target is voided
	task.defer(function()
		local util, enumLib
		pcall(function()
			util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Utility)
		end)
		pcall(function()
			enumLib = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.EnumLibrary)
		end)
		local useItem
		pcall(function()
			useItem = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Replication.Fighter.UseItem
		end)
		if not useItem or not util or type(hookfunction) ~= "function" then
			return
		end
		local startEnum
		pcall(function()
			startEnum = enumLib:ToEnum("StartShooting")
		end)
		local old
		old = hookfunction(useItem.FireServer, newcclosure(function(self, objId, enumVal, camdata, extra)
			if self == useItem and camdata and type(camdata) == "table" then
				local isShoot = (startEnum and enumVal == startEnum)
					or (tostring(enumVal):find("StartShooting") ~= nil)
				if isShoot then
					local entry = camdata[utf8.char(1)] or camdata["\1"] or camdata[1]
					if type(entry) == "table" then
						local part = entry[utf8.char(2)] or entry["\2"] or entry[2]
						if typeof(part) == "Instance" then
							local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
							local plr = model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
							local realPos = select(1, resolveRealPos(part, plr))
							if realPos and not isSane(part.Position) then
								-- rebuild aim from local root / camera toward REAL pos
								local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
								local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
								local origin = myRoot and myRoot.Position or workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
								local aimCF = CFrame.lookAt(origin, realPos)
								local targetCF = CFrame.new(realPos)
								local objSpace = CFrame.new()
								pcall(function()
									objSpace = part.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(CFrame.new(realPos))
								end)
								pcall(function()
									entry[utf8.char(0)] = util:EncodeCFrame(aimCF)
									entry[utf8.char(1)] = util:EncodeCFrame(targetCF)
									entry[utf8.char(3)] = util:EncodeCFrame(objSpace)
								end)
								-- also string-key variants some builds use
								pcall(function()
									if entry["\0"] ~= nil then entry["\0"] = util:EncodeCFrame(aimCF) end
									if entry["\1"] ~= nil then entry["\1"] = util:EncodeCFrame(targetCF) end
									if entry["\3"] ~= nil then entry["\3"] = util:EncodeCFrame(objSpace) end
								end)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			return old(self, objId, enumVal, camdata, extra)
		end))
	end)

	-- Soft GetTarget boost: among enemies, prefer sane-position ones first (hack via tagging lastReal)
	-- Heartbeat already tracks; no schema change
end


-- ============================================================
-- Anti Aim (Dreamer method) · EncodeCameraRotation bend FIXED multi-path
-- ============================================================
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

	local MAX_CODE_POINT = 0x10ffff
	local TAU = 2 * math.pi
	local hooked = false

	local function codePoint(value)
		local point = math.floor(value)
		if point >= 0xd800 and point < 0xe000 then
			point = 0xe000
		end
		return utf8.char(math.clamp(point, 0, MAX_CODE_POINT))
	end

	local function cfg()
		local ok, data = pcall(function()
			return tbl17.bG().Data
		end)
		if ok and type(data) == "table" and type(data.AntiAim) == "table" then
			return data.AntiAim
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function aaOn(s)
		return s and (s.Enabled == true or s.Desync == true or s.Spinbot == true or s.HeadGhost == true)
	end

	local function bendPose(settings, pitch, yaw, random)
		pitch = tonumber(pitch) or 0
		yaw = tonumber(yaw) or 0
		local mode = string.lower(tostring(settings.PitchMode or "disabled"))
		if mode == "extended custom" then
			local cp = tonumber(settings.CustomPitch) or 0
			-- full range encode used by Rivals AA
			return { kind = "encoded", data = codePoint((cp + 180) / 360 * MAX_CODE_POINT) }
		elseif mode == "extended random" then
			return { kind = "encoded", data = codePoint(random(0, MAX_CODE_POINT)) }
		elseif mode == "offset" then
			pitch = pitch + (tonumber(settings.CustomPitch) or 0)
		elseif mode == "random" then
			pitch = random(-89, 89)
		elseif mode == "look up" then
			pitch = 89
		elseif mode == "look down" then
			pitch = -89
		elseif mode == "custom" then
			pitch = tonumber(settings.CustomPitch) or 0
		end

		mode = string.lower(tostring(settings.YawMode or "disabled"))
		if mode == "offset" then
			yaw = yaw + (tonumber(settings.CustomYaw) or 0)
		elseif mode == "backwards" then
			yaw = yaw + 180
		elseif mode == "random" then
			yaw = random(0, 360)
		elseif mode == "custom" then
			yaw = tonumber(settings.CustomYaw) or 0
		end

		if settings.Desync == true or settings.HeadGhost == true then
			local amount = tonumber(settings.DesyncAmount) or 70
			local side = tostring(settings.DesyncSide or "Left")
			local mul = 1
			if side == "Right" then
				mul = -1
			elseif side == "Jitter" then
				mul = (math.floor(os.clock() * 5) % 2 == 0) and 1 or -1
			end
			yaw = yaw + amount * mul
			if settings.FakePitch or settings.BodyPitch then
				local fp = tonumber(settings.FakePitchValue)
				if fp == nil then
					fp = -89
				end
				if settings.FakePitchHard or settings.BodyPitch then
					if fp >= 0 then
						fp = math.max(fp, 89)
						if fp < 120 then
							fp = 180
						end
					else
						fp = math.min(fp, -89)
						if fp > -120 then
							fp = -180
						end
					end
				end
				pitch = fp
			end
		end
		if settings.Spinbot then
			local spd = tonumber(settings.SpinSpeed) or 720
			yaw = (os.clock() * spd) % 360
		end
		return { kind = "angles", pitch = pitch, yaw = yaw }
	end

	local function extractPY(rotation)
		-- Utility receives Vector2(pitchRad, yawRad) usually
		if typeof(rotation) == "Vector2" then
			return math.deg(rotation.X), math.deg(rotation.Y)
		end
		if typeof(rotation) == "Vector3" then
			return math.deg(rotation.X), math.deg(rotation.Y)
		end
		if type(rotation) == "number" then
			return math.deg(rotation), 0
		end
		if type(rotation) == "table" then
			local x = rotation.X or rotation[1] or 0
			local y = rotation.Y or rotation[2] or 0
			-- if already degrees (abs > 2pi-ish), keep
			if math.abs(x) > 6.5 or math.abs(y) > 6.5 then
				return x, y
			end
			return math.deg(x), math.deg(y)
		end
		return 0, 0
	end

	local function applyEncode(encode, self, rotation, ...)
		local settings = cfg()
		if not aaOn(settings) then
			return encode(self, rotation, ...)
		end
		local p, y = extractPY(rotation)
		local pose = bendPose(settings, p, y, math.random)
		if pose.kind == "encoded" then
			return pose.data
		end
		return encode(self, Vector2.new(math.rad(pose.pitch), math.rad(pose.yaw)), ...)
	end

	local function tryHook()
		if hooked then
			return true
		end
		local utility
		pcall(function()
			utility = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Utility)
		end)
		if not utility or type(utility.EncodeCameraRotation) ~= "function" then
			return false
		end
		local encode = utility.EncodeCameraRotation

		-- Path A: hookfunction on EncodeCameraRotation
		local okA = false
		pcall(function()
			if type(hookfunction) == "function" then
				local old
				old = hookfunction(encode, newcclosure(function(self, rotation, ...)
					return applyEncode(old, self, rotation, ...)
				end))
				okA = true
			end
		end)

		-- Path B: swap Utility upvalue inside CameraReplicationLoop
		local okB = false
		pcall(function()
			local ps = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
			local controllers = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("Controllers")
			local fighterMod = controllers and controllers:FindFirstChild("FighterController")
			if not fighterMod then
				return
			end
			local FC = require(fighterMod)
			local loop = FC._CameraReplicationLoop
			if type(loop) ~= "function" or not debug or not debug.getupvalues then
				return
			end
			local standIn = setmetatable({}, { __index = utility })
			standIn.EncodeCameraRotation = function(self, rotation, ...)
				return applyEncode(encode, utility, rotation, ...)
			end
			pcall(function()
				if type(newcclosure) == "function" then
					standIn.EncodeCameraRotation = newcclosure(standIn.EncodeCameraRotation)
				end
			end)
			local ups = debug.getupvalues(loop)
			for index, value in pairs(ups) do
				if value == utility then
					debug.setupvalue(loop, index, standIn)
					okB = true
				elseif type(value) == "table" and value.EncodeCameraRotation == encode then
					local clone = setmetatable({}, { __index = value })
					clone.EncodeCameraRotation = standIn.EncodeCameraRotation
					debug.setupvalue(loop, index, clone)
					okB = true
				end
			end
		end)

		-- Path C: FireServer on UpdateCameraRotation remote
		local okC = false
		pcall(function()
			local rem = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
			rem = rem and rem:FindFirstChild("Replication")
			rem = rem and rem:FindFirstChild("Fighter")
			rem = rem and rem:FindFirstChild("UpdateCameraRotation")
			if not rem or not hookfunction then
				return
			end
			local oldFire
			oldFire = hookfunction(rem.FireServer, newcclosure(function(self, ...)
				local args = { ... }
				-- args may be encoded rotation string / numbers
				local settings = cfg()
				if aaOn(settings) and #args >= 1 then
					local pose = bendPose(settings, 0, 0, math.random)
					if pose.kind == "encoded" then
						args[1] = pose.data
						return oldFire(self, table.unpack(args))
					end
					-- if first arg is Vector2-like, bend it before original encode path already sent
				end
				return oldFire(self, ...)
			end))
			okC = true
		end)

		-- Path D: soft-fail decode bulk
		pcall(function()
			local decode = utility.DecodeCameraRotationBulk
			if type(decode) == "function" and hookfunction then
				local old
				old = hookfunction(decode, newcclosure(function(...)
					local results = table.pack(pcall(old, ...))
					if results[1] then
						return table.unpack(results, 2, results.n)
					end
					return {}
				end))
			end
		end)

		hooked = okA or okB or okC
		return hooked
	end

	-- init + retry (FighterController may load late)
	task.spawn(function()
		for i = 1, 30 do
			if tryHook() then
				break
			end
			task.wait(0.5)
		end
	end)
	LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		task.delay(0.8, function()
			hooked = false
			tryHook()
		end)
	end)

	-- Visualise (solo local, no toca encode)
	local visConn = nil
	local function stopVisualise()
		if visConn then
			pcall(function()
				visConn:Disconnect()
			end)
			visConn = nil
		end
	end

	visConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local c = cfg()
		if not c or not c.Enabled or not c.Visualise then
			return
		end
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		if not char then
			return
		end
		pcall(function()
			local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum then
				hum.AutoRotate = false
			end
		end)
	end)

	if K and K.onUnload then
		K.onUnload(stopVisualise)
	end
end








-- ============================================================
-- SHK Desync HARD · multi-path EncodeCameraRotation + FireServer rewrite
-- Si el server mandaba la cabeza real, es porque el encode del juego ganaba la carrera.
-- Aqui reescribimos TODO paquete UpdateCameraRotation y el encode de Utility.
-- ============================================================
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

	local TAU = math.pi * 2
	local utilMod = nil
	local rotRemote = nil
	local ghost = nil
	local jitter = 1
	local lastPrint = 0
	local interceptCount = 0

	local function cfg()
		local ok, d = pcall(function() return tbl17.bG().Data end)
		if not ok or not d or type(d.AntiAim) ~= "table" then return nil end
		return d.AntiAim
	end

	local function desyncActive(c)
		return c and (c.Desync == true or c.HeadGhost == true or c.Spinbot == true)
	end

	local function resolveAngles(c, realPitchDeg, realYawDeg)
		local amount = tonumber(c.DesyncAmount) or 70
		local side = tostring(c.DesyncSide or "Left")
		local mul = 1
		if side == "Right" then
			mul = -1
		elseif side == "Jitter" then
			if os.clock() % 0.18 < 0.04 then jitter = -jitter end
			mul = jitter
		end
		local yaw = realYawDeg + amount * mul
		local pitch = realPitchDeg

		-- AA pitch modes
		if c.Enabled then
			local pm = string.lower(tostring(c.PitchMode or "disabled"))
			if pm == "custom" then pitch = tonumber(c.CustomPitch) or pitch
			elseif pm == "offset" then pitch = realPitchDeg + (tonumber(c.CustomPitch) or 0)
			elseif pm == "look up" then pitch = 89
			elseif pm == "look down" then pitch = -89
			elseif pm == "random" then pitch = math.random(-89, 89)
			elseif pm == "extended custom" then pitch = tonumber(c.CustomPitch) or pitch
			end
			local ym = string.lower(tostring(c.YawMode or "disabled"))
			if ym == "custom" then yaw = (tonumber(c.CustomYaw) or 0) + amount * mul
			elseif ym == "backwards" then yaw = realYawDeg + 180 + amount * mul
			elseif ym == "offset" then yaw = realYawDeg + (tonumber(c.CustomYaw) or 0) + amount * mul
			elseif ym == "random" then yaw = math.random(0, 360)
			end
		end

		-- Fake pitch: full body hard (rage suele ir a head arriba → mandamos pitch al piso)
		if c.FakePitch then
			local fp = tonumber(c.FakePitchValue)
			if fp == nil then fp = -89 end
			if c.FakePitchHard then
				-- fuerza extremos: -180..180 y empuja a valores duros
				if fp >= 0 then
					fp = math.max(fp, 89)
					if fp < 120 then fp = 180 end -- mirar "atras/arriba" extremo
				else
					fp = math.min(fp, -89)
					if fp > -120 then fp = -180 end -- mirar al piso extremo
				end
			end
			pitch = fp
		elseif c.BodyPitch then
			-- sin toggle FakePitch, BodyPitch aplica pitch duro automatico
			pitch = tonumber(c.FakePitchValue) or -180
		end

		-- Spinbot: yaw gira full 360 (otros lo ven por encode)
		if c.Spinbot then
			local spd = tonumber(c.SpinSpeed) or 720
			yaw = (os.clock() * spd) % 360
		end
		return pitch, yaw, amount * mul
	end

	local function realCamDeg()
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not cam then return 0, 0 end
		local lv = cam.CFrame.LookVector
		local pitch = math.deg(math.asin(math.clamp(lv.Y, -1, 1)))
		local yaw = math.deg(math.atan2(-lv.X, -lv.Z))
		return pitch, yaw
	end

	-- mismo encode que usa Rivals (Utility / ViewAngleDriver)
	local function encodeCameraRotation(pitchRad, yawRad)
		local n = math.clamp(math.floor((pitchRad % TAU) / math.pi / 2 * 256 + 0.5), 0, 255)
		local n2 = math.clamp(math.floor((yawRad % TAU) / math.pi / 2 * 256 + 0.5), 0, 255)
		return utf8.char(n) .. utf8.char(n2)
	end

	local function encodeFromDeg(pitchDeg, yawDeg)
		return encodeCameraRotation(math.rad(pitchDeg), math.rad(yawDeg))
	end

	local function ensureRefs()
		if utilMod and rotRemote then return true end
		pcall(function()
			utilMod = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Utility)
		end)
		pcall(function()
			rotRemote = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Replication.Fighter.UpdateCameraRotation
		end)
		return utilMod ~= nil and rotRemote ~= nil
	end

	-- PATH 1: hookfunction EncodeCameraRotation (Utility)
	local function installEncodeHook()
		if not ensureRefs() then return end
		local encode = utilMod.EncodeCameraRotation
		if type(encode) ~= "function" or not hookfunction then return end
		pcall(function()
			local old
			old = hookfunction(encode, newcclosure(function(self, rotation, ...)
				local c = cfg()
				if not desyncActive(c) then
					return old(self, rotation, ...)
				end
				local rp, ry
				if typeof(rotation) == "Vector2" then
					rp, ry = math.deg(rotation.X), math.deg(rotation.Y)
				else
					rp, ry = realCamDeg()
				end
				local np, ny = resolveAngles(c, rp, ry)
				interceptCount += 1
				return old(self, Vector2.new(math.rad(np), math.rad(ny)), ...)
			end))
		end)
	end

	-- PATH 2: __namecall FireServer rewrite on UpdateCameraRotation
	local function installNamecallHook()
		if not ensureRefs() or not hookmetamethod then return end
		pcall(function()
			local old
			old = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", newcclosure(function(self, ...)
				local method = getnamecallmethod()
				if method == "FireServer" and rotRemote and self == rotRemote then
					local c = cfg()
					if desyncActive(c) then
						local rp, ry = realCamDeg()
						local np, ny = resolveAngles(c, rp, ry)
						local packet = encodeFromDeg(np, ny)
						interceptCount += 1
						return old(self, packet, nil)
					end
				end
				return old(self, ...)
			end))
		end)
	end

	-- PATH 3: hook remote.FireServer directly
	local function installRemoteFireHook()
		if not ensureRefs() or not hookfunction then return end
		pcall(function()
			local fire = rotRemote.FireServer
			if type(fire) ~= "function" then return end
			local old
			old = hookfunction(fire, newcclosure(function(self, ...)
				if self == rotRemote then
					local c = cfg()
					if desyncActive(c) then
						local rp, ry = realCamDeg()
						local np, ny = resolveAngles(c, rp, ry)
						local packet = encodeFromDeg(np, ny)
						interceptCount += 1
						return old(self, packet, nil)
					end
				end
				return old(self, ...)
			end))
		end)
	end

	-- PATH 4: re-assert Dreamer upvalue swap + force bend
	local function reassertDreamer()
		pcall(function()
			local ps = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
			local controllers = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("Controllers")
			local fighterMod = controllers and controllers:FindFirstChild("FighterController")
			if not fighterMod then return end
			local FC = require(fighterMod)
			local loop = FC._CameraReplicationLoop
			if type(loop) ~= "function" or not debug or not debug.getupvalues then return end
			local utility = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Utility)
			local encode = utility.EncodeCameraRotation
			if type(encode) ~= "function" then return end
			local standIn = setmetatable({}, { __index = utility })
			standIn.EncodeCameraRotation = function(_, rotation, ...)
				local c = cfg()
				if not desyncActive(c) and not (c and c.Enabled) then
					return encode(utility, rotation, ...)
				end
				local rp, ry
				if typeof(rotation) == "Vector2" then
					rp, ry = math.deg(rotation.X), math.deg(rotation.Y)
				else
					rp, ry = realCamDeg()
				end
				-- apply AA bend if enabled
				if c.Enabled then
					local pm = string.lower(tostring(c.PitchMode or "disabled"))
					if pm == "custom" then rp = tonumber(c.CustomPitch) or rp
					elseif pm == "offset" then rp = rp + (tonumber(c.CustomPitch) or 0)
					elseif pm == "look up" then rp = 89
					elseif pm == "look down" then rp = -89
					end
					local ym = string.lower(tostring(c.YawMode or "disabled"))
					if ym == "custom" then ry = tonumber(c.CustomYaw) or ry
					elseif ym == "backwards" then ry = ry + 180
					elseif ym == "offset" then ry = ry + (tonumber(c.CustomYaw) or 0)
					end
				end
				if desyncActive(c) then
					local np, ny = resolveAngles(c, rp, ry)
					rp, ry = np, ny
				end
				interceptCount += 1
				return encode(utility, Vector2.new(math.rad(rp), math.rad(ry)), ...)
			end
			pcall(function()
				if newcclosure then standIn.EncodeCameraRotation = newcclosure(standIn.EncodeCameraRotation) end
			end)
			local ups = debug.getupvalues(loop)
			for index, value in pairs(ups) do
				if value == utility or (type(value) == "table" and value.EncodeCameraRotation) then
					debug.setupvalue(loop, index, standIn)
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	local function clearGhost()
		if ghost then pcall(function() ghost:Destroy() end) ghost = nil end
	end

	local function ensureGhost(color, trans)
		if ghost and ghost.Parent then return ghost end
		clearGhost()
		local m = Instance.new("Model")
		m.Name = "ShakoNeverloseGhost"
		m.Parent = workspace
		local head = Instance.new("Part")
		head.Name = "Head"
		head.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		head.Size = Vector3.new(1.15, 1.15, 1.15)
		head.Anchored = true
		head.CanCollide = false
		head.CanQuery = false
		head.CanTouch = false
		head.CastShadow = false
		head.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
		head.Color = color
		head.Transparency = trans
		head.Parent = m
		local body = Instance.new("Part")
		body.Name = "Body"
		body.Size = Vector3.new(1.5, 1.7, 0.85)
		body.Anchored = true
		body.CanCollide = false
		body.CanQuery = false
		body.CanTouch = false
		body.CastShadow = false
		body.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
		body.Color = color
		body.Transparency = math.clamp(trans + 0.12, 0, 0.95)
		body.Parent = m
		local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(140, 20)
		bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 1.35, 0)
		bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
		bb.Parent = head
		local tl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		tl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		tl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		tl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		tl.TextSize = 12
		tl.TextColor3 = color
		tl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
		tl.Text = "FAKE (enemy view)"
		tl.Parent = bb
		ghost = m
		return m
	end

	-- install all paths
	task.defer(function()
		task.wait(1)
		ensureRefs()
		installEncodeHook()
		installNamecallHook()
		installRemoteFireHook()
		reassertDreamer()
	end)

	-- keep dreamer alive (respawn / controller refresh)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(2.5)
			if desyncActive(cfg()) then
				reassertDreamer()
			end
		end
	end)

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local c = cfg()
		if not desyncActive(c) then
			clearGhost()
			return
		end
		if c.ShowEnemyView or c.HeadGhost then
			local char = LocalPlayer.Character
			local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
			local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not root then clearGhost() return end
			local color = (typeof(c.GhostColor) == "Color3") and c.GhostColor or Color3.fromRGB(120, 210, 255)
			local trans = tonumber(c.GhostTransparency) or 0.55
			local g = ensureGhost(color, trans)
			local rp, ry = realCamDeg()
			local np, ny, off = resolveAngles(c, rp, ry)
			local base = head and head.CFrame or (root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0))
			local fakeCF = CFrame.new(base.Position)
				* CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(ny), 0)
				* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(np), 0, 0)
				* CFrame.new((off >= 0 and 1 or -1) * 0.9, 0, 0)
			local gh, gb = g:FindFirstChild("Head"), g:FindFirstChild("Body")
			if gh then gh.Color = color gh.Transparency = trans gh.CFrame = fakeCF end
			if gb then gb.Color = color gb.Transparency = math.clamp(trans + 0.12, 0, 0.95) gb.CFrame = fakeCF * CFrame.new(0, -1.05, 0) end
		else
			clearGhost()
		end
	end)

	LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		clearGhost()
		task.delay(1, reassertDreamer)
	end)

end


-- SHK Spinbot local CFrame (optional) + force network spin tick
-- ============================================================
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

	local function cfg()
		local ok, d = pcall(function() return tbl17.bG().Data end)
		if not ok or not d or type(d.AntiAim) ~= "table" then return nil end
		return d.AntiAim
	end

	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		local c = cfg()
		if not c or not c.Spinbot then return end
		if not c.SpinLocal then return end
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not root then return end
		pcall(function()
			if hum then hum.AutoRotate = false end
			local spd = tonumber(c.SpinSpeed) or 720
			local ang = math.rad(spd * dt)
			root.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, ang, 0)
		end)
	end)

end
