-- ============================================================
-- SHK BRAND LOCK · sobrevive Auto Load / configs de Kicia
-- ============================================================
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

	local function forceShkBranding()
		pcall(function()
			local pg = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
			if not pg then return end
			for _, gui in ipairs(pg:GetDescendants()) do
				if gui:IsA("TextLabel") or gui:IsA("TextButton") then
					local t = gui.Text
					if type(t) == "string" and t ~= "" then
						if t:find("KiciaHook") or t:find("Kiciahook") or t:find("kiciahook") then
							gui.Text = t:gsub("[Kk]icia[Hh]ook", "SHK"):gsub("Premium Build", "Premium")
						end
						-- logo KH solo (texto exacto)
						if t == "KH" or t == "Kh" then
							gui.Text = "SHK"
							gui.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
						end
					end
				elseif gui:IsA("ImageLabel") or gui:IsA("ImageButton") then
					-- logo imagen KH → texto SHK
					local n = tostring(gui.Name or "")
					local img = tostring(gui.Image or "")
					if n:find("Logo") or n:find("logo") or n:find("Lithium") or n:find("Brand") then
						if gui:FindFirstChild("SHKLock") then
							-- already converted
						else
							local parent = gui.Parent
							if parent then
								gui.ImageTransparency = 1
								local tl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
								tl.Name = "SHKLock"
								tl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
								tl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
								tl.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
								tl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
								tl.Text = "SHK"
								tl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
								tl.TextScaled = true
								tl.ZIndex = (gui.ZIndex or 1) + 2
								tl.Parent = parent
								-- match size roughly
								tl.Size = gui.Size
								tl.Position = gui.Position
								tl.AnchorPoint = gui.AnchorPoint
								tl.LayoutOrder = gui.LayoutOrder
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	-- al inicio
	task.defer(forceShkBranding)
	task.delay(1, forceShkBranding)
	task.delay(3, forceShkBranding)

	-- cada vez que cargue algo en PlayerGui (configs / rebuild)
	pcall(function()
		local pg = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 10)
		if pg then
			pg.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
				task.defer(function()
					if obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") then
						local t = obj.Text
						if type(t) == "string" and (t:find("Kicia") or t == "KH") then
							forceShkBranding()
						end
					elseif obj:IsA("ImageLabel") then
						local n = tostring(obj.Name or "")
						if n:find("Logo") or n:find("logo") then
							forceShkBranding()
						end
					end
				end)
			end)
		end
	end)

	-- refuerzo lento (no lag): cada 2s
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(2)
			forceShkBranding()
		end
	end)

end




-- ============================================================
-- SHK Tactical viewmodel + No Hands
-- Solo en partida (con arma equipada): oculta brazos/manos del viewmodel.
-- El arma se queda visible.
-- ============================================================
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

	local saved = {} -- [BasePart] = { Transparency, LTM, decals... }

	local ARM_EXACT = {
		leftupperarm = true, leftlowerarm = true, lefthand = true,
		rightupperarm = true, rightlowerarm = true, righthand = true,
		leftarm = true, rightarm = true, leftforearm = true, rightforearm = true,
		["left arm"] = true, ["right arm"] = true, ["left hand"] = true, ["right hand"] = true,
		arms = true, arm = true, hands = true, hand = true, gloves = true, glove = true,
		upperarm = true, lowerarm = true, forearm = true, wrist = true, palm = true,
		leftglove = true, rightglove = true, sleeve = true,
	}

	local WEAPON_HINT = {
		item = true, weapon = true, gun = true, itemmodel = true, weaponmodel = true,
		blade = true, barrel = true, magazine = true, mag = true, stock = true,
		scope = true, sight = true, muzzle = true, receiver = true, grip = true,
		handle = true, slide = true, bolt = true, rail = true, suppressor = true,
	}

	local function cfgNoHands()
		local ok, data = pcall(function() return tbl17.bG().Data end)
		if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return false end
		local skin = data.ViewmodelSkin
		return type(skin) == "table" and skin.NoHands == true
	end

	local function norm(name)
		return string.lower((tostring(name or "")):gsub("%s+", ""))
	end

	-- ¿Estamos en partida / con arma? (no lobby vacío)
	local function inMatchWithWeapon()
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		if not char then return false end
		-- EnvironmentID = en matchmaking / partida
		local envOk, env = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID") end)
		local inEnv = envOk and env ~= nil and env ~= "" and env ~= 0
		-- arma equipada via FighterController
		local hasItem = false
		pcall(function()
			local ps = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
			local controllers = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("Controllers")
			local mod = controllers and controllers:FindFirstChild("FighterController")
			if not mod then return end
			local fc = require(mod)
			local item = fc and fc.LocalFighter and fc.LocalFighter.EquippedItem
			hasItem = item ~= nil
		end)
		-- también: viewmodel bajo camera
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local hasVm = false
		if cam then
			for _, c in ipairs(cam:GetChildren()) do
				if c:IsA("Model") and c.Name ~= "ShakoValorantHands" then
					hasVm = true
					break
				end
			end
		end
		-- partida si EnvironmentID o hay viewmodel/arma
		return (inEnv or hasItem or hasVm) and (hasItem or hasVm)
	end

	local function isArmName(name)
		local n = norm(name)
		if ARM_EXACT[n] then return true end
		if n:find("sleeve", 1, true) or n:find("finger", 1, true) or n:find("thumb", 1, true)
			or n:find("palm", 1, true) or n:find("forearm", 1, true) or n:find("wrist", 1, true)
			or n:find("glove", 1, true) or n:find("upperarm", 1, true) or n:find("lowerarm", 1, true) then
			return true
		end
		-- left/right + arm/hand, evitando handguard/handle del arma
		if (n:find("left", 1, true) or n:find("right", 1, true)) then
			if n:find("arm", 1, true) or n:find("hand", 1, true) then
				if not n:find("handguard", 1, true) and not n:find("handle", 1, true)
					and not n:find("handgrip", 1, true) then
					return true
				end
			end
		end
		return false
	end

	local function isWeaponName(name)
		local n = norm(name)
		if WEAPON_HINT[n] then return true end
		for k in pairs(WEAPON_HINT) do
			if n:find(k, 1, true) then return true end
		end
		return false
	end

	local function isUnderWeapon(part, gunRoot)
		if not gunRoot then return false end
		return part:IsDescendantOf(gunRoot)
	end

	local function capture(part)
		if saved[part] then return saved[part] end
		local rec = {
			Transparency = part.Transparency,
			LTM = part.LocalTransparencyModifier,
			children = {},
		}
		for _, d in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
			if d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then
				rec.children[#rec.children + 1] = { inst = d, t = d.Transparency }
			elseif d:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
				rec.children[#rec.children + 1] = { inst = d, kind = "sa", parent = part }
			elseif d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("Beam") or d:IsA("Trail") then
				rec.children[#rec.children + 1] = { inst = d, kind = "fx", enabled = d.Enabled }
			end
		end
		saved[part] = rec
		return rec
	end

	local function hidePart(part)
		local rec = capture(part)
		pcall(function()
			part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
			part.Transparency = 1
			for _, c in ipairs(rec.children) do
				if c.kind == "sa" then
					if c.inst and c.inst.Parent then c.inst.Parent = nil end
				elseif c.kind == "fx" then
					if c.inst then c.inst.Enabled = false end
				elseif c.inst then
					c.inst.Transparency = 1
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	local function restorePart(part)
		local rec = saved[part]
		if not rec then return end
		pcall(function()
			if part and part.Parent then
				part.Transparency = rec.Transparency
				part.LocalTransparencyModifier = rec.LTM
				for _, c in ipairs(rec.children) do
					if c.kind == "sa" then
						if c.inst and c.parent and c.inst.Parent ~= c.parent then
							c.inst.Parent = c.parent
						end
					elseif c.kind == "fx" then
						if c.inst then c.inst.Enabled = c.enabled end
					elseif c.inst and c.inst.Parent then
						c.inst.Transparency = c.t
					end
				end
			end
		end)
		saved[part] = nil
	end

	local function restoreAll()
		for part in pairs(saved) do
			restorePart(part)
		end
	end

	local function findGunRoot(model)
		for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
			if (d:IsA("Model") or d:IsA("Folder")) and isWeaponName(d.Name) then
				if d:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) then
					return d
				end
			end
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function collectViewmodels()
		local list, seen = {}, {}
		local function add(inst)
			if typeof(inst) ~= "Instance" then return end
			local model = inst:IsA("Model") and inst or inst:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			if not model or seen[model] then return end
			if model == LocalPlayer.Character then return end
			if model.Name == "ShakoValorantHands" then return end
			seen[model] = true
			list[#list + 1] = model
		end
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if cam then
			for _, c in ipairs(cam:GetChildren()) do add(c) end
			-- a veces el VM está anidado
			for _, d in ipairs(cam:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("Model") and (isArmName(d.Name) or isWeaponName(d.Name) or norm(d.Name):find("view", 1, true)) then
					add(d)
				end
			end
		end
		pcall(function()
			local ps = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
			local controllers = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("Controllers")
			local mod = controllers and controllers:FindFirstChild("FighterController")
			if not mod then return end
			local fc = require(mod)
			local item = fc and fc.LocalFighter and fc.LocalFighter.EquippedItem
			if not item then return end
			local vm = item.ViewModel
			if vm == nil and item.Inner then vm = item.Inner.ViewModel end
			if typeof(vm) == "Instance" then
				add(vm)
			elseif type(vm) == "table" then
				for _, key in ipairs({ "Model", "Arms", "ArmsModel", "Item", "ItemModel", "Weapon", "Root", "Instance" }) do
					local v
					pcall(function() v = vm[key] end)
					if typeof(v) == "Instance" then add(v) end
				end
			end
		end)
		return list
	end

	local function isArmPart(part, model, gunRoot)
		if isUnderWeapon(part, gunRoot) then
			-- piezas del arma: solo si el nombre es claramente brazo
			return isArmName(part.Name)
		end
		if isArmName(part.Name) then return true end
		-- parent chain: Arms / LeftArm folder
		local p = part.Parent
		local depth = 0
		while p and p ~= model and depth < 6 do
			if isArmName(p.Name) then return true end
			if isWeaponName(p.Name) then return false end
			p = p.Parent
			depth += 1
		end
		return false
	end

	local seenParts = {}
	local function apply()
		if not cfgNoHands() then
			if next(saved) then restoreAll() end
			return
		end
		-- solo en partida / con arma (no en menú vacío)
		if not inMatchWithWeapon() then
			if next(saved) then restoreAll() end
			return
		end

		table.clear(seenParts)
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character

		for _, model in ipairs(collectViewmodels()) do
			if char and (model == char or model:IsDescendantOf(char)) then
				continue
			end
			local gun = findGunRoot(model)
			for _, part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") then
					if char and part:IsDescendantOf(char) then continue end
					local n = norm(part.Name)
					if n == "humanoidrootpart" or n == "rootpart" or n == "camera" then
						continue
					end
					if isArmPart(part, model, gun) then
						seenParts[part] = true
						hidePart(part)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		-- limpiar partes que ya no existen
		for part in pairs(saved) do
			if not seenParts[part] then
				restorePart(part)
			end
		end
	end

	-- Después del update del viewmodel del juego (prioridad alta)
	pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ShakoViewSkin") end)
	RunService:BindToRenderStep("ShakoViewSkin", Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value + 200, apply)
	-- refuerzo en Heartbeat por si el juego reescribe LTM
	local hb = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not cfgNoHands() then return end
		for part in pairs(saved) do
			if part and part.Parent then
				if part.LocalTransparencyModifier < 1 or part.Transparency < 1 then
					pcall(function()
						part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
						part.Transparency = 1
					end)
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	if K and K.onUnload then
		K.onUnload(function()
			pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ShakoViewSkin") end)
			if hb then pcall(function() hb:Disconnect() end) end
			restoreAll()
		end)
	end
end


-- ============================================================
-- SHK Charm Color Override · pinta TODO el charm/rank (Nemesis etc)
-- ============================================================
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

	local original = {} -- [BasePart] = {Color, TextureID, Material, Reflectance}

	local function cfg()
		local ok, data = pcall(function() return tbl17.bG().Data end)
		if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return nil end
		local c = data.CharmColorOverride
		return type(c) == "table" and c or nil
	end

	local function norm(s)
		return string.lower(tostring(s or ""))
	end

	local function capture(part)
		if original[part] then return end
		original[part] = {
			Color = part.Color,
			TextureID = part:IsA("MeshPart") and part.TextureID or nil,
			Material = part.Material,
			Reflectance = part.Reflectance,
		}
	end

	local function restoreAll()
		for part, rec in pairs(original) do
			if part and part.Parent then
				pcall(function()
					part.Color = rec.Color
					part.Material = rec.Material
					part.Reflectance = rec.Reflectance
					if rec.TextureID ~= nil and part:IsA("MeshPart") then
						part.TextureID = rec.TextureID
					end
				end)
			end
		end
		table.clear(original)
	end

	local function forcePaint(part, color)
		capture(part)
		pcall(function()
			-- sacar todo lo que tapa el Color
			if part:IsA("MeshPart") then
				part.TextureID = ""
			end
			for _, ch in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
				if ch:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
					ch:Destroy()
				elseif ch:IsA("Decal") or ch:IsA("Texture") then
					ch.Transparency = 1
				elseif ch:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
					pcall(function() ch.TextureId = "" end)
				end
			end
			part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			part.Reflectance = 0
			part.Color = color
			-- por si el juego reescribe Material
			part.LocalTransparencyModifier = math.min(part.LocalTransparencyModifier, 0)
		end)
	end

	local function isCharmRelatedName(name)
		local n = norm(name)
		if n == "" then return false end
		-- rank / season charms de Rivals
		if n:find("charm", 1, true) then return true end
		if n:find("season", 1, true) then return true end
		if n:find("rank", 1, true) and not n:find("trank", 1, true) then return true end
		if n:find("nemesis", 1, true) or n:find("archon", 1, true) then return true end
		if n:find("trinket", 1, true) or n:find("pendant", 1, true) then return true end
		if n:find("badge", 1, true) then return true end
		if n:find("wing", 1, true) then return true end -- alas del rank charm
		return false
	end

	-- junta TODAS las BaseParts de un root
	local function partsOf(root)
		local t = {}
		if root:IsA("BasePart") then
			t[1] = root
			return t
		end
		for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("BasePart") then
				t[#t + 1] = d
			end
		end
		return t
	end

	local function collectCharmModels()
		local models, seen = {}, {}
		local function add(inst)
			if not inst or seen[inst] then return end
			-- subir al model contenedor si es un part
			local root = inst
			if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
				root = inst:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model") or inst
			end
			if seen[root] then return end
			seen[root] = true
			models[#models + 1] = root
		end

		local function scan(node, depth)
			if not node or depth > 8 then return end
			for _, child in ipairs(node:GetChildren()) do
				if isCharmRelatedName(child.Name) then
					add(child)
				end
				if child:IsA("Model") or child:IsA("Folder") or child:IsA("BasePart") then
					scan(child, depth + 1)
				end
			end
		end

		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if cam then
			scan(cam, 0)
			-- también: cualquier model chico bajo el viewmodel (rank charm suele ser hijo del arma)
			for _, vm in ipairs(cam:GetChildren()) do
				if vm:IsA("Model") then
					for _, d in ipairs(vm:GetDescendants()) do
						if d:IsA("Model") then
							local n = norm(d.Name)
							local parts = partsOf(d)
							-- rank charm: modelo con varias piezas de color, no el arma entera
							if #parts >= 2 and #parts <= 40 then
								if isCharmRelatedName(d.Name) or isCharmRelatedName(d.Parent and d.Parent.Name) then
									add(d)
								end
								-- heuristic: modelos con "Mesh" hijos y tamaño chico
								local ok, size = pcall(function()
									local cf, sz = d:GetBoundingBox()
									return sz
								end)
								if ok and size and size.Magnitude < 6 and size.Magnitude > 0.05 then
									-- si tiene >1 color distinto, es candidato a charm
									local cols = {}
									for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
										local k = string.format("%.2f%.2f%.2f", p.Color.R, p.Color.G, p.Color.B)
										cols[k] = true
									end
									local nCol = 0
									for _ in pairs(cols) do nCol += 1 end
									if nCol >= 2 then
										add(d)
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		if char then scan(char, 0) end

		-- FighterController viewmodel / charm field
		pcall(function()
			local ps = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
			local mod = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("Controllers") and ps.Controllers:FindFirstChild("FighterController")
			if not mod then return end
			local fc = require(mod)
			local item = fc and fc.LocalFighter and fc.LocalFighter.EquippedItem
			if not item then return end
			local function dig(obj, depth)
				if obj == nil or depth > 5 then return end
				if typeof(obj) == "Instance" then
					scan(obj, 0)
					if isCharmRelatedName(obj.Name) then add(obj) end
					return
				end
				if type(obj) ~= "table" then return end
				for _, key in ipairs({ "Charm", "ViewModel", "Model", "Item", "ItemModel", "Weapon", "Root", "Instance", "Inner" }) do
					local v
					pcall(function() v = obj[key] end)
					dig(v, depth + 1)
				end
			end
			dig(item, 0)
		end)

		return models
	end

	local function applyColorsToParts(parts, colors)
		if #parts == 0 then return end
		-- cluster por color ORIGINAL (guardado)
		local buckets = {}
		for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
			capture(p)
			local oc = original[p].Color
			local key = string.format("%.2f_%.2f_%.2f", oc.R, oc.G, oc.B)
			if not buckets[key] then buckets[key] = {} end
			buckets[key][#buckets[key] + 1] = p
		end
		local keys = {}
		for k in pairs(buckets) do keys[#keys + 1] = k end
		table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return #buckets[a] > #buckets[b] end)

		for i, key in ipairs(keys) do
			local col = colors[((i - 1) % #colors) + 1]
			for _, p in ipairs(buckets[key]) do
				forcePaint(p, col)
			end
		end
	end

	local function tickApply()
		local c = cfg()
		if not c or not c.Enabled then
			if next(original) then restoreAll() end
			return
		end
		local colors = {}
		for _, k in ipairs({ "Color1", "Color2", "Color3" }) do
			if typeof(c[k]) == "Color3" then
				colors[#colors + 1] = c[k]
			end
		end
		if #colors == 0 then return end

		local models = collectCharmModels()
		local painted = {}
		for _, model in ipairs(models) do
			local parts = partsOf(model)
			for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
				painted[p] = true
			end
			applyColorsToParts(parts, colors)
		end

		-- si el juego resetea, re-forzar partes ya trackeadas
		for part in pairs(original) do
			if part and part.Parent and not painted[part] then
				-- ya no está en un charm detectado
			end
		end
	end

	-- cada frame: el juego suele reaplicar texturas del rank charm
	pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ShakoCharmColor") end)
	RunService:BindToRenderStep("ShakoCharmColor", Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value + 250, tickApply)

	if K and K.onUnload then
		K.onUnload(function()
			pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ShakoCharmColor") end)
			restoreAll()
		end)
	end
end






-- ============================================================
-- SHK Auto Hit · Manipulation (wall / height scan) de shako free
-- ============================================================
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

	local manipRay = RaycastParams.new()
	manipRay.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local manipOffsets = {
		Vector3.new(0, 12, 0), Vector3.new(0, 16, 0), Vector3.new(0, 20, 0), Vector3.new(0, 24, 0),
		Vector3.new(0, 28, 0), Vector3.new(0, 32, 0), Vector3.new(0, 36, 0), Vector3.new(0, 40, 0),
	}
	local lastManipFire = 0
	local utilMod, enumMod, fighterMod

	local function cfg()
		local ok, data = pcall(function() return tbl17.bG().Data end)
		if not ok or not data or not data.Ragebot then return nil end
		return data.Ragebot.AutoHit
	end

	local function isSameTeam(plr)
		if not plr or not LocalPlayer or plr == LocalPlayer then return true end
		-- Rivals: TeamID en el Player (lo que usa el juego para IsEnemy)
		local ok1, myTeam = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("TeamID") end)
		local ok2, theirTeam = pcall(function() return plr:GetAttribute("TeamID") end)
		if ok1 and ok2 and myTeam ~= nil and theirTeam ~= nil then
			if myTeam == theirTeam then return true end
			-- TeamIDs distintos = enemigo seguro
			return false
		end
		-- Character TeamID fallback
		local mc, oc = LocalPlayer.Character, plr.Character
		if mc and oc then
			local ok3, a = pcall(function() return mc:GetAttribute("TeamID") end)
			local ok4, b = pcall(function() return oc:GetAttribute("TeamID") end)
			if ok3 and ok4 and a ~= nil and b ~= nil then
				return a == b
			end
		end
		-- Roblox Team
		if LocalPlayer.Team ~= nil and plr.Team ~= nil then
			return LocalPlayer.Team == plr.Team
		end
		if LocalPlayer.TeamColor and plr.TeamColor and LocalPlayer.Team and plr.Team then
			if LocalPlayer.TeamColor == plr.TeamColor then return true end
		end
		for _, name in ipairs({ "Team", "TeamName", "Side", "Faction", "Squad", "PartyId" }) do
			local oa, a = pcall(function() return plr:GetAttribute(name) end)
			local ob, b = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute(name) end)
			if oa and ob and a ~= nil and b ~= nil and a ~= "" and a == b then return true end
		end
		return false
	end

	local function sameMatch(plr)
		-- Solo pelear en el mismo EnvironmentID (misma partida)
		local ok1, myEnv = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID") end)
		local ok2, theirEnv = pcall(function() return plr:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID") end)
		if ok1 and ok2 and myEnv ~= nil and theirEnv ~= nil and myEnv ~= theirEnv then
			return false
		end
		return true
	end
	local function loadMods()
		if utilMod and enumMod and fighterMod then return true end
		pcall(function()
			utilMod = require(RS.Modules.Utility)
			enumMod = require(RS.Modules.EnumLibrary)
			fighterMod = require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController)
		end)
		return utilMod and enumMod and fighterMod
	end

	local function getClosest()
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not root then return nil, nil end
		local c = cfg()
		local teamCheck = not c or c.TeamCheck ~= false
		local best, bestChar, bestD = nil, nil, math.huge
		for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
				if not sameMatch(p) then continue end
				-- Team check: default ON; nunca targetear mismo TeamID
				if teamCheck and isSameTeam(p) then continue end
				local head = p.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
				local hum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if head and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
					local d = (root.Position - head.Position).Magnitude
					if d < bestD then
						bestD, best, bestChar = d, head, p.Character
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return best, bestChar
	end

	local function calcPoint(origin, targetPos, targetChar)
		manipRay.FilterDescendantsInstances = { LocalPlayer.Character, targetChar }
		if not workspace:Raycast(origin, targetPos - origin, manipRay) then
			return origin, nil
		end
		for _, offset in ipairs(manipOffsets) do
			local scan = origin + offset
			if not workspace:Raycast(scan, targetPos - scan, manipRay) then
				return scan, offset.Y
			end
		end
		return nil, nil
	end

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local c = cfg()
		if not c or not c.Enabled then return end
		-- no pelear con rage si está on (opcional: dejar ambos)
		local ok, data = pcall(function() return tbl17.bG().Data end)
		if ok and data and data.Ragebot and data.Ragebot.Enabled then
			-- permitir ambos: comment return si quieres solo auto hit sin rage
		end
		local rate = tonumber(c.Rate) or 0.05
		if tick() - lastManipFire < rate then return end
		if not loadMods() then return end
		local fc = fighterMod
		if not fc or not fc.LocalFighter then return end
		local item = fc.LocalFighter.EquippedItem
		if not item then return end
		local targetPart, targetChar = getClosest()
		if not targetPart or not targetChar then return end
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not cam then return end
		local manip, height = calcPoint(cam.CFrame.Position, targetPart.Position, targetChar)
		if not manip then return end
		local shootPos = (height == nil and manip) or cam.CFrame.Position
		local look = CFrame.lookAt(shootPos, targetPart.Position)
		local rx, ry, rz = look:ToOrientation()
		local cameradata = {}
		local okBuild = pcall(function()
			cameradata[utf8.char(1)] = {
				[utf8.char(0)] = utilMod:EncodeCFrame(CFrame.new(shootPos.X, shootPos.Y + (height or 0), shootPos.Z) * CFrame.Angles(rx, ry, rz)),
				[utf8.char(1)] = height and utilMod:EncodeCFrame(CFrame.new(targetPart.Position) * CFrame.Angles(rx, ry, rz))
					or utilMod:EncodeCFrame(CFrame.new(shootPos.X, shootPos.Y + (height or 0), shootPos.Z) * CFrame.Angles(rx, ry, rz)),
				[utf8.char(2)] = targetPart,
				[utf8.char(3)] = utilMod:EncodeCFrame(targetPart.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(CFrame.new(targetPart.Position))),
			}
		end)
		if not okBuild then return end
		local oid
		pcall(function() oid = item:Get("ObjectID") end)
		if not oid then return end
		local rem = RS:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
		rem = rem and rem:FindFirstChild("Replication")
		rem = rem and rem:FindFirstChild("Fighter")
		rem = rem and rem:FindFirstChild("UseItem")
		if not rem then return end
		lastManipFire = tick()
		pcall(function()
			rem:FireServer(oid, enumMod:ToEnum("StartShooting"), cameradata, nil)
		end)
	end)

end


-- ============================================================
-- SHK World Visuals · Potato Graphics + Show Invisible (MAPA)
-- ============================================================
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	local MaterialService = game:GetService("MaterialService")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

	local potatoApplied = false
	local saved = {}
	-- map parts we forced visible: [BasePart] = { Transparency, LocalTransparencyModifier, CanCollide? }
	local revealed = {}
	local scanCursor = 1
	local cachedParts = {}
	local lastCache = 0
	local darkSaved = {}
	local darkApplied = false
	local darkCC = nil
	local noTexSaved = {}
	local noTexApplied = false
	local noTexCursor = 1
	local noTexCache = {}
	local noTexLastCache = 0

	local function cfg()
		local ok, data = pcall(function() return tbl17.bG().Data end)
		if not ok or not data then return nil end
		return data.WorldVisuals
	end

	local function isCharacterDescendant(obj)
		for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if plr.Character and obj:IsDescendantOf(plr.Character) then
				return true
			end
		end
		return false
	end

	local function applyPotato(on)
		if on and potatoApplied then return end
		if not on and not potatoApplied then return end
		pcall(function()
			if on then
				saved.GlobalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows
				saved.Technology = Lighting.Technology
				saved.Brightness = Lighting.Brightness
				pcall(function()
					settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Level01
				end)
				pcall(function()
					local ugs = UserSettings():GetService("UserGameSettings")
					ugs.SavedQualityLevel = Enum.SavedQualitySetting.QualityLevel1
				end)
				pcall(function()
					Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
					if Enum.Technology.Compatibility then
						Lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.Compatibility
					elseif Enum.Technology.Voxel then
						Lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.Voxel
					end
					Lighting.Brightness = math.min(Lighting.Brightness, 1)
				end)
				pcall(function()
					workspace.Terrain.Decoration = false
					workspace.Terrain.WaterWaveSize = 0
					workspace.Terrain.WaterWaveSpeed = 0
					workspace.Terrain.WaterReflectance = 0
				end)
				pcall(function()
					if MaterialService then
						MaterialService.Use2022Materials = false
					end
				end)
				local n = 0
				for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
					if obj:IsA("BasePart") and not isCharacterDescendant(obj) then
						if obj.Material ~= Enum.Material.Plastic and obj.Material ~= Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic then
							obj:SetAttribute("_ShakoMat", obj.Material.Name)
							obj.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic
							n += 1
							if n > 4000 then break end
						end
						if obj.CastShadow then
							obj.CastShadow = false
						end
					elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or obj:IsA("Trail") or obj:IsA("Beam") then
						if obj.Enabled then
							obj:SetAttribute("_ShakoFx", true)
							obj.Enabled = false
						end
					end
				end
				potatoApplied = true
			else
				pcall(function()
					if saved.GlobalShadows ~= nil then Lighting.GlobalShadows = saved.GlobalShadows end
					if saved.Technology ~= nil then Lighting.Technology = saved.Technology end
					if saved.Brightness ~= nil then Lighting.Brightness = saved.Brightness end
				end)
				pcall(function()
					settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Automatic
				end)
				for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
					if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
						local m = obj:GetAttribute("_ShakoMat")
						if m then
							pcall(function() obj.Material = Enum.Material[m] end)
							obj:SetAttribute("_ShakoMat", nil)
						end
					elseif obj:GetAttribute("_ShakoFx") then
						pcall(function() obj.Enabled = true end)
						obj:SetAttribute("_ShakoFx", nil)
					end
				end
				potatoApplied = false
				table.clear(saved)
			end
		end)
	end

	local function restoreAllMap()
		for part, info in pairs(revealed) do
			if part and part.Parent then
				pcall(function()
					part.Transparency = info.Transparency
					if info.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= nil then
						part.LocalTransparencyModifier = info.LocalTransparencyModifier
					end
					if info.Color then
						part.Color = info.Color
					end
				end)
			end
		end
		table.clear(revealed)
	end

	local function rebuildCache()
		cachedParts = {}
		for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if obj:IsA("BasePart") and not isCharacterDescendant(obj) then
				-- ignorar armas / viewmodel bajo camera
				if not obj:IsDescendantOf(workspace.CurrentCamera or workspace) then
					table.insert(cachedParts, obj)
				end
			end
		end
		scanCursor = 1
		lastCache = os.clock()
	end


	-- grises oscuros pero legibles
	local DARK = Color3.fromRGB(62, 62, 70)
	local DARK2 = Color3.fromRGB(78, 78, 88)
	local DARK3 = Color3.fromRGB(48, 48, 54)

	-- no tocar jugadores, NPCs, armas ni viewmodels
	local function shouldSkipWorldFx(obj)
		if not obj then return true end
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		-- solo viewmodels bajo la camara; NO filtrar por distancia
		-- (si no, las paredes cercanas vuelven al color normal)
		if cam and obj:IsDescendantOf(cam) then
			return true
		end
		for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if plr.Character and obj:IsDescendantOf(plr.Character) then
				return true
			end
		end
		local inst = obj
		for _ = 1, 12 do
			if not inst or inst == workspace or inst == game then break end
			if inst:IsA("Tool") or inst:IsA("Humanoid") or inst:IsA("AnimationController") or inst:IsA("WorldModel") then
				return true
			end
			if inst:IsA("Model") then
				if inst:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					or inst:FindFirstChildOfClass("AnimationController")
					or inst:FindFirstChildOfClass("WorldModel") then
					return true
				end
			end
			local n = string.lower(inst.Name)
			if string.find(n, "viewmodel", 1, true)
				or string.find(n, "weapon", 1, true)
				or string.find(n, "gun", 1, true)
				or string.find(n, "rifle", 1, true)
				or string.find(n, "pistol", 1, true)
				or string.find(n, "knife", 1, true)
				or string.find(n, "melee", 1, true)
				or string.find(n, "arms", 1, true)
				or string.find(n, "firstperson", 1, true)
				or string.find(n, "fp_", 1, true)
				or string.find(n, "clientview", 1, true)
				or string.find(n, "helditem", 1, true)
				or string.find(n, "firearm", 1, true)
				or n == "item" then
				return true
			end
			inst = inst.Parent
		end
		return false
	end

	local function restoreOneDark(part)
		local rec = darkSaved[part]
		if not rec then return end
		pcall(function()
			if part and part.Parent then
				part.Color = rec.Color
				part.Material = rec.Material
				part.Reflectance = rec.Reflectance
				if rec.TextureID ~= nil and part:IsA("MeshPart") then
					part.TextureID = rec.TextureID
				end
			end
		end)
		darkSaved[part] = nil
	end

	local function restoreOneNoTex(part)
		local rec = noTexSaved[part]
		if not rec then return end
		pcall(function()
			if part and part.Parent then
				part.Color = rec.Color
				part.Material = rec.Material
				part.Reflectance = rec.Reflectance
				if rec.TextureID ~= nil and part:IsA("MeshPart") then
					part.TextureID = rec.TextureID
				end
				for _, k in ipairs(rec.Kids or {}) do
					local inst = k.Inst
					if not inst then continue end
					if k.Kind == "SA" and k.Parent then
						inst.Parent = k.Parent
					elseif k.Kind == "Decal" and inst.Parent then
						inst.Transparency = k.Transparency or 0
					elseif k.Kind == "Mesh" then
						pcall(function() inst.TextureId = k.TextureId or "" end)
					end
				end
			end
		end)
		noTexSaved[part] = nil
	end

	local function isCharPart(obj)
		return shouldSkipWorldFx(obj)
	end

	-- solo armas / jugadores / viewmodels reales (NO paredes cercanas)
	local function isWeaponOrCharacter(obj)
		if not obj then return true end
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if cam and obj:IsDescendantOf(cam) then
			return true
		end
		for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if plr.Character and obj:IsDescendantOf(plr.Character) then
				return true
			end
		end
		local inst = obj
		for _ = 1, 10 do
			if not inst or inst == workspace or inst == game then break end
			if inst:IsA("Tool") or inst:IsA("Humanoid") then
				return true
			end
			if inst:IsA("AnimationController") or inst:IsA("WorldModel") then
				return true
			end
			if inst:IsA("Model") and inst:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
				return true
			end
			local n = string.lower(inst.Name)
			if string.find(n, "viewmodel", 1, true)
				or string.find(n, "clientview", 1, true)
				or string.find(n, "firstperson", 1, true)
				or string.find(n, "fp_", 1, true) then
				return true
			end
			inst = inst.Parent
		end
		return false
	end

	local function captureDark(part)
		if darkSaved[part] then return end
		darkSaved[part] = {
			Color = part.Color,
			Material = part.Material,
			Reflectance = part.Reflectance,
			TextureID = part:IsA("MeshPart") and part.TextureID or nil,
		}
	end

	local function restoreDark()
		for part, rec in pairs(darkSaved) do
			if part and part.Parent then
				pcall(function()
					part.Color = rec.Color
					part.Material = rec.Material
					part.Reflectance = rec.Reflectance
					if rec.TextureID ~= nil and part:IsA("MeshPart") then
						part.TextureID = rec.TextureID
					end
				end)
			end
		end
		table.clear(darkSaved)
		darkApplied = false
		pcall(function()
			if darkCC then darkCC:Destroy() end
			darkCC = nil
			local leftover = Lighting:FindFirstChild("ShakoDarkTextures")
			if leftover then leftover:Destroy() end
		end)
	end

	local darkCursor = 1
	local darkCache = {}
	local darkLastCache = 0

	local function rebuildDarkCache()
		darkCache = {}
		for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("BasePart") and not isWeaponOrCharacter(d) then
				darkCache[#darkCache + 1] = d
			end
		end
		darkLastCache = os.clock()
		darkCursor = 1
	end

	-- sin ColorCorrection global: no tiñe armas / jugadores / NPCs
	local function ensureDarkCC(on)
		pcall(function()
			if darkCC then darkCC:Destroy() end
			darkCC = nil
			local leftover = Lighting:FindFirstChild("ShakoDarkTextures")
			if leftover then leftover:Destroy() end
		end)
	end

	local function applyDarkToPart(part)
		if not part or not part.Parent then return end
		if isWeaponOrCharacter(part) then
			restoreOneDark(part)
			return
		end
		if part.Transparency >= 0.99 then return end
		if not part:IsA("BasePart") then return end
		captureDark(part)
		pcall(function()
			local rec = darkSaved[part]
			local base = (rec and rec.Color) or part.Color
			local f = 0.40
			part.Color = Color3.new(
				math.clamp(base.R * f, 0, 1),
				math.clamp(base.G * f, 0, 1),
				math.clamp(base.B * f, 0, 1)
			)
		end)
	end

	local function stepDark(batch)
		ensureDarkCC(true)
		if os.clock() - darkLastCache > 1.25 or #darkCache == 0 then
			rebuildDarkCache()
		end
		local n = #darkCache
		if n == 0 then return end
		local processed = 0
		while processed < batch and n > 0 do
			if darkCursor > n then darkCursor = 1 end
			local part = darkCache[darkCursor]
			darkCursor += 1
			processed += 1
			applyDarkToPart(part)
		end
		darkApplied = true
	end

	local function captureNoTex(part)
		if noTexSaved[part] then return end
		local kids = {}
		for _, ch in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
			if ch:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
				kids[#kids + 1] = { Kind = "SA", Inst = ch, Parent = part }
			elseif ch:IsA("Decal") or ch:IsA("Texture") then
				kids[#kids + 1] = { Kind = "Decal", Inst = ch, Transparency = ch.Transparency }
			elseif ch:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
				local tid = ""
				pcall(function() tid = ch.TextureId end)
				kids[#kids + 1] = { Kind = "Mesh", Inst = ch, TextureId = tid }
			end
		end
		noTexSaved[part] = {
			Color = part.Color,
			Material = part.Material,
			Reflectance = part.Reflectance,
			TextureID = part:IsA("MeshPart") and part.TextureID or nil,
			Kids = kids,
		}
	end

	local function applyNoTexRestore(part, rec)
		if not part or not part.Parent or not rec then return end
		pcall(function()
			part.Color = rec.Color
			part.Material = rec.Material
			part.Reflectance = rec.Reflectance
			if rec.TextureID ~= nil and part:IsA("MeshPart") then
				part.TextureID = rec.TextureID
			end
			for _, k in ipairs(rec.Kids or {}) do
				local inst = k.Inst
				if not inst then continue end
				if k.Kind == "SA" then
					if k.Parent and inst.Parent ~= k.Parent then
						inst.Parent = k.Parent
					end
				elseif k.Kind == "Decal" then
					if inst.Parent then
						inst.Transparency = k.Transparency or 0
					end
				elseif k.Kind == "Mesh" then
					pcall(function() inst.TextureId = k.TextureId or "" end)
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	local function restoreNoTex()
		for part, rec in pairs(noTexSaved) do
			applyNoTexRestore(part, rec)
		end
		table.clear(noTexSaved)
		noTexApplied = false
		noTexCache = {}
		noTexCursor = 1
		noTexLastCache = 0
	end

	local function rebuildNoTexCache()
		noTexCache = {}
		for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("BasePart") and not shouldSkipWorldFx(d) then
				noTexCache[#noTexCache + 1] = d
			end
		end
		noTexLastCache = os.clock()
		noTexCursor = 1
	end

	local function stepNoTex(batch)
		if os.clock() - noTexLastCache > 4 or #noTexCache == 0 then
			rebuildNoTexCache()
		end
		local n = #noTexCache
		if n == 0 then return end
		local processed = 0
		while processed < batch and n > 0 do
			if noTexCursor > n then noTexCursor = 1 end
			local part = noTexCache[noTexCursor]
			noTexCursor += 1
			processed += 1
			if not part or not part.Parent then continue end
			if shouldSkipWorldFx(part) then
				local rec = noTexSaved[part]
				if rec then
					applyNoTexRestore(part, rec)
					noTexSaved[part] = nil
				end
				continue
			end
			if part.Transparency >= 0.99 then continue end
			captureNoTex(part)
			pcall(function()
				if part:IsA("MeshPart") then
					part.TextureID = ""
				end
				for _, ch in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
					if ch:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
						ch.Parent = nil
					elseif ch:IsA("Decal") or ch:IsA("Texture") then
						ch.Transparency = 1
					elseif ch:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
						pcall(function() ch.TextureId = "" end)
					end
				end
				part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
				part.Reflectance = 0
				if noTexSaved[part] and noTexSaved[part].Color then
					part.Color = noTexSaved[part].Color
				end
			end)
		end
		noTexApplied = true
	end


	-- partes nuevas (streaming): oscurecer al instante si Dark esta on
	workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
		if not obj:IsA("BasePart") then return end
		task.defer(function()
			local c = cfg()
			if not c or not c.DarkTextures then return end
			applyDarkToPart(obj)
			if c.NoTextures then
				-- no-tex se aplica en el loop; solo dark aqui
			end
		end)
	end)

	local BATCH = 40
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local c = cfg()
		if not c then return end

		if c.PotatoGraphics then
			applyPotato(true)
		elseif potatoApplied then
			applyPotato(false)
		end

		-- Dark Textures / No Texture ELIMINADOS (generaban lag masivo al escanear el mapa)
		if noTexApplied then pcall(restoreNoTex) end
		if darkApplied then pcall(restoreDark) end

		if not c.ShowInvisible then
			if next(revealed) then restoreAllMap() end
			return
		end

		-- refrescar cache cada 3s (mapa dinámico)
		if os.clock() - lastCache > 6 or #cachedParts == 0 then
			rebuildCache()
		end

		local color = typeof(c.InvisibleColor) == "Color3" and c.InvisibleColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 255)
		local tint = c.TintInvisible ~= false -- default tint so se noten

		local n = #cachedParts
		if n == 0 then return end
		local processed = 0
		while processed < BATCH and n > 0 do
			if scanCursor > n then scanCursor = 1 end
			local part = cachedParts[scanCursor]
			scanCursor += 1
			processed += 1
			if not part or not part.Parent then continue end
			if isCharacterDescendant(part) then continue end

			local t = part.Transparency
			local ltm = 0
			pcall(function() ltm = part.LocalTransparencyModifier end)

			-- parte "invisible" del mapa: muy transparente o LocalTransparency alto
			if t >= 0.85 or ltm >= 0.7 then
				if not revealed[part] then
					revealed[part] = {
						Transparency = t,
						LocalTransparencyModifier = ltm,
						Color = part.Color,
					}
				end
				pcall(function()
					part.Transparency = 0.35 -- visible pero semi
					if ltm > 0 then part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0 end
					if tint then
						part.Color = color
					end
				end)
			end
		end
	end)

	-- cleanup on character / place
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function() end)
	
end


-- ============================================================
-- SHK Ambience free-style (sin mute)
-- ============================================================
do
	local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

	local function getData()
		local ok, d = pcall(function() return tbl17.bG().Data end)
		if ok then return d end
		return nil
	end

	local PRESETS = {
		["Soft Rain"] = "https://github.com/kiciahook-org/v3-assets/raw/refs/heads/main/soft-rain.ogg",
		["Light Rain"] = "https://github.com/kiciahook-org/v3-assets/raw/refs/heads/main/light-rain.ogg",
		["Heavy Rain"] = "rbxassetid://169380148",
		["Forest"] = "rbxassetid://1840021608",
		["Wind"] = "rbxassetid://9112829155",
		["Night"] = "rbxassetid://1837828763",
		["Ocean"] = "rbxassetid://9112834338",
		["Campfire"] = "rbxassetid://5987864349",
		["City"] = "rbxassetid://1842610496",
		["Cave"] = "rbxassetid://9112840124",
	}

	local ambSound = nil
	local ambKey = nil
	local ambLoading = false
	local assetCache = {}

	local function stopAmbience()
		if ambSound then
			pcall(function() ambSound:Stop() end)
			pcall(function() ambSound:Destroy() end)
			ambSound = nil
		end
		ambKey = nil
	end

	local function ensureFolder(path)
		if isfolder and isfolder(path) then return true end
		if makefolder then
			pcall(makefolder, path)
			return true
		end
		return false
	end

	local function loadRemoteSound(url)
		if assetCache[url] then return assetCache[url] end
		if type(url) ~= "string" then return nil end
		if url:find("rbxassetid://", 1, true) then
			assetCache[url] = url
			return url
		end
		if url:match("^%d+$") then
			local id = "rbxassetid://" .. url
			assetCache[url] = id
			return id
		end
		if url:find("http", 1, true) then
			if not (writefile and isfile and getcustomasset) then
				return nil
			end
			ensureFolder("shako.win Premium")
			ensureFolder("shako.win Premium/cache")
			local tail = url:match("([^/]+)$") or "ambience.ogg"
			tail = tail:gsub("[^%w%.%-_]", "_")
			local filePath = "shako.win Premium/cache/" .. tail
			if not isfile(filePath) then
				local ok, data = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(url) end)
				if not ok or not data or #tostring(data) < 100 then
					return nil
				end
				if not pcall(writefile, filePath, data) then
					return nil
				end
			end
			local ok2, asset = pcall(getcustomasset, filePath)
			if ok2 and asset then
				assetCache[url] = asset
				return asset
			end
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function resolveSource(amb)
		if not amb or amb.Enabled ~= true then return nil end
		local custom = amb.CustomSound
		if type(custom) == "string" and custom:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
			custom = custom:gsub("%s+", "")
			if custom:find("rbxassetid://", 1, true) or custom:find("http", 1, true) then
				return custom
			end
			local num = custom:match("%d+")
			if num then return "rbxassetid://" .. num end
			return custom
		end
		local preset = amb.Sound
		if type(preset) == "string" and preset ~= "" and PRESETS[preset] then
			return PRESETS[preset]
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function playAmbience(soundId, volume)
		if not ambSound or not ambSound.Parent then
			ambSound = Instance.new("Sound")
			ambSound.Name = "ShakoAmbience"
			ambSound.Looped = true
			ambSound.Parent = SoundService
			pcall(function()
				ambSound:SetAttribute("ShakoFeedback", true)
				ambSound:SetAttribute("ShakoSound", true)
			end)
		end
		ambSound.Volume = math.clamp(tonumber(volume) or 1, 0, 10)
		if ambSound.SoundId ~= soundId then
			ambSound.SoundId = soundId
		end
		if not ambSound.IsPlaying then
			pcall(function() ambSound:Play() end)
		end
	end

	local function syncAmbience()
		local data = getData()
		local amb = data and data.Ambience
		local src = resolveSource(amb)
		if not src then
			stopAmbience()
			return
		end
		local vol = amb and amb.Volume or 1
		if ambSound and ambSound.Parent then
			ambSound.Volume = math.clamp(tonumber(vol) or 1, 0, 10)
		end
		local key = tostring(src) .. "|" .. tostring(vol)
		if ambKey == key and ambSound and ambSound.IsPlaying then
			return
		end
		if ambLoading then return end
		ambLoading = true
		task.spawn(function()
			local id = loadRemoteSound(src)
			ambLoading = false
			if not id then
				return
			end
			local data2 = getData()
			local amb2 = data2 and data2.Ambience
			if not amb2 or amb2.Enabled ~= true then
				stopAmbience()
				return
			end
			ambKey = tostring(src) .. "|" .. tostring(amb2.Volume or 1)
			playAmbience(id, amb2.Volume)
		end)
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(0.45)
			pcall(syncAmbience)
		end
	end)

	task.defer(function()
		syncAmbience()
	end)

end

-- ============================================================
-- SHK World Force · aplica Lighting/Sky/Fog/CC directo (bypass guard roto)
-- Las opciones del panel World vuelven a funcionar de verdad.
-- ============================================================
do
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

	local function data()
		local ok, d = pcall(function() return tbl17.bG().Data end)
		return ok and d or nil
	end

	local function ensureChild(className, name)
		local x = Lighting:FindFirstChild(name)
		if x and x.ClassName == className then return x end
		if x then pcall(function() x:Destroy() end) end
		local n = Instance.new(className)
		n.Name = name
		n.Parent = Lighting
		return n
	end

	local function clearChild(name)
		local x = Lighting:FindFirstChild(name)
		if x then pcall(function() x:Destroy() end) end
	end

	-- Presets sky comunes (ids usados en shako free / rivals)
	local SKY_PRESETS = {
		["Dark Sky"] = {
			SkyboxBk = "rbxassetid://570555736",
			SkyboxDn = "rbxassetid://570555964",
			SkyboxFt = "rbxassetid://570555800",
			SkyboxLf = "rbxassetid://570555840",
			SkyboxRt = "rbxassetid://570555882",
			SkyboxUp = "rbxassetid://570555929",
		},
		["Clouds"] = {
			SkyboxBk = "rbxassetid://570557514",
			SkyboxDn = "rbxassetid://570557775",
			SkyboxFt = "rbxassetid://570557559",
			SkyboxLf = "rbxassetid://570557620",
			SkyboxRt = "rbxassetid://570557672",
			SkyboxUp = "rbxassetid://570557727",
		},
		["Nebula"] = {
			SkyboxBk = "rbxassetid://159454299",
			SkyboxDn = "rbxassetid://159454296",
			SkyboxFt = "rbxassetid://159454293",
			SkyboxLf = "rbxassetid://159454286",
			SkyboxRt = "rbxassetid://159454300",
			SkyboxUp = "rbxassetid://159454288",
		},
		["Twilight"] = {
			SkyboxBk = "rbxassetid://264908339",
			SkyboxDn = "rbxassetid://264907909",
			SkyboxFt = "rbxassetid://264909420",
			SkyboxLf = "rbxassetid://264909758",
			SkyboxRt = "rbxassetid://264908886",
			SkyboxUp = "rbxassetid://264907379",
		},
		["Vaporwave"] = {
			SkyboxBk = "rbxassetid://1417494030",
			SkyboxDn = "rbxassetid://1417494146",
			SkyboxFt = "rbxassetid://1417494253",
			SkyboxLf = "rbxassetid://1417494402",
			SkyboxRt = "rbxassetid://1417494499",
			SkyboxUp = "rbxassetid://1417494643",
		},
	}

	local lastSky = nil
	local lastApply = 0

	local function applyLighting(L)
		if not L or not L.Enabled then return end
		pcall(function()
			if L.ClockTime and L.ClockTime.Enabled then
				Lighting.ClockTime = tonumber(L.ClockTime.Value) or Lighting.ClockTime
			end
			if L.Brightness and L.Brightness.Enabled then
				Lighting.Brightness = tonumber(L.Brightness.Value) or Lighting.Brightness
			end
			if L.GeographicLatitude and L.GeographicLatitude.Enabled then
				Lighting.GeographicLatitude = tonumber(L.GeographicLatitude.Value) or Lighting.GeographicLatitude
			end
			if L.ExposureCompensation and L.ExposureCompensation.Enabled then
				Lighting.ExposureCompensation = tonumber(L.ExposureCompensation.Value) or 0
			end
			if L.EnvironmentDiffuseScale and L.EnvironmentDiffuseScale.Enabled then
				Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = tonumber(L.EnvironmentDiffuseScale.Value) or 0
			end
			if L.EnvironmentSpecularScale and L.EnvironmentSpecularScale.Enabled then
				Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = tonumber(L.EnvironmentSpecularScale.Value) or 0
			end
			if L.DisableGlobalShadows == true then
				Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
			end
			if L.ShadowSoftness and L.ShadowSoftness.Enabled then
				pcall(function() Lighting.ShadowSoftness = tonumber(L.ShadowSoftness.Value) or 0.5 end)
			end
			if L.Ambient and L.Ambient.Enabled then
				if typeof(L.Ambient.Indoor) == "Color3" then Lighting.Ambient = L.Ambient.Indoor end
				if typeof(L.Ambient.Outdoor) == "Color3" then Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = L.Ambient.Outdoor end
			end
			if L.ColorShift and L.ColorShift.Enabled then
				if typeof(L.ColorShift.Top) == "Color3" then Lighting.ColorShift_Top = L.ColorShift.Top end
				if typeof(L.ColorShift.Bottom) == "Color3" then Lighting.ColorShift_Bottom = L.ColorShift.Bottom end
			end
			if L.Fog and L.Fog.Enabled then
				if typeof(L.Fog.Color) == "Color3" then Lighting.FogColor = L.Fog.Color end
				Lighting.FogStart = tonumber(L.Fog.Start) or 0
				Lighting.FogEnd = tonumber(L.Fog.End) or 100000
			end
		end)
	end

	local function applySkybox(S)
		if not S or not S.Enabled then
			if lastSky then
				-- no auto-destroy (juego puede tener su sky); solo marcar
				lastSky = nil
			end
			return
		end
		local preset = tostring(S.Preset or "")
		local ids = SKY_PRESETS[preset]
		if not ids then return end
		if lastSky == preset then return end
		lastSky = preset
		pcall(function()
			local sky = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky")
			if not sky then
				sky = Instance.new("Sky")
				sky.Name = "ShakoSky"
				sky.Parent = Lighting
			end
			for k, v in pairs(ids) do
				pcall(function() sky[k] = v end)
			end
		end)
	end

	local function applyAtmosphere(A)
		if not A or not A.Enabled then
			clearChild("ShakoAtmosphere")
			return
		end
		pcall(function()
			local at = ensureChild("Atmosphere", "ShakoAtmosphere")
			if typeof(A.Color) == "Color3" then at.Color = A.Color end
			if typeof(A.Decay) == "Color3" then at.Decay = A.Decay end
			at.Density = tonumber(A.Density) or at.Density
			at.Offset = tonumber(A.Offset) or at.Offset
			at.Glare = tonumber(A.Glare) or at.Glare
			at.Haze = tonumber(A.Haze) or at.Haze
		end)
	end

	local function applyBloom(B)
		if not B or not B.Enabled then
			clearChild("ShakoBloom")
			return
		end
		pcall(function()
			local b = ensureChild("BloomEffect", "ShakoBloom")
			b.Enabled = true
			b.Intensity = tonumber(B.Intensity) or 0.4
			b.Size = tonumber(B.Size) or 24
			b.Threshold = tonumber(B.Threshold) or 0.95
		end)
	end

	local function applyCC(C)
		if not C or not C.Enabled then
			clearChild("ShakoColorCorrection")
			return
		end
		pcall(function()
			local cc = ensureChild("ColorCorrectionEffect", "ShakoColorCorrection")
			cc.Enabled = true
			if typeof(C.TintColor) == "Color3" then cc.TintColor = C.TintColor end
			cc.Saturation = tonumber(C.Saturation) or 0
			cc.Brightness = tonumber(C.Brightness) or 0
			cc.Contrast = tonumber(C.Contrast) or 0
		end)
	end

	local function applySunRays(R)
		if not R or not R.Enabled then
			clearChild("ShakoSunRays")
			return
		end
		pcall(function()
			local r = ensureChild("SunRaysEffect", "ShakoSunRays")
			r.Enabled = true
			r.Intensity = tonumber(R.Intensity) or 0.25
			r.Spread = tonumber(R.Spread) or 1
		end)
	end

	local function applyDOF(D)
		if not D or not D.Enabled then
			clearChild("ShakoDOF")
			return
		end
		pcall(function()
			local d = ensureChild("DepthOfFieldEffect", "ShakoDOF")
			d.Enabled = true
			d.FarIntensity = tonumber(D.FarIntensity) or 0.75
			d.FocusDistance = tonumber(D.FocusDistance) or 0.05
			d.InFocusRadius = tonumber(D.InFocusRadius) or 10
			d.NearIntensity = tonumber(D.NearIntensity) or 0.75
		end)
	end

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - lastApply < 0.15 then return end -- no spam, suficiente para UI
		lastApply = now
		local d = data()
		if not d then return end
		-- Lighting master toggle
		applyLighting(d.Lighting)
		applySkybox(d.Skybox)
		applyAtmosphere(d.Atmosphere)
		applyBloom(d.Bloom)
		applyCC(d.ColorCorrection)
		applySunRays(d.SunRays)
		applyDOF(d.DepthOfField)
	end)

end



-- ============================================================
-- SHK Underground Counter · lado A / lado B + acostado + fire
-- ============================================================
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

	local side = 1 -- 1 = A (right), -1 = B (left)
	local lastSwitch = 0
	local lastFire = 0
	local utilMod, enumMod, fighterMod

	local function cfg()
		-- UG Counter removed from UI
		return nil
	end

	local function isOn(c)
		if not c or not c.Enabled then return false end
		local kb = c.Keybind
		if type(kb) == "table" then
			-- Always / Toggle / Hold: State lo maneja la UI
			if kb.State == false and kb.Kind ~= "Always" then
				-- Always ignora state a veces; si Kind Always y Enabled, on
				if kb.Kind == "Always" then return true end
				return false
			end
			if kb.Kind == "Always" then return true end
			return kb.State == true
		end
		return true
	end

	local function sameTeam(plr)
		if not plr or not LocalPlayer or plr == LocalPlayer then return true end
		-- Rivals: TeamID en el Player (lo que usa el juego para IsEnemy)
		local ok1, myTeam = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("TeamID") end)
		local ok2, theirTeam = pcall(function() return plr:GetAttribute("TeamID") end)
		if ok1 and ok2 and myTeam ~= nil and theirTeam ~= nil then
			if myTeam == theirTeam then return true end
			-- TeamIDs distintos = enemigo seguro
			return false
		end
		-- Character TeamID fallback
		local mc, oc = LocalPlayer.Character, plr.Character
		if mc and oc then
			local ok3, a = pcall(function() return mc:GetAttribute("TeamID") end)
			local ok4, b = pcall(function() return oc:GetAttribute("TeamID") end)
			if ok3 and ok4 and a ~= nil and b ~= nil then
				return a == b
			end
		end
		-- Roblox Team
		if LocalPlayer.Team ~= nil and plr.Team ~= nil then
			return LocalPlayer.Team == plr.Team
		end
		if LocalPlayer.TeamColor and plr.TeamColor and LocalPlayer.Team and plr.Team then
			if LocalPlayer.TeamColor == plr.TeamColor then return true end
		end
		for _, name in ipairs({ "Team", "TeamName", "Side", "Faction", "Squad", "PartyId" }) do
			local oa, a = pcall(function() return plr:GetAttribute(name) end)
			local ob, b = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute(name) end)
			if oa and ob and a ~= nil and b ~= nil and a ~= "" and a == b then return true end
		end
		return false
	end

	local function sameMatch(plr)
		-- Solo pelear en el mismo EnvironmentID (misma partida)
		local ok1, myEnv = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID") end)
		local ok2, theirEnv = pcall(function() return plr:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID") end)
		if ok1 and ok2 and myEnv ~= nil and theirEnv ~= nil and myEnv ~= theirEnv then
			return false
		end
		return true
	end
	local function loadMods()
		if utilMod and enumMod and fighterMod then return true end
		pcall(function()
			utilMod = require(RS.Modules.Utility)
			enumMod = require(RS.Modules.EnumLibrary)
			fighterMod = require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController)
		end)
		return utilMod and enumMod and fighterMod
	end

	local function getTarget()
		local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
		local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not myRoot then return nil, nil, nil end
		local c = cfg()
		local teamCheck = not c or c.TeamCheck ~= false
		local best, bestHead, bestRoot, bestD = nil, nil, nil, math.huge
		for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
				if not sameMatch(p) then continue end
				if teamCheck and sameTeam(p) then continue end
				local hum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local head = p.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
				local root = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if hum and hum.Health > 0 and head and root then
					local d = (myRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
					if d < bestD then
						bestD, best, bestHead, bestRoot = d, p, head, root
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return best, bestHead, bestRoot
	end

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local c = cfg()
		if not isOn(c) then return end

		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not hrp then return end

		local _, head, tRoot = getTarget()
		if not head or not tRoot then return end

		local sideDist = tonumber(c.SideDistance) or 10
		local switchRate = tonumber(c.SwitchRate) or 0.12
		local depth = tonumber(c.Depth) or 2
		local pitchDeg = tonumber(c.Pitch) or 90
		local fireRate = tonumber(c.FireRate) or 0.05

		local now = os.clock()
		if now - lastSwitch >= switchRate then
			lastSwitch = now
			side = -side
		end

		-- Posición: al lado del enemigo (RightVector) + un poco abajo (depth)
		local cf = tRoot.CFrame
		local right = cf.RightVector
		local pos = tRoot.Position + right * (sideDist * side) + Vector3.new(0, -depth, 0)

		-- Mirar a la cabeza estando acostado (pitch)
		local lookFlat = Vector3.new(head.Position.X - pos.X, 0, head.Position.Z - pos.Z)
		local yaw = 0
		if lookFlat.Magnitude > 0.05 then
			lookFlat = lookFlat.Unit
			yaw = math.atan2(-lookFlat.X, -lookFlat.Z)
		end
		local pitch = math.rad(pitchDeg)

		-- Noclip breve para no trabar bajo suelo / paredes
		pcall(function()
			for _, p in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
				if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CanCollide = false end
			end
		end)

		hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(pitch, 0, 0)
		hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

		-- Disparo a la cabeza
		if now - lastFire < fireRate then return end
		if not loadMods() then return end
		local fc = fighterMod
		if not fc or not fc.LocalFighter then return end
		local item = fc.LocalFighter.EquippedItem
		if not item then return end
		local oid
		pcall(function() oid = item:Get("ObjectID") end)
		if not oid then return end
		local rem = RS:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
		rem = rem and rem:FindFirstChild("Replication")
		rem = rem and rem:FindFirstChild("Fighter")
		rem = rem and rem:FindFirstChild("UseItem")
		if not rem then return end

		local origin = pos
		local aimCF = CFrame.lookAt(origin, head.Position)
		local cameradata = {}
		local okBuild = pcall(function()
			cameradata[utf8.char(1)] = {
				[utf8.char(0)] = utilMod:EncodeCFrame(aimCF),
				[utf8.char(1)] = utilMod:EncodeCFrame(head.CFrame),
				[utf8.char(2)] = head,
				[utf8.char(3)] = utilMod:EncodeCFrame(head.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(CFrame.new(head.Position))),
			}
		end)
		if not okBuild then return end
		lastFire = now
		pcall(function()
			rem:FireServer(oid, enumMod:ToEnum("StartShooting"), cameradata, nil)
		end)
	end)

end


-- ============================================================
-- SHK Target Hub · Sleepy UI mejorado (slots grandes, HP bonita, rank icons)
-- ============================================================
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

	local gui, frame, nameLbl, statsRow
	local hpFill, hpGlow, hpVal
	local ratioFill, ratioTakenFill, ratioVal
	local rankImg, rankLbl, levelLbl, streakLbl, deviceImg, deviceLbl, metaLbl
	local weaponSlots = {}
		local weaponSlotStrokes = {}
	local hubScale = nil
	local HUB_BASE_W, HUB_BASE_H = 530, 168
	local itemLibCache = nil
	local damageDealt, damageTaken = 0, 0
	local lastMyHP, lastEnemyHP = nil, nil
	local currentTarget = nil

	-- Rank icons (Rivals-style map; fallback text si no hay id)
	local RANK_ICONS = {
		["Unranked"] = "rbxassetid://7733715400",
		["Bronze"] = "rbxassetid://7733715400",
		["Silver"] = "rbxassetid://7733716798",
		["Gold"] = "rbxassetid://7733717224",
		["Platinum"] = "rbxassetid://7733919094",
		["Diamond"] = "rbxassetid://7733919439",
		["Emerald"] = "rbxassetid://7733919683",
		["Champion"] = "rbxassetid://7733920081",
		["Grand Champion"] = "rbxassetid://7733920336",
		["Unreal"] = "rbxassetid://7733920559",
		["Nemesis"] = "rbxassetid://7733920559",
		["Arch Nemesis"] = "rbxassetid://7733920559",
		["Archnemesis"] = "rbxassetid://7733920559",
	}

	local DEVICE_ICONS = {
		Computer = "rbxassetid://7734053495",
		MouseKeyboard = "rbxassetid://7734053495",
		PC = "rbxassetid://7734053495",
		Mobile = "rbxassetid://7734054641",
		Touch = "rbxassetid://7734054641",
		Console = "rbxassetid://7734055328",
		Gamepad = "rbxassetid://7734055328",
		VR = "rbxassetid://7734056031",
	}

	-- Cache de dispositivo por jugador (Rivals replica Controls en Fighter / attrs)
	local deviceCache = {} -- [Player] = "MouseKeyboard"|"Touch"|"Gamepad"|"VR"

	local function normalizeDevice(v)
		if v == nil then return nil end
		if typeof(v) == "EnumItem" then
			local n = v.Name
			if n:find("Touch") then return "Touch" end
			if n:find("Gamepad") then return "Gamepad" end
			if n:find("Mouse") or n:find("Keyboard") then return "MouseKeyboard" end
			v = n
		end
		local str = tostring(v)
		if str == "" then return nil end
		local low = str:lower()
		if str == "MouseKeyboard" or str == "Desktop" or str == "Computer" or str == "PC" or low == "keyboard" then
			return "MouseKeyboard"
		end
		if str == "Touch" or low:find("mobile") or low:find("phone") or low:find("tablet") then
			return "Touch"
		end
		if str == "Gamepad" or low:find("console") or low:find("xbox") or low:find("playstation") or low:find("gamepad") then
			return "Gamepad"
		end
		if str == "VR" or low:find("vr") then
			return "VR"
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function scanInstanceAttrs(inst)
		if not inst then return nil end
		local found = nil
		pcall(function()
			for name, val in pairs(inst:GetAttributes()) do
				local n = normalizeDevice(val)
				if n then found = n return end
			end
		end)
		return found
	end

	local function scanFighter(pl)
		local found = nil
		pcall(function()
			local ps = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
			if not ps then return end
			local ctrl = ps:FindFirstChild("Controllers")
			local mod = ctrl and ctrl:FindFirstChild("FighterController")
			if not mod then
				-- require path
			end
			local FC
			pcall(function()
				FC = require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController)
			end)
			if not FC then return end
			local fighter
			pcall(function() fighter = FC:GetFighter(pl) end)
			if not fighter then
				pcall(function()
					local map = FC.Fighters or FC._fighters or FC.fighters
					if type(map) == "table" then
						fighter = map[pl] or map[pl.UserId] or map[tostring(pl.UserId)]
					end
				end)
			end
			if not fighter then return end
			local keys = { "Controls", "CurrentControls", "ControlType", "InputType", "Device", "PreferredInput", "Platform", "ClientControls" }
			for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
				local val
				pcall(function()
					if type(fighter.Get) == "function" then
						val = fighter:Get(key)
					end
				end)
				if val == nil then pcall(function() val = fighter[key] end) end
				local n = normalizeDevice(val)
				if n then found = n return end
			end
			pcall(function()
				for k, v in pairs(fighter) do
					if type(k) == "string" and (k:lower():find("control") or k:lower():find("device") or k:lower():find("input")) then
						local n = normalizeDevice(v)
						if n then found = n return end
					end
					if type(v) == "string" then
						local n = normalizeDevice(v)
						if n then found = n return end
					end
				end
			end)
			-- nested Data / State
			pcall(function()
				local data = fighter.Data or fighter.State or fighter._data
				if type(data) == "table" then
					for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
						local n = normalizeDevice(data[key])
						if n then found = n return end
					end
				end
			end)
		end)
		return found
	end

	local function detectDevice(pl)
		if not pl then return nil end
		if deviceCache[pl] then return deviceCache[pl] end
		local d = scanInstanceAttrs(pl)
		if not d then d = scanInstanceAttrs(pl.Character) end
		if not d then d = scanFighter(pl) end
		if not d then
			pcall(function()
				for _, ch in ipairs(pl:GetChildren()) do
					if ch:IsA("StringValue") or ch:IsA("StringValue") then
						local n = normalizeDevice(ch.Value)
						if n then d = n return end
					end
					if ch:IsA("StringValue") or ch.ClassName == "StringValue" then
						local n = normalizeDevice(ch.Value)
						if n then d = n return end
					end
					-- folder values
					if ch:IsA("Folder") or ch:IsA("Configuration") then
						for _, v in ipairs(ch:GetChildren()) do
							if v:IsA("StringValue") then
								local n = normalizeDevice(v.Value)
								if n then d = n return end
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end)
		end
		if d then deviceCache[pl] = d end
		return d
	end

	local function watchDevice(pl)
		if not pl or pl == LocalPlayer then return end
		pcall(function()
			detectDevice(pl)
			pl.AttributeChanged:Connect(function()
				local d = scanInstanceAttrs(pl)
				if d then deviceCache[pl] = d end
			end)
			pl.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
				task.defer(function()
					local d = scanInstanceAttrs(char) or scanFighter(pl)
					if d then deviceCache[pl] = d end
					pcall(function()
						char.AttributeChanged:Connect(function()
							local dd = scanInstanceAttrs(char)
							if dd then deviceCache[pl] = dd end
						end)
					end)
				end)
			end)
		end)
	end

	for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		task.defer(watchDevice, pl)
	end

	local function isOn(c)
		if not c or not c.Enabled then return false end
		local kb = c.Keybind
		if type(kb) == "table" then
			if kb.Kind == "Always" then return true end
			return kb.State == true
		end
		return true
	end

	local function isTeammate(plr)
		if not plr or plr == LocalPlayer then return true end
		local ok1, a = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("TeamID") end)
		local ok2, b = pcall(function() return plr:GetAttribute("TeamID") end)
		if ok1 and ok2 and a ~= nil and b ~= nil then return a == b end
		if LocalPlayer.Team and plr.Team and LocalPlayer.Team == plr.Team then return true end
		return false
	end

		local ok1, a = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID") end)
		local ok2, b = pcall(function() return plr:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID") end)
		if ok1 and ok2 and a ~= nil and b ~= nil and a ~= b then return false end
		return true
