	-- Absense/Rivals: DisplayELO → rank name via SeasonLibrary.RankProfiles
	local function rankFromElo(elo, userId)
		local eloN = tonumber(elo)
		if eloN == nil then return nil end
		-- Función nativa del juego (SeasonLibrary) — distingue Nemesis / Archnemesis
		local ok, name = pcall(function()
			local fn = tbl17 and tbl17.cx and tbl17.cx()
			if type(fn) ~= "function" then return nil end
			-- signature: (userId, elo)
			return fn(userId or 0, eloN)
		end)
		if ok and type(name) == "string" and name ~= "" and name ~= "Unranked" then
			return name
		end
		-- Fallback manual por RanksOrder
		local sl = getSeasonLibrary()
		if not sl then
			pcall(function()
				if tbl17 and tbl17.aS then
					local ns = tbl17.aS()
					sl = ns and ns.SeasonLibrary
				end
			end)
		end
		if not sl then return nil end
		local ok2, name2 = pcall(function()
			local current = sl.CurrentSeason
			local profileName = current and current.RankProfile and (current.RankProfile.Name or current.RankProfile)
			local profiles = sl.RankProfiles
			local profile = profiles and profileName and profiles[profileName]
			if not profile and type(profiles) == "table" then
				for _, v in pairs(profiles) do
					if type(v) == "table" and v.Ranks then profile = v break end
				end
			end
			if not profile then return nil end
			local order = profile.RanksOrder
			local ranks = profile.Ranks
			if type(order) ~= "table" or type(ranks) ~= "table" then return nil end
			-- Misma lógica que el juego: si elo < RequiredELO → rank anterior
			local n = #order
			for i = 1, n do
				local rn = order[i]
				local rd = ranks[rn]
				if type(rd) == "table" then
					local need = tonumber(rd.RequiredELO or rd.RequiredElo)
					local lb = rd.RequiredELOLeaderboardRanking or rd.RequiredEloLeaderboardRanking
					if need ~= nil and eloN < need and lb == nil then
						return order[math.clamp(i - 1, 1, n)] or "Unranked"
					end
				end
			end
			-- Elegir el rank más alto cuyo RequiredELO <= elo
			local best = order[1] or "Unranked"
			for i = 1, n do
				local rn = order[i]
				local rd = ranks[rn]
				if type(rd) == "table" then
					local need = tonumber(rd.RequiredELO or rd.RequiredElo)
					-- ranks de leaderboard (Archnemesis) no se resuelven solo con ELO
					local lb = rd.RequiredELOLeaderboardRanking or rd.RequiredEloLeaderboardRanking
					if lb ~= nil then
						-- no asignar Archnemesis solo por ELO; dejar Nemesis/anterior
						break
					end
					if need ~= nil and eloN >= need then
						best = rn
					elseif need ~= nil and eloN < need then
						break
					end
				end
			end
			return best
		end)
		if ok2 and type(name2) == "string" and name2 ~= "" then return name2 end
		return nil
	end

	local function readPlayerStats(pl)
		local level, streak, rank, deviceRaw = "—", "—", "—", nil

		-- STREAK: StatisticDuelsWinStreak (Absense winstreak flag)
		pcall(function()
			local ws = pl:GetAttribute("StatisticDuelsWinStreak")
			if ws ~= nil then streak = tostring(ws) end
		end)

		-- LEVEL
		pcall(function()
			local lv = pl:GetAttribute("Level")
			if lv ~= nil then level = tostring(lv) end
		end)

		-- RANK: nombre real (Nemesis ≠ Archnemesis)
		pcall(function()
			local function isRankName(v)
				if v == nil then return false end
				local t = tostring(v)
				if t == "" or t == "—" then return false end
				if tonumber(t) ~= nil then return false end
				return true
			end
			local function normalizeRankName(v)
				local t = tostring(v):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
				local low = t:lower():gsub("[%s%-%_]+", "")
				-- Archnemesis ANTES que Nemesis (contiene "nemesis")
				if low == "archnemesis" or (low:find("arch", 1, true) and low:find("nemesis", 1, true)) then
					return "Archnemesis"
				end
				if low == "nemesis" then
					return "Nemesis"
				end
				if low == "grandchampion" then
					return "Grand Champion"
				end
				return t
			end
			local knownSet = {
				Unranked = true, Bronze = true, Silver = true, Gold = true, Platinum = true,
				Diamond = true, Emerald = true, Champion = true, ["Grand Champion"] = true,
				Unreal = true, Nemesis = true, Archnemesis = true,
			}

			local attrRank = nil
			local candidates = {
				pl:GetAttribute("RankName"),
				pl:GetAttribute("SeasonRankName"),
				pl:GetAttribute("DisplayRank"),
				pl:GetAttribute("Rank"),
			}
			for _, r in ipairs(candidates) do
				if isRankName(r) then
					attrRank = normalizeRankName(r)
					break
				end
			end

			-- Preferir atributo si es rank conocido (NO pisar Archnemesis con ELO → Nemesis)
			if attrRank and knownSet[attrRank] then
				rank = attrRank
				return
			end
			if attrRank then
				local low = attrRank:lower()
				if low == "nemesis" or low == "archnemesis" or (low:find("arch") and low:find("nemesis")) then
					rank = normalizeRankName(attrRank)
					return
				end
			end

			local elo = pl:GetAttribute("DisplayELO")
				or pl:GetAttribute("ELO")
				or pl:GetAttribute("Elo")
				or pl:GetAttribute("SeasonELO")
				or pl:GetAttribute("SeasonElo")
			if elo ~= nil then
				local fromElo = rankFromElo(elo, pl.UserId)
				if fromElo then
					rank = normalizeRankName(fromElo)
					return
				end
			end
			if attrRank then
				rank = attrRank
			end
		end)

		-- DEVICE desde cache / Fighter / attrs
		pcall(function()
			deviceRaw = deviceCache[pl] or detectDevice(pl)
		end)

		-- leaderstats fallback
		pcall(function()
			local ls = pl:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
			if not ls then return end
			if level == "—" and ls:FindFirstChild("Level") then level = tostring(ls.Level.Value) end
			if streak == "—" and ls:FindFirstChild("Streak") then streak = tostring(ls.Streak.Value) end
			if streak == "—" and ls:FindFirstChild("Winstreak") then streak = tostring(ls.Winstreak.Value) end
			if rank == "—" and ls:FindFirstChild("Rank") then rank = tostring(ls.Rank.Value) end
		end)

		-- Character attributes fallback
		pcall(function()
			local char = pl.Character
			if not char then return end
			if streak == "—" then
				local ws = char:GetAttribute("StatisticDuelsWinStreak") or char:GetAttribute("WinStreak")
				if ws ~= nil then streak = tostring(ws) end
			end
			if rank == "—" then
				local r = char:GetAttribute("Rank") or char:GetAttribute("RankName")
				if r then rank = tostring(r) end
			end
		end)

		return level, streak, rank, deviceRaw
	end

	local function getWeaponImage(weaponName)
		if not weaponName or weaponName == "" then return "" end
		local lib = getItemLibrary()
		if not lib or type(lib.Items) ~= "table" then return "" end
		local itm = lib.Items[weaponName]
		if type(itm) ~= "table" then
			for k, v in pairs(lib.Items) do
				if type(k) == "string" and k:lower() == weaponName:lower() and type(v) == "table" then
					itm = v
					break
				end
			end
		end
		if type(itm) ~= "table" then return "" end
		local img = itm.ImageHighResolution or itm.Image or itm.Icon or ""
		return type(img) == "string" and img or ""
	end

	local function toAsset(id)
		if id == nil or id == "" then return "" end
		if type(id) == "number" then return "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id) end
		if type(id) == "string" then
			if id:find("rbxassetid://", 1, true) or id:find("rbxasset://", 1, true) then return id end
			if tonumber(id) then return "rbxassetid://" .. id end
			return id
		end
		return ""
	end

	-- Imagen del rango del jugador (SeasonLibrary del juego, como target hub antiguo)
	local function resolveRankIcon(rankName)
		if not rankName or rankName == "" or rankName == "—" then return "" end
		local want = tostring(rankName)
		local wantLow = want:lower()

		local assetOut = ""
		pcall(function()
			local sl = getSeasonLibrary()
			if not sl and tbl17 and tbl17.aS then
				local ns = tbl17.aS()
				sl = ns and ns.SeasonLibrary
			end
			if not sl then return end
			local current = sl.CurrentSeason
			local profileName = current and current.RankProfile and (current.RankProfile.Name or current.RankProfile)
			local profiles = sl.RankProfiles
			local profile = profiles and profileName and profiles[profileName]
			if not profile and type(profiles) == "table" then
				for _, v in pairs(profiles) do
					if type(v) == "table" and v.Ranks then profile = v break end
				end
			end
			if not profile or type(profile.Ranks) ~= "table" then return end
			local ranks = profile.Ranks
			-- match exacto (Nemesis ≠ Archnemesis)
			local rd = ranks[want]
			if not rd then
				for k, v in pairs(ranks) do
					if type(k) == "string" and k:lower() == wantLow then
						rd = v
						break
					end
				end
			end
			if type(rd) == "table" then
				assetOut = toAsset(rd.Image or rd.Icon or rd.ImageId or rd.BadgeImage or rd.AssetId or rd.IconImage or rd.ImageAssetId)
			end
		end)
		if assetOut ~= "" then return assetOut end

		local normWant = want
		do
			local low = wantLow:gsub("[%s%-%_]+", "")
			if low == "archnemesis" or (low:find("arch", 1, true) and low:find("nemesis", 1, true)) then
				normWant = "Archnemesis"
			elseif low == "nemesis" then
				normWant = "Nemesis"
			end
		end
		if RANK_ICONS[normWant] then return RANK_ICONS[normWant] end
		if RANK_ICONS[want] then return RANK_ICONS[want] end
		local wantLowNorm = normWant:lower()
		for k, v in pairs(RANK_ICONS) do
			if k:lower() == wantLow or k:lower() == wantLowNorm then
				return v
			end
		end
		return ""
	end

	local function resolveDeviceIcon(dev)
		-- sin dato → "?" (NO forzar PC)
		if not dev or dev == "" or dev == "—" then
			return "", "?"
		end
		local str = tostring(dev)
		local low = str:lower()
		if low == "mousekeyboard" or low == "desktop" or low == "computer" or low == "pc" or low == "keyboard" then
			return DEVICE_ICONS.MouseKeyboard, "PC"
		end
		if low == "touch" or low:find("mobile") or low:find("phone") then
			return DEVICE_ICONS.Mobile, "Mobile"
		end
		if low == "gamepad" or low:find("console") or low:find("xbox") or low:find("playstation") then
			return DEVICE_ICONS.Console, "Console"
		end
		if low:find("vr") then
			return DEVICE_ICONS.VR, "VR"
		end
		if DEVICE_ICONS[str] then
			local label = str
			if str == "MouseKeyboard" then label = "PC"
			elseif str == "Touch" then label = "Mobile"
			elseif str == "Gamepad" then label = "Console"
			end
			return DEVICE_ICONS[str], label
		end
		return "", str
	end

	local function getEnemyWeapons(plr)
		local weps = { nil, nil, nil, nil }
		local equippedIndex = nil
		local function slotIndex(slot)
			if type(slot) == "number" then return (slot >= 1 and slot <= 4) and slot or nil end
			if type(slot) ~= "string" then return nil end
			local low = slot:lower()
			if low:find("primary", 1, true) then return 1 end
			if low:find("secondary", 1, true) then return 2 end
			if low:find("melee", 1, true) then return 3 end
			if low:find("utility", 1, true) or low:find("throwable", 1, true) then return 4 end
			return nil
		end
		pcall(function()
			local ps = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
			local c = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("Controllers")
			local m = c and c:FindFirstChild("FighterController")
			if not m then return end
			local fc = require(m)
			local fighter = nil
			if fc.GetFighter then fighter = fc:GetFighter(plr)
			elseif fc._player_to_fighter then fighter = fc._player_to_fighter[plr] end
			if not fighter then return end
			local items = fighter.Items or (fighter.GetItems and fighter:GetItems())
			if type(items) == "table" then
				for key, item in pairs(items) do
					if type(item) == "table" then
						local name = item.Name or item.ItemName
						local slot = item.Slot or item.Index or item.Category or item.Type or key
						local idx = slotIndex(slot)
						if not idx then
							for i = 1, 4 do if not weps[i] then idx = i break end end
						end
						if idx and idx >= 1 and idx <= 4 and type(name) == "string" then
							weps[idx] = name
						end
					end
				end
			end
			local eq = fighter.EquippedItem
			if eq then
				local n = eq.Name or eq.ItemName
				equippedIndex = slotIndex(eq.Slot or eq.Index or eq.Category or eq.Type)
				if type(n) == "string" then
					for i = 1, 4 do
						if weps[i] == n then equippedIndex = equippedIndex or i break end
					end
					if not equippedIndex and not weps[1] then weps[1] = n end
				end
			end
		end)
		pcall(function()
			local char = plr.Character
			if not char then return end
			local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
			if tool and tool.Name then
				for i = 1, 4 do
					if weps[i] == tool.Name then equippedIndex = equippedIndex or i break end
				end
				if not equippedIndex and not weps[1] then weps[1] = tool.Name equippedIndex = 1 end
			end
		end)
		return weps, equippedIndex
	end

	local function getClosestEnemy(maxDist, teamCheck)
		-- SIN límite de distancia (void / rage / desync no ocultan el hub)
		local function pack(plr)
			local ch = plr.Character
			if not ch then return nil end
			local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local root = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local head = ch:FindFirstChild("Head")
			if hum and hum.Health > 0 and (root or head) then
				return { plr = plr, hum = hum, root = root or head, dist = 0 }
			end
			return nil
		end

		-- sticky: mantener target aunque esté en void
		if currentTarget and currentTarget.Parent then
			if not (teamCheck and isTeammate(currentTarget)) and sameMatch(currentTarget) then
				local p = pack(currentTarget)
				if p then
					local origin = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
					local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if myRoot then origin = myRoot.Position end
					if origin and p.root then
						p.dist = (origin - p.root.Position).Magnitude
					end
					return p
				end
			end
		end

		local origin = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position or Vector3.zero
		local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if myRoot then origin = myRoot.Position end

		local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
		for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character and sameMatch(plr) then
				if teamCheck and isTeammate(plr) then continue end
				local p = pack(plr)
				if p and p.root then
					-- sin maxDist: void puede estar a 1e9+
					local d = (origin - p.root.Position).Magnitude
					p.dist = d
					if d < bestD then
						bestD = d
						best = p
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return best
	end

	local meowDistLbl = nil

	local function updateHud(target, c)
		ensureGui()
		if not frame then return end
		if not target then
			frame.Visible = false
			return
		end
		frame.Visible = true
		local scale = tonumber(c and c.Scale) or 1
		scale = math.clamp(scale, 0.55, 1.75)
		frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(HUB_BASE_W, HUB_BASE_H)
		if hubScale then
			hubScale.Scale = scale
		else
			local us = frame:FindFirstChild("HubUIScale")
			if us and us:IsA("UIScale") then
				hubScale = us
				hubScale.Scale = scale
			else
				frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(HUB_BASE_W * scale), math.floor(HUB_BASE_H * scale))
			end
		end
		-- Posición por offsets (se guarda en config, sin mouse)
		local ox = tonumber(c and c.OffsetX) or 0
		local oy = tonumber(c and c.OffsetY) or 120
		frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, ox, 0.5, oy)

		-- Square Scale = tamaño del cuadrito | Icon Scale = tamaño del icono del arma
		local sqScale = math.clamp(tonumber(c and c.SquareScale) or 1.0, 0.5, 1.1)
		local icScale = math.clamp(tonumber(c and c.IconScale) or 1, 0.5, 6)
		local pad = 14
		local gap = 12
		local base = 64
		local sz = math.clamp(math.floor(base * sqScale + 0.5), 48, 100)
		local posList = {
			UDim2.fromOffset(pad, 14),
			UDim2.fromOffset(pad, 90),
			UDim2.new(1, -(pad + sz), 0, 14),
			UDim2.new(1, -(pad + sz), 0, 90),
		}
		for i, img in pairs(weaponSlots) do
			if img and img.Parent then
				local box = img.Parent
				box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sz, sz)
				box.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 20)
				if posList[i] then
					box.Position = posList[i]
				end
				-- Icon Scale controla el tamaño del icono (puede ser más grande que el slot)
				local iconSz = math.clamp(math.floor(sz * icScale + 0.5), 16, 300)
				local inset = math.floor((sz - iconSz) / 2)
				img.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(inset, inset)
				img.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(iconSz, iconSz)
			end
		end

		local pl = target.plr
		local hum = target.hum
		nameLbl.Text = (c.ShowName ~= false) and (pl.DisplayName or pl.Name) or ""

		local level, streak, rank, deviceRaw = readPlayerStats(pl)

		-- Rango = la imagen (sustituye la tuerquita). Nombre solo si no hay icono.
		local rankText = (rank and tostring(rank) ~= "" and tostring(rank) ~= "—") and tostring(rank) or "Unranked"
		local rIcon = resolveRankIcon(rankText)
		rankImg.Visible = true
		if rIcon ~= "" then
			rankImg.Image = rIcon
			rankImg.ImageTransparency = 0
			rankLbl.Visible = false
			rankLbl.Text = ""
		else
			rankImg.Image = ""
			rankImg.ImageTransparency = 1
			rankLbl.Visible = true
			rankLbl.Text = rankText
		end
		rankImg.Visible = false
		rankLbl.Visible = false

		levelLbl.Text = "Lv " .. tostring(level)
		do
			local n = tonumber(streak) or streak
			if streak == "—" or streak == nil or streak == "" then
				streakLbl.Text = "x0"
			else
				streakLbl.Text = "x" .. tostring(n)
			end
		end

		local dIcon, dName = resolveDeviceIcon(deviceRaw)
		if metaLbl then
			local safeRank = rankText:gsub("[%c]", "")
			local safeDevice = tostring(dName or "?"):gsub("[%c]", "")
			metaLbl.Text = string.format("level: %s    rank: %s    device: %s    streak: %s", tostring(level), safeRank, safeDevice, tostring(streak == "—" and 0 or streak))
		end
		if dIcon ~= "" then
			deviceImg.Image = dIcon
			deviceImg.ImageTransparency = 0
			deviceImg.Visible = true
		else
			deviceImg.Image = ""
			deviceImg.ImageTransparency = 1
		end
		deviceLbl.Text = dName or "?"

		if c.ShowHealth ~= false and hum then
			local hp = math.max(0, hum.Health)
			local maxHp = math.max(1, hum.MaxHealth)
			local pct = math.clamp(hp / maxHp, 0, 1)
			hpFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(pct, 1)
			hpVal.Text = string.format("%d / %d", math.floor(hp), math.floor(maxHp))
			if pct > 0.55 then
				hpFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 210, 120)
				hpGlow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 255, 200)
			elseif pct > 0.28 then
				hpFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 175, 55)
				hpGlow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 150)
			else
				hpFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 70, 85)
				hpGlow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 170)
			end
		end

		local total = damageDealt + damageTaken
		if total > 0 then
			local dealtPct = math.clamp(damageDealt / total, 0, 1)
			local takenPct = math.clamp(damageTaken / total, 0, 1)
			ratioFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(dealtPct, 1)
			ratioTakenFill.Position = UDim2.fromScale(dealtPct, 0)
			ratioTakenFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(takenPct, 1)
		else
			ratioFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
			ratioTakenFill.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
			ratioTakenFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
		end
		ratioVal.Text = string.format(
			'<font color="#FFFFFF">%d ▲</font>  <font color="#C6535D">%d ▼</font>',
			math.floor(damageDealt), math.floor(damageTaken)
		)

		if meowDistLbl and c.ShowDistance ~= false then
			meowDistLbl.Text = string.format("%.0f studs", target.dist or 0)
		elseif meowDistLbl then
			meowDistLbl.Text = ""
		end

		local weps, equippedIndex = getEnemyWeapons(pl)
		for i = 1, 4 do
			local slotStroke = weaponSlotStrokes[i]
			if slotStroke then
				if equippedIndex == i then
					slotStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
					slotStroke.Thickness = 2.2
				else
					slotStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 68)
					slotStroke.Thickness = 1.2
				end
			end
			local img = weaponSlots[i]
			if img then
				local wName = weps[i]
				local asset = wName and getWeaponImage(wName) or ""
				if asset ~= "" then
					img.Image = asset
					img.ImageTransparency = 0
				else
					img.Image = ""
					img.ImageTransparency = 1
				end
			end
		end
	end

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local c = cfg()
		if not isOn(c) then
			if frame then frame.Visible = false end
			currentTarget = nil
			return
		end

		local teamCheck = c.TeamCheck ~= false
		local target = getClosestEnemy(math.huge, teamCheck) -- sin límite

		local myHum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if myHum then
			if lastMyHP ~= nil and myHum.Health < lastMyHP then
				damageTaken = damageTaken + (lastMyHP - myHum.Health)
			end
			lastMyHP = myHum.Health
		end
		if target and target.hum then
			if currentTarget ~= target.plr then
				currentTarget = target.plr
			end
			if lastEnemyHP ~= nil and target.hum.Health < lastEnemyHP then
				damageDealt = damageDealt + (lastEnemyHP - target.hum.Health)
			end
			lastEnemyHP = target.hum.Health
		else
			lastEnemyHP = nil
			currentTarget = nil
		end

		updateHud(target, c)
	end)

	if K and K.onUnload then
		K.onUnload(function()
			if gui then pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end) end
			gui = nil
			frame = nil
		end)
	end

end






-- ============================================================
-- SHK new.miny Counter · TP triángulo a velocidad supersónica
-- ============================================================
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

	local vertex = 1 -- 1,2,3
	local lastSwitch = 0

	local function cfg()
		local ok, data = pcall(function() return tbl17.bG().Data end)
		if not ok or not data or not data.Ragebot or not data.Ragebot.Evasion then return nil end
		return data.Ragebot.Evasion.NewMinyCounter
	end

	local function isOn(c)
		if not c or not c.Enabled then return false end
		local kb = c.Keybind
		if type(kb) == "table" then
			if kb.Kind == "Always" then return true end
			return kb.State == true
		end
		return true
	end

	local function isTeammate(plr)
		if not plr or plr == LocalPlayer then return true end
		local ok1, a = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("TeamID") end)
		local ok2, b = pcall(function() return plr:GetAttribute("TeamID") end)
		if ok1 and ok2 and a ~= nil and b ~= nil then return a == b end
		if LocalPlayer.Team and plr.Team and LocalPlayer.Team == plr.Team then return true end
		return false
	end

	local function sameMatch(plr)
		local ok1, a = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID") end)
		local ok2, b = pcall(function() return plr:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID") end)
		if ok1 and ok2 and a ~= nil and b ~= nil and a ~= b then return false end
		return true
	end

	local function getTarget(teamCheck)
		local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
		local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not myRoot then return nil end
		local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
		for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
				if not sameMatch(plr) then continue end
				if teamCheck and isTeammate(plr) then continue end
				local hum = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local root = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if hum and hum.Health > 0 and root then
					local d = (myRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
					if d < bestD then
						bestD, best = d, root
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return best
	end

	-- Vértices de un triángulo equilátero en XZ alrededor del target
	local function trianglePoint(center, size, index, height)
		-- index 1,2,3 → 0°, 120°, 240°
		local angle = math.rad((index - 1) * 120)
		local x = center.X + math.cos(angle) * size
		local z = center.Z + math.sin(angle) * size
		return Vector3.new(x, center.Y + height, z)
	end

	-- Centro del triángulo en el vacío (NO sigue al enemigo)
	local voidCenter = nil

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local c = cfg()
		if not isOn(c) then
			voidCenter = nil
			return
		end

		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not hrp then return end

		local size = tonumber(c.Size) or 40
		local switchRate = tonumber(c.SwitchRate) or 0.04
		local voidAlt = tonumber(c.VoidAltitude) or 5000

		-- Al activar: fija el centro ARRIBA del mapa (XZ actual del jugador, Y = vacío)
		if not voidCenter then
			voidCenter = Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X, voidAlt, hrp.Position.Z)
		else
			-- actualizar solo la altura si cambian el slider
			voidCenter = Vector3.new(voidCenter.X, voidAlt, voidCenter.Z)
		end

		local now = os.clock()
		if now - lastSwitch >= switchRate then
			lastSwitch = now
			vertex = vertex % 3 + 1
		end

		-- Triángulo en el vacío, lejos del enemigo
		local pos = trianglePoint(voidCenter, size, vertex, 0)

		pcall(function()
			for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
				if p:IsA("BasePart") then
					p.CanCollide = false
				end
			end
		end)

		hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
		hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end)

end


-- ============================================================

-- ============================================================
-- SHK Throwables ESP · iconos que tú pasaste (molotov/grenade/flash/...)
-- ============================================================
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

	local ICON_B64 = {
	molotov = [[]],
	flash = [[]],
	grenade = [[]],
	smoke = [[]],
	freeze = [[]],
	mine = [[]],
	satchel = [[]],
}

	local function b64decode(data)
		local fn = nil
		pcall(function()
			if crypt and crypt.base64decode then fn = crypt.base64decode
			elseif crypt and crypt.base64 and crypt.base64.decode then fn = crypt.base64.decode
			elseif base64_decode then fn = base64_decode
			elseif syn and syn.crypt and syn.crypt.base64 and syn.crypt.base64.decode then fn = syn.crypt.base64.decode
			end
		end)
		if not fn then return nil end
		local ok, res = pcall(fn, data)
		return ok and res or nil
	end

	local customAsset = (getcustomasset or getsynasset)
	local iconPath = {}

	local function ensureIcons()
		if not writefile or not customAsset then return end
		pcall(function()
			if makefolder and not isfolder("shako_throwables_v5") then
				makefolder("shako_throwables_v5")
			end
		end)
		for name, data in pairs(ICON_B64) do
			local path = "shako_throwables_v5/" .. name .. ".png"
			-- siempre reescribe v3 para corregir iconos flash/smoke viejos
			local raw = b64decode(data)
			if raw then
				pcall(writefile, path, raw)
			end
			local ok, asset = pcall(customAsset, path)
			if ok and asset then
				iconPath[name] = asset
			end
		end
	end
	pcall(ensureIcons)

	local KINDS = {
		-- orden importa: flash ANTES que smoke; smoke/flash antes que "grenade"
		{ key = "flash", match = {"flashbang", "flash", "stun", "blind", "flare"}, label = "FLASH", color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 230), iconKey = "flash" },
		{ key = "smoke", match = {"smoke"}, label = "SMOKE", color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 180, 80), iconKey = "smoke" },
		{ key = "molotov", match = {"molotov"}, label = "MOLOTOV", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 40), iconKey = "molotov" },
		{ key = "satchel", match = {"satchel"}, label = "SATCHEL", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 50), iconKey = "satchel" },
		{ key = "mine", match = {"tripmine", "subspace", "mine"}, label = "MINE", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 80), iconKey = "mine" },
		{ key = "freeze", match = {"freeze"}, label = "FREEZE", color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 255), iconKey = "freeze" },
		{ key = "grenade", match = {"grenade"}, label = "GRENADE", color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 100), iconKey = "grenade" },
	}

	local tracked = {}
	local lastScan = 0

	local function cfg()
		local ok, data = pcall(function() return tbl17.bG().Data end)
		if not ok or not data then return nil end
		return data.WorldVisuals
	end

	local function isOn()
		local c = cfg()
		return c and c.ThrowablesESP == true
	end

	local function classifyName(name)
		local n = string.lower(tostring(name or ""))
		if n == "" then return nil end
		for _, k in ipairs(KINDS) do
			for _, m in ipairs(k.match) do
				if string.find(n, m, 1, true) then return k end
			end
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function classify(name)
		return classifyName(name)
	end

	local function classifyObj(obj)
		if not obj then return nil end
		local k = classifyName(obj.Name)
		if k then return k end
		if obj.Parent then
			k = classifyName(obj.Parent.Name)
			if k then return k end
		end
		-- atributos del juego
		for _, attr in ipairs({ "ItemName", "WeaponName", "Type", "ProjectileType", "Name" }) do
			local ok, v = pcall(function() return obj:GetAttribute(attr) end)
			if ok and v ~= nil then
				k = classifyName(tostring(v))
				if k then return k end
			end
		end
		-- hijos con nombre útil
		for _, ch in ipairs(obj:GetChildren()) do
			k = classifyName(ch.Name)
			if k then return k end
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function getAdornee(obj)
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then return obj end
		if obj:IsA("Model") then
			return obj.PrimaryPart or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function clearOne(obj)
		local t = tracked[obj]
		if t and t.gui then pcall(function() t.gui:Destroy() end) end
		tracked[obj] = nil
	end

	local function clearAll()
		for obj in pairs(tracked) do clearOne(obj) end
	end

	local function makeBillboard(adornee, kind)
		local parent = (K and K.hudParent and K.hudParent()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
		local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		bb.Name = "ShakoThrowableESP"
		bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
		bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 72)
		bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.2, 0)
		bb.MaxDistance = 800
		bb.Adornee = adornee
		bb.Parent = parent

		-- Solo imagen + distancia (sin fondo negro)
		local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
		img.Name = "Icon"
		img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		img.BorderSizePixel = 0
		img.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(48, 48)
		img.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -24, 0, 0)
		img.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
		img.Image = iconPath[kind.iconKey] or ""
		img.Parent = bb

		if img.Image == "" then
			task.defer(function()
				pcall(ensureIcons)
				img.Image = iconPath[kind.iconKey] or ""
			end)
		end

		local dist = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		dist.Name = "Dist"
		dist.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		dist.BorderSizePixel = 0
		dist.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 50)
		dist.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
		dist.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		dist.TextSize = 12
		dist.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		dist.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
		dist.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		dist.Text = ""
		dist.Parent = bb

		return bb
	end

	local function isLocalOwned(obj)
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		return char and obj:IsDescendantOf(char)
	end

	local function consider(obj)
		if tracked[obj] then return end
		if isLocalOwned(obj) then return end
		local kind = classifyObj(obj)
		if not kind then return end
		local adornee = getAdornee(obj)
		if not adornee then return end
		for other, data in pairs(tracked) do
			if other ~= obj and data.adornee == adornee then return end
		end
		tracked[obj] = { gui = makeBillboard(adornee, kind), kind = kind, adornee = adornee }
	end

	local function scanWorkspace()
		local roots = { workspace }
		for _, name in ipairs({ "Projectiles", "Thrown", "Effects", "Debris", "Ignore", "Utilities", "Entities" }) do
			local f = workspace:FindFirstChild(name)
			if f then roots[#roots + 1] = f end
		end
		for _, root in ipairs(roots) do
			for _, obj in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
				consider(obj)
				for _, child in ipairs(obj:GetChildren()) do
					if child:IsA("Model") or child:IsA("BasePart") then
						consider(child)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(obj)
		if not isOn() then return end
		task.defer(function() consider(obj) end)
	end)

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not isOn() then
			if next(tracked) then clearAll() end
			return
		end
		local c = cfg()
		local maxDist = tonumber(c and c.ThrowablesMaxDist) or 300
		local showDist = not c or c.ThrowablesShowDist ~= false
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - lastScan > 0.25 then
			lastScan = now
			scanWorkspace()
		end
		local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local myPos = myRoot and myRoot.Position
		for obj, data in pairs(tracked) do
			if not obj.Parent or not data.adornee or not data.adornee.Parent then
				clearOne(obj)
				continue
			end
			local dist = myPos and (myPos - data.adornee.Position).Magnitude or 0
			if data.gui then
				data.gui.Enabled = dist <= maxDist
				local distLbl = data.gui:FindFirstChild("Dist", true)
				if distLbl and distLbl:IsA("TextLabel") then
					distLbl.Text = showDist and string.format("%dm", math.floor(dist + 0.5)) or ""
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	if K and K.onUnload then
		K.onUnload(clearAll)
	end

end









-- ============================================================
-- SHK Kicia Counter · underground + void desync + Kicia Spectate
-- ============================================================
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

	local lastSwitch = 0
	local phaseVoid = false
	local underCF = nil
	local voidCF = nil
	local currentTarget = nil

	-- Spectate state
	local specActive = false
	local savedType, savedFOV, savedSubject = nil, nil, nil
	local camCF = nil

	local function cfg()
		local ok, data = pcall(function()
			return tbl17.bG().Data
		end)
		if not ok or not data or not data.Ragebot or not data.Ragebot.Evasion then
			return nil
		end
		return data.Ragebot.Evasion.KiciaCounter
	end

	local function isOn(c)
		if not c or not c.Enabled then
			return false
		end
		local kb = c.Keybind
		if type(kb) == "table" then
			if kb.Kind == "Always" then
				return true
			end
			return kb.State == true
		end
		return true
	end

	local function specCfg(c)
		local s = c and c.Spectate
		if type(s) ~= "table" then
			return { Enabled = false, Distance = 10, Height = 4, Smooth = 0.18, FOV = 90 }
		end
		return s
	end

	local function isTeammate(plr)
		if not plr or plr == LocalPlayer then
			return true
		end
		local ok1, a = pcall(function()
			return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("TeamID")
		end)
		local ok2, b = pcall(function()
			return plr:GetAttribute("TeamID")
		end)
		if ok1 and ok2 and a ~= nil and b ~= nil then
			return a == b
		end
		if LocalPlayer.Team and plr.Team and LocalPlayer.Team == plr.Team then
			return true
		end
		return false
	end

	local function sameMatch(plr)
		local ok1, a = pcall(function()
			return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID")
		end)
		local ok2, b = pcall(function()
			return plr:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID")
		end)
		if ok1 and ok2 and a ~= nil and b ~= nil and a ~= b then
			return false
		end
		return true
	end

	local function getEnemy()
		-- SIN límite de distancia
		local function valid(plr)
			if not plr or plr == LocalPlayer or not plr.Parent then return nil end
			if isTeammate(plr) or not sameMatch(plr) then return nil end
			local ch = plr.Character
			local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local root = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local head = ch and (ch:FindFirstChild("Head") or root)
			if hum and hum.Health > 0 and head then
				return plr, head, root or head
			end
			return nil
		end

		local sticky = currentTarget or getgenv().__SHK_KiciaTarget
		if sticky then
			local p, h, r = valid(sticky)
			if p then return p, h, r end
		end

		local origin = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position or Vector3.zero
		local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if myRoot then origin = myRoot.Position end

		local best, bestHead, bestRoot, bestD = nil, nil, nil, math.huge
		for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local p, h, r = valid(plr)
			if p then
				local d = (origin - (r or h).Position).Magnitude
				if d < bestD then
					bestD = d
					best, bestHead, bestRoot = p, h, r
				end
			end
		end
		return best, bestHead, bestRoot
	end

	local function getUnderCF(hrp, char, depth, pitchDeg)
		local origin = Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X, hrp.Position.Y + 250, hrp.Position.Z)
		local rp = RaycastParams.new()
		rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, Vector3.new(0, -600, 0), rp)
		local groundY = hit and hit.Position.Y or (hrp.Position.Y - 4)
		local underPos = Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X, groundY - (tonumber(depth) or 3.5), hrp.Position.Z)
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local look = cam and cam.CFrame.LookVector or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
		local yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
		local pitch = math.rad(tonumber(pitchDeg) or 90)
		return CFrame.new(underPos) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(pitch, 0, 0)
	end

	local function noclip(char)
		for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
			if p:IsA("BasePart") then
				p.CanCollide = false
			end
		end
	end

	local function restoreCam()
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not cam then
			return
		end
		if savedType ~= nil then
			pcall(function()
				cam.CameraType = savedType
			end)
		else
			pcall(function()
				cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
			end)
		end
		if savedFOV ~= nil then
			pcall(function()
				cam.FieldOfView = savedFOV
			end)
		end
		if savedSubject ~= nil then
			pcall(function()
				cam.CameraSubject = savedSubject
			end)
		else
			local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum then
				pcall(function()
					cam.CameraSubject = hum
				end)
			end
		end
		savedType, savedFOV, savedSubject = nil, nil, nil
		camCF = nil
		specActive = false
	end

	local function beginCam(s)
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not cam then
			return
		end
		if not specActive then
			savedType = cam.CameraType
			savedFOV = cam.FieldOfView
			savedSubject = cam.CameraSubject
			camCF = cam.CFrame
			specActive = true
		end
		pcall(function()
			cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
			cam.FieldOfView = tonumber(s.FOV) or 90
		end)
	end

	-- Counter movement
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local c = cfg()
		if not isOn(c) then
			phaseVoid = false
			underCF = nil
			voidCF = nil
			currentTarget = nil
			getgenv().__SHK_KiciaTarget = nil
			if specActive then
				restoreCam()
			end
			return
		end

		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not hrp then
			return
		end

		pcall(noclip, char)
		if hum then
			pcall(function()
				hum.AutoRotate = false
				hum.PlatformStand = true
			end)
		end

		local depth = tonumber(c.Depth) or 3.5
		local pitch = tonumber(c.Pitch) or 90
		local dist = tonumber(c.VoidDistance) or 80000
		local rate = tonumber(c.SwitchRate) or 0.08

		-- track enemy for spectate
		local enemy, head, root = getEnemy()
		currentTarget = enemy
		getgenv().__SHK_KiciaTarget = enemy

		underCF = getUnderCF(hrp, char, depth, pitch)

		local now = os.clock()
		if now - lastSwitch >= rate then
			lastSwitch = now
			phaseVoid = not phaseVoid
		end

		if phaseVoid then
			local dir = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector or Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			local flat = Vector3.new(dir.X, 0, dir.Z)
			if flat.Magnitude < 0.05 then
				flat = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
			else
				flat = flat.Unit
			end
			local voidPos = underCF.Position + Vector3.new(0, dist, 0) + flat * (dist * 0.15)
			voidCF = CFrame.new(voidPos)
			hrp.CFrame = voidCF
		else
			hrp.CFrame = underCF
		end

		hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end)

	-- Desync visual: underground pose
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local c = cfg()
		if not isOn(c) or not underCF then
			return
		end
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not hrp then
			return
		end
		hrp.CFrame = underCF
		hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end)

	-- Kicia Spectate: cámara al enemigo cuando aparece / está en partida
	RunService:BindToRenderStep("ShakoKiciaSpectate", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 3, function(dt)
		local c = cfg()
		local s = specCfg(c)
		if not isOn(c) or not s.Enabled then
			if specActive then
				restoreCam()
			end
			return
		end

		local enemy = currentTarget
		local head, root = nil, nil
		if enemy and enemy.Character then
			head = enemy.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
			root = enemy.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		end
		if not enemy or not head then
			-- sin enemigo aún: no forzar cámara
			if specActive then
				restoreCam()
			end
			return
		end

		beginCam(s)
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not cam then
			return
		end

		local dist = tonumber(s.Distance) or 10
		local height = tonumber(s.Height) or 4
		local smooth = math.clamp(tonumber(s.Smooth) or 0.18, 0.02, 1)

		local basis = root and root.CFrame or head.CFrame
		local back = -basis.LookVector
		local focus = head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0)
		local goalPos = focus + back * dist + Vector3.new(0, height, 0)
		if back.Magnitude < 0.1 then
			goalPos = focus + Vector3.new(0, height, dist)
		end
		local goalCF = CFrame.lookAt(goalPos, focus)

		if not camCF then
			camCF = goalCF
		else
			local alpha = 1 - math.exp(-(dt or 0.016) / smooth)
			camCF = camCF:Lerp(goalCF, alpha)
		end
		cam.CFrame = camCF
	end)

	LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		if specActive then
			restoreCam()
		end
	end)

	if K and K.onUnload then
		K.onUnload(function()
			pcall(function()
				RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ShakoKiciaSpectate")
			end)
			restoreCam()
		end)
	end

end


-- ============================================================
-- Translocate Newminy Counter — TP en la ESPALDA del enemigo
-- ============================================================
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

	local lastSwitch = 0
	local side = 1

	local function cfg()
		local ok, data = pcall(function() return tbl17.bG().Data end)
		if not ok or not data or not data.Ragebot or not data.Ragebot.Evasion then return nil end
		return data.Ragebot.Evasion.TranslocateNewminyCounter
	end

	local function isOn(c)
		if not c or not c.Enabled then return false end
		local kb = c.Keybind
		if type(kb) == "table" then
			if kb.Kind == "Always" then return true end
			return kb.State == true
		end
		return true
	end

	local function sameTeam(plr)
		if not plr or plr == LocalPlayer then return true end
		local myId = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("TeamID")
		local theirId = plr:GetAttribute("TeamID")
		if myId ~= nil and theirId ~= nil then return myId == theirId end
		if LocalPlayer.Team and plr.Team then return LocalPlayer.Team == plr.Team end
		return false
	end

	local function getTarget(teamCheck)
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local origin = cam and cam.CFrame.Position or Vector3.zero
		local best, bestDist = nil, 1e9
		for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if plr ~= LocalPlayer and not (teamCheck and sameTeam(plr)) then
				local char = plr.Character
				local head = char and (char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
				local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if head and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
					local d = (head.Position - origin).Magnitude
					if d < bestDist then bestDist, best = d, head end
				end
			end
		end
		return best
	end

	local realCF, visualCF = nil, nil
	local desyncOn = true

	local function behindCF(thrp, head, backDist, idx)
		local look = thrp.CFrame.LookVector
		local right = thrp.CFrame.RightVector
		look = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
		right = Vector3.new(right.X, 0, right.Z)
		if look.Magnitude < 1e-3 then look = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) else look = look.Unit end
		if right.Magnitude < 1e-3 then right = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) else right = right.Unit end
		local base = thrp.Position - look * backDist
		if idx == 2 then base = base - right * (backDist * 0.12)
		elseif idx == 3 then base = base + right * (backDist * 0.12) end
		base = Vector3.new(base.X, thrp.Position.Y, base.Z)
		return CFrame.lookAt(base, head.Position)
	end

	local function computeFrames(c)
		local head = getTarget(c.TeamCheck ~= false)
		if not head then realCF, visualCF = nil, nil return end
		local thrp = head.Parent and head.Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not thrp then realCF, visualCF = nil, nil return end
		local backDist = math.clamp(tonumber(c.BackDistance) or 8, 1, 80)
		local switchRate = tonumber(c.SwitchRate) or 0.05
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - lastSwitch >= switchRate then
			lastSwitch = now
			side = side % 3 + 1
		end
		realCF = behindCF(thrp, head, backDist, side)
		visualCF = behindCF(thrp, head, math.max(2, backDist * 0.5), 1)
	end

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local c = cfg()
		if not isOn(c) then
			getgenv()._ShakoTranslocateNM = false
			realCF, visualCF = nil, nil
			return
		end
		getgenv()._ShakoTranslocateNM = true
		desyncOn = c.Desync ~= false
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not hrp then return end
		computeFrames(c)
		if not realCF then return end
		pcall(function()
			for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanCollide = false end
			end
			hrp.CFrame = realCF
			hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end)
	end)

	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not getgenv()._ShakoTranslocateNM then return end
		if not desyncOn or not visualCF then return end
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not hrp then return end
		pcall(function()
			hrp.CFrame = visualCF
		end)
	end)

end

-- ============================================================
-- Nebula Counter (meowlua method) — OOB / extreme TP spam
-- ============================================================
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

	local lastUpdate = 0
	local saveCF = nil
	local wasOn = false
	local rng = Random.new()

	local function cfg()
		local ok, data = pcall(function() return tbl17.bG().Data end)
		if not ok or not data or not data.Ragebot or not data.Ragebot.Evasion then return nil end
		return data.Ragebot.Evasion.NebulaCounter
	end

	local function isOn(c)
		if not c or not c.Enabled then return false end
		local kb = c.Keybind
		if type(kb) == "table" then
			if kb.Kind == "Always" then return true end
			return kb.State == true
		end
		return true
	end

	local function getHRP()
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		return char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	end

	local function validVec(v)
		return typeof(v) == "Vector3" and v.X == v.X and v.Y == v.Y and v.Z == v.Z
			and math.abs(v.X) < 1e30 and math.abs(v.Y) < 1e30 and math.abs(v.Z) < 1e30
	end

	local function setCF(hrp, cf)
		pcall(function()
			hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			hrp.CFrame = cf
			hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end)
	end

	local function ringPoint(anchor, minRad, maxRad)
		local angle = rng:NextNumber(0, 2 * math.pi)
		local radiusValue = rng:NextNumber(minRad, maxRad)
		return anchor + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * radiusValue, 0, math.sin(angle) * radiusValue)
	end

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local c = cfg()
		local on = isOn(c)
		if on and not wasOn then
			local hrp = getHRP()
			if hrp then saveCF = hrp.CFrame end
			wasOn = true
			getgenv()._ShakoNebulaCounter = true
		elseif not on and wasOn then
			wasOn = false
			getgenv()._ShakoNebulaCounter = false
			if c and c.RestoreOnDisable ~= false and saveCF then
				local hrp = getHRP()
				if hrp then setCF(hrp, saveCF) end
			end
			saveCF = nil
			return
		end
		if not on then return end

		local rate = tonumber(c.UpdateRate) or 0.1
		local now = tick()
		if now - lastUpdate < rate then return end
		lastUpdate = now

		local hrp = getHRP()
		if not hrp then return end

		local height = tonumber(c.Height) or 15
		local destCF = nil

		-- Prefer OutOfBoundsPart with KillDelay == 0 (same as Nebula/meowlua)
		for _, part in pairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("OutOfBoundsPart")) do
			if part:GetAttribute("KillDelay") == 0 then
				destCF = part.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, part.Size.Y / 2 + height, 0)
				break
			end
		end

		if not destCF then
			local baseRad = tonumber(c.EvasionRadiusMin) or 100
			local maxRad = tonumber(c.EvasionRadiusMax) or 150
			if maxRad < baseRad then maxRad = baseRad end
			local ring = ringPoint(hrp.Position, baseRad, maxRad)
			local x2, y2, z = ring.X, ring.Y, ring.Z
			local pick = rng:NextInteger(1, 3)
			if pick == 1 then x2 = 1073741824
			elseif pick == 2 then y2 = 1073741824
			else z = 1073741824 end
			destCF = CFrame.new(x2, y2, z)
		end

		local pos = destCF.Position
		if not validVec(pos) then return end
		setCF(hrp, CFrame.new(pos))
	end)

end



-- ============================================================
-- SHK UI Toggle animation (pulse al encender/apagar)
-- ============================================================
do
	local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
	local pulseInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

	local function pulse(gui)
		if not gui or not gui.Parent then return end
		local scale = gui:FindFirstChild("_ShakoPulse")
		if not scale then
			scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
			scale.Name = "_ShakoPulse"
			scale.Parent = gui
		end
		scale.Scale = 0.88
		TweenService:Create(scale, pulseInfo, { Scale = 1 }):Play()
	end

	local hooked = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

	local function hookButton(btn)
		if hooked[btn] then return end
		if not (btn:IsA("TextButton") or btn:IsA("ImageButton") or btn:IsA("GuiButton")) then return end
		hooked[btn] = true
		btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			-- pulsa el botón y su fila padre
			pulse(btn)
			local row = btn.Parent
			if row and row:IsA("GuiObject") then
				pulse(row)
			end
		end)
	end

	task.defer(function()
		local parent = (K and K.hudParent and K.hudParent()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
		for _, d in ipairs(parent:GetDescendants()) do
			hookButton(d)
		end
		parent.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
			task.defer(hookButton, d)
		end)
	end)

end








-- ============================================================
-- SHK Counter text · estilo Nebula (arriba, bajo el marcador/llaves)
-- ============================================================
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

	local function hudParent()
		local okPg, pg = pcall(function()
			return LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") or LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 2)
		end)
		if okPg and pg then return pg end
		if K and K.hudParent then
			local ok, h = pcall(K.hudParent)
			if ok and h then return h end
		end
		local ok, h = pcall(function()
			return (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
		end)
		return (ok and h) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
	end

	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "ShakoCounterHUD"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
	gui.DisplayOrder = 1e9
	gui.Enabled = true
	gui.Parent = hudParent()

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = "CounterText"
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.BorderSizePixel = 0
	label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	-- Como Nebula: abajo de las llaves del marcador (score / timer)
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 70)
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 28)
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	label.TextSize = 18
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
	label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	label.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	label.ZIndex = 50
	label.Text = ""
	label.Visible = false
	label.Parent = gui

	local textGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	textGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.35, Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.75, Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
	})
	textGrad.Parent = label

	local function counterOn(pathTbl)
		if type(pathTbl) ~= "table" then return false end
		if pathTbl.Enabled == true then return true end
		local kb = pathTbl.Keybind
		if type(kb) == "table" and kb.State == true then return true end
		return false
	end

	local function activeTags()
		local ok, data = pcall(function() return tbl17.bG().Data end)
		if not ok or not data or not data.Ragebot or not data.Ragebot.Evasion then return {} end
		local e = data.Ragebot.Evasion
		local tags = {}
		if counterOn(e.KiciaCounter) then tags[#tags + 1] = "[Kicia Counter]" end
		if counterOn(e.TranslocateNewminyCounter) then tags[#tags + 1] = "[Translocate Newminy]" end
		if counterOn(e.NewMinyCounter) then tags[#tags + 1] = "[Newminy Counter]" end
		if counterOn(e.UECounter) then tags[#tags + 1] = "[UE Counter]" end
		if counterOn(e.NebulaCounter) then tags[#tags + 1] = "[Nebula Counter]" end
		return tags
	end

	local t0 = os.clock()
	local lastParentCheck = 0
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - lastParentCheck > 2 then
			lastParentCheck = now
			if not gui.Parent then
				gui.Parent = hudParent()
			end
		end

		local tags = activeTags()
		if #tags == 0 then
			label.Visible = false
			label.Text = ""
			return
		end

		label.Visible = true
		label.Text = "Shako.win " .. table.concat(tags, " ")
		local t = now - t0
		textGrad.Offset = Vector2.new((t * 0.35) % 2 - 1, 0)
		label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.1 + (math.sin(t * 3) * 0.5 + 0.5) * 0.2
	end)

	if K and K.onUnload then
		K.onUnload(function()
			pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end)
		end)
	end

end





-- ============================================================
-- SHK Waifu SHK · imagen nueva original
-- ============================================================
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

	local ICON_B64 = ""

	local function hudParent()
		local okPg, pg = pcall(function()
			return LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") or LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 2)
		end)
		if okPg and pg then return pg end
		if K and K.hudParent then
			local ok, h = pcall(K.hudParent)
			if ok and h then return h end
		end
		local ok, h = pcall(function()
			return (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
		end)
		return (ok and h) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
	end

	local function b64decode(data)
		local b = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
		data = tostring(data):gsub("[^" .. b .. "=]", "")
		local out = {}
		local function idx(ch)
			if not ch or ch == "" or ch == "=" then return 0 end
			local p = b:find(ch, 1, true)
			return p and (p - 1) or 0
		end
		for i = 1, #data, 4 do
			local a1 = idx(data:sub(i, i))
			local a2 = idx(data:sub(i + 1, i + 1))
			local a3 = idx(data:sub(i + 2, i + 2))
			local a4 = idx(data:sub(i + 3, i + 3))
			local n = a1 * 262144 + a2 * 4096 + a3 * 64 + a4
			local b1 = math.floor(n / 65536) % 256
			local b2 = math.floor(n / 256) % 256
			local b3 = n % 256
			out[#out + 1] = string.char(b1)
			if data:sub(i + 2, i + 2) ~= "=" then out[#out + 1] = string.char(b2) end
			if data:sub(i + 3, i + 3) ~= "=" then out[#out + 1] = string.char(b3) end
		end
		return table.concat(out)
	end

	local assetId = ""
	local function ensureAsset()
		if assetId ~= "" and assetId ~= "fail" then return assetId end
		local okDec, raw = pcall(b64decode, ICON_B64)
		if not okDec or type(raw) ~= "string" or #raw < 100 then
			pcall(function()
				if crypt and crypt.base64decode then raw = crypt.base64decode(ICON_B64) end
			end)
		end
		if type(raw) ~= "string" or #raw < 100 then
			assetId = "fail"
			return ""
		end
		local path = "shako_assets/waifu_shk_new_v8.png"
		pcall(function()
			if makefolder and not isfolder("shako_assets") then makefolder("shako_assets") end
		end)
		local wrote = pcall(function()
			if writefile then writefile(path, raw) end
		end)
		if not wrote then
			assetId = "fail"
			return ""
		end
		local customAsset = getcustomasset or getsynasset
		if not customAsset then
			assetId = "fail"
			return ""
		end
		local okA, asset = pcall(customAsset, path)
		if okA and type(asset) == "string" and asset ~= "" then
			assetId = asset
			return assetId
		end
		assetId = "fail"
		return ""
	end

	local gui, img, size = nil, nil, 180
	local dragging, dragStart, startPos = false, nil, nil

	local function cfg()
		local ok, data = pcall(function() return tbl17.bG().Data end)
		if not ok or not data or not data.WorldVisuals then
			return { on = false, size = 180 }
		end
		local w = data.WorldVisuals
		return {
			on = w.WaifuSHK == true,
			size = tonumber(w.WaifuSize) or 180,
		}
	end

	local function destroy()
		if gui then pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end) end
		gui, img = nil, nil
		dragging = false
	end

	local function ensure()
		if K.destroyed or getgenv().ShakoUnloaded then destroy() return end
		if gui and gui.Parent then return end
		local parent = hudParent()
		gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		gui.Name = "ShakoWaifuSHK"
		gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
		gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
		gui.DisplayOrder = 120
		gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
		gui.Parent = parent

		img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
		img.Name = "Waifu"
		img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		img.BorderSizePixel = 0
		img.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
		img.Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, -12)
		img.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
		img.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
		img.ImageTransparency = 0
		img.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		img.Image = ensureAsset()
		img.Active = true
		img.Parent = gui

		img.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
				or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				dragging = true
				dragStart = input.Position
				startPos = img.Position
			end
		end)
		UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
				or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				dragging = false
			end
		end)
		UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if not dragging or not dragStart or not startPos or not img then return end
			if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
				and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
			local d = input.Position - dragStart
			img.Position = UDim2.new(
				startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X,
				startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y
			)
		end)
	end

	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if K.destroyed or getgenv().ShakoUnloaded then
			destroy()
			return
		end
		local c = cfg()
		if not c.on then
			destroy()
			return
		end
		ensure()
		if img then
			size = math.clamp(c.size, 80, 420)
			img.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
			if img.Image == "" or img.Image == "fail" then
				local a = ensureAsset()
				if a ~= "" and a ~= "fail" then img.Image = a end
			end
		end
	end)

	if K and K.onUnload then
		K.onUnload(destroy)
	end

end


-- ============================================================
-- SHK Zombie Tower · auto shoot NPC + TP arriba (te puedes mover)
-- ============================================================
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

	local lastFire = 0
	local lastSwitch = 0
	local currentTarget = nil
	local slots = { Primary = 1, Secondary = 2, Melee = 3 }
	local strafeAngle = 0
	local lastStrafeTick = os.clock()
	local lastNc = 0

	local function cfg()
		local ok, data = pcall(function() return tbl17.bG().Data end)
		if not ok or not data or not data.Ragebot then return nil end
		return data.Ragebot.ZombieTower
	end

	local function isOn(c)
		if not c or not c.Enabled then return false end
		local kb = c.Keybind
		if type(kb) == "table" then
			if kb.Kind == "Always" then return true end
			return kb.State == true
		end
		return true
	end

	local function getFighter()
		local ok, fc = pcall(function()
			return require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController)
		end)
		if ok and fc then return fc.LocalFighter end
		return nil
	end

	local function getUtilEnum()
		local util, enum
		pcall(function()
			util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Utility)
			enum = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.EnumLibrary)
		end)
		return util, enum
	end

	local function isPlayerChar(model)
		return Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) ~= nil
	end

	local function getTargets(maxDist, myPos)
		local list = {}
		for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if obj:IsA("Model") and not isPlayerChar(obj) then
				local root = obj:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local head = obj:FindFirstChild("Head")
				local hum = obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
				if root and head and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
					local d = (myPos - root.Position).Magnitude
					if d <= maxDist then
						list[#list + 1] = { model = obj, root = root, head = head, dist = d }
					end
				end
			end
		end
		table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.dist < b.dist end)
		return list
	end

	local function ensureEquip(fighter, slotName)
		if not fighter then return end
		if fighter.EquippedItem ~= nil then return end
		local n = slots[slotName] or 1
		pcall(function() fighter:EquipItem(n) end)
	end

	local function shoot(util, enum, fighter, head)
		if not util or not enum or not fighter or not fighter.EquippedItem or not head then return end
		local originPos = head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
		local targetPos = head.Position
		local aimCF = CFrame.lookAt(originPos, targetPos)
		local targetCF = head.CFrame
		local aimedPos = targetPos + Vector3.new(
			(math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02,
			(math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02,
			(math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02
		)
		local objSpace = head.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(CFrame.new(aimedPos))
		local cameradata = {}
		cameradata[utf8.char(1)] = {
			[utf8.char(0)] = util:EncodeCFrame(aimCF),
			[utf8.char(1)] = util:EncodeCFrame(targetCF),
			[utf8.char(2)] = head,
			[utf8.char(3)] = util:EncodeCFrame(objSpace),
		}
		pcall(function()
			local oid = fighter.EquippedItem:Get("ObjectID")
			ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Replication.Fighter.UseItem:FireServer(
				oid,
				enum:ToEnum("StartShooting"),
				cameradata,
				nil
			)
		end)
	end

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local c = cfg()
		if not isOn(c) then
			currentTarget = nil
			return
		end

		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not hrp then return end

		local maxDist = tonumber(c.MaxDistance) or 5000
		local height = tonumber(c.Height) or 12
		local switchRate = tonumber(c.SwitchRate) or 0.15
		local fireRate = tonumber(c.FireRate) or 0.03
		local moveFreedom = tonumber(c.MoveFreedom) or 18
		local slotName = c.WeaponSlot or "Primary"

		local now = os.clock()
		local targets = getTargets(maxDist, hrp.Position)
		if #targets == 0 then
			currentTarget = nil
			return
		end

		if now - lastSwitch >= switchRate or not currentTarget or not currentTarget.Parent then
			lastSwitch = now
			currentTarget = targets[1].model
		end

		local tModel = currentTarget
		local tRoot = tModel and tModel:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local tHead = tModel and tModel:FindFirstChild("Head")
		local tHum = tModel and tModel:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
		if not tRoot or not tHead or not tHum or tHum.Health <= 0 then
			currentTarget = targets[1] and targets[1].model
			tModel = currentTarget
			tRoot = tModel and tModel:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			tHead = tModel and tModel:FindFirstChild("Head")
			if not tRoot or not tHead then return end
		end

		-- Movimiento: UnderFeet (bajo las patas) / Above / TargetStrafe
		local movement = tostring(c.Movement or "UnderFeet")
		local md = (hum and hum.MoveDirection) or Vector3.zero
		local pos
		local lookAt = tHead.Position

		if movement == "UnderFeet" then
			-- debajo de las patas del NPC (no llegan a pegar)
			local depth = tonumber(c.UnderDepth) or 4.5
			local radius = tonumber(c.StrafeRadius) or 0
			local speedDeg = tonumber(c.StrafeSpeed) or 0
			local nowT = os.clock()
			local dt = math.clamp(nowT - lastStrafeTick, 0, 0.05)
			lastStrafeTick = nowT
			-- órbita chica opcional bajo ellos
			if radius > 0.5 and speedDeg > 0 then
				strafeAngle = strafeAngle + math.rad(speedDeg) * dt
				if strafeAngle > math.pi * 2 then strafeAngle = strafeAngle - math.pi * 2 end
				pos = tRoot.Position + Vector3.new(
					math.cos(strafeAngle) * radius * 0.35,
					-depth,
					math.sin(strafeAngle) * radius * 0.35
				)
			else
				pos = tRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, -depth, 0)
			end
			-- mirar hacia arriba al head
			lookAt = tHead.Position
		elseif movement == "TargetStrafe" then
			local radius = tonumber(c.StrafeRadius) or 10
			local speedDeg = tonumber(c.StrafeSpeed) or 220
			local sHeight = tonumber(c.StrafeHeight)
			if sHeight == nil then sHeight = 3 end
			local nowT = os.clock()
			local dt = math.clamp(nowT - lastStrafeTick, 0, 0.05)
			lastStrafeTick = nowT
			strafeAngle = strafeAngle + math.rad(speedDeg) * dt
			if strafeAngle > math.pi * 2 then strafeAngle = strafeAngle - math.pi * 2 end
			pos = tRoot.Position + Vector3.new(
				math.cos(strafeAngle) * radius,
				sHeight,
				math.sin(strafeAngle) * radius
			)
		else
			local base = tRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, height, 0)
			pos = base + Vector3.new(md.X, 0, md.Z) * moveFreedom
		end

		local useDesync = c.Desync ~= false
		pcall(function()
			local tnow = os.clock()
			if tnow - lastNc > 0.25 then
				lastNc = tnow
				for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
					if p:IsA("BasePart") then
						p.CanCollide = false
						p.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
					end
				end
			end

			-- pitch boca arriba cuando estamos debajo (desync visual)
			local targetCF
			if movement == "UnderFeet" then
				local pitch = math.rad(90)
				local yaw = math.atan2(-(lookAt.X - pos.X), -(lookAt.Z - pos.Z))
				targetCF = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(pitch, 0, 0)
			else
				targetCF = CFrame.new(pos, lookAt)
			end

			if useDesync then
				if hum then
					hum.AutoRotate = false
					hum.PlatformStand = true
					pcall(function()
						hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
					end)
				end
				-- aplicar CFrame real (hitbox abajo)
				hrp.CFrame = targetCF
				hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
				-- reconstrucción joints (evita ver el tp roto)
				local lower = char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")
				local rootJoint = lower and lower:FindFirstChild("Root")
				if rootJoint and rootJoint:IsA("Motor6D") then
					rootJoint.Transform = CFrame.new()
				end
				local upper = char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
				local waist = upper and upper:FindFirstChild("Waist")
				if waist and waist:IsA("Motor6D") then
					waist.Transform = CFrame.new()
				end
				local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
				local neck = head and (head:FindFirstChild("Neck") or (upper and upper:FindFirstChild("Neck")))
				if neck and neck:IsA("Motor6D") then
					neck.Transform = CFrame.new()
				end
			else
				hrp.CFrame = targetCF
				hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			end
		end)

		local fighter = getFighter()
		ensureEquip(fighter, slotName)
		if now - lastFire >= fireRate then
			lastFire = now
			local util, enum = getUtilEnum()
			shoot(util, enum, fighter, tHead)
		end
	end)

end

-- ============================================================
-- SHK Zombie ESP (NPCs) · junto a Zombie Tower
-- ============================================================
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

	local tracked = {} -- [Model] = { hl, bb, name, hpBg, hpFill, dist }
	local lastScan = 0

	local function cfg()
		local ok, data = pcall(function() return tbl17.bG().Data end)
		if not ok or not data or not data.Ragebot then return nil end
		return data.Ragebot.ZombieTower
	end

	local function isPlayerChar(model)
		return Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) ~= nil
	end

	local function clearOne(model)
		local t = tracked[model]
		if not t then return end
		if t.hl then pcall(function() t.hl:Destroy() end) end
		if t.bb then pcall(function() t.bb:Destroy() end) end
		tracked[model] = nil
	end

	local function clearAll()
		for m in pairs(tracked) do clearOne(m) end
	end

	local function makeESP(model, color)
		local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head")
		local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local adornee = head or root
		if not adornee then return nil end

		local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
		hl.Name = "ShakoZombieESP"
		hl.Adornee = model
		hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
		hl.FillTransparency = 0.72
		hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
		hl.FillColor = color
		hl.OutlineColor = color
		hl.Parent = model

		local parent = (K and K.hudParent and K.hudParent()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
		local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		bb.Name = "ShakoZombieESP_BB"
		bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
		bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 42)
		bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.6, 0)
		bb.MaxDistance = 2500
		bb.Adornee = adornee
		bb.Parent = parent

		local nameLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		nameLbl.Name = "Name"
		nameLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		nameLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14)
		nameLbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
		nameLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		nameLbl.TextSize = 12
		nameLbl.TextColor3 = color
		nameLbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
		nameLbl.Text = model.Name
		nameLbl.Parent = bb

		local hpBg = Instance.new("Frame")
		hpBg.Name = "HpBg"
		hpBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
		hpBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 34)
		hpBg.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 4)
		hpBg.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0, 16)
		hpBg.Parent = bb
		Instance.new("UICorner", hpBg).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

		local hpFill = Instance.new("Frame")
		hpFill.Name = "HpFill"
		hpFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
		hpFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 100)
		hpFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		hpFill.Parent = hpBg
		Instance.new("UICorner", hpFill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

		local distLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		distLbl.Name = "Dist"
		distLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		distLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12)
		distLbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 24)
		distLbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		distLbl.TextSize = 11
		distLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 230)
		distLbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.45
		distLbl.Text = ""
		distLbl.Parent = bb

		return {
			hl = hl,
			bb = bb,
			name = nameLbl,
			hpBg = hpBg,
			hpFill = hpFill,
			dist = distLbl,
		}
	end

	local function scan(maxDist, myPos)
		for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if obj:IsA("Model") and not isPlayerChar(obj) then
				local root = obj:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local hum = obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
				if root and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
					local d = (myPos - root.Position).Magnitude
					if d <= maxDist and not tracked[obj] then
						-- defer create with color from cfg on next frame
						tracked[obj] = { pending = true, root = root, hum = hum }
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local c = cfg()
		if not c or not c.ESP then
			if next(tracked) then clearAll() end
			return
		end

		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		local myRoot = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not myRoot then return end

		local maxDist = tonumber(c.ESPMaxDistance) or 500
		local color = (typeof(c.ESPColor) == "Color3") and c.ESPColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
		local showBox = c.ESPBox ~= false
		local showName = c.ESPName ~= false
		local showHp = c.ESPHealth ~= false
		local showDist = c.ESPDistance ~= false

		local now = os.clock()
		if now - lastScan > 0.4 then
			lastScan = now
			-- mark alive set
			local alive = {}
			for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
				if obj:IsA("Model") and not isPlayerChar(obj) then
					local root = obj:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					local hum = obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
					if root and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
						local d = (myRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
						if d <= maxDist then
							alive[obj] = { root = root, hum = hum, dist = d }
							if not tracked[obj] then
								local visual = makeESP(obj, color)
								if visual then
									tracked[obj] = visual
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			for model in pairs(tracked) do
				if not alive[model] then
					clearOne(model)
				end
			end
		end

		for model, data in pairs(tracked) do
			if not model.Parent then
				clearOne(model)
				continue
			end
			local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local hum = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
			if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
				clearOne(model)
				continue
			end
			local dist = (myRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
			local on = dist <= maxDist

			if data.hl then
				data.hl.Enabled = on and showBox
				data.hl.FillColor = color
				data.hl.OutlineColor = color
			end
			if data.bb then
				data.bb.Enabled = on
			end
			if data.name then
				data.name.Visible = showName
				data.name.Text = model.Name
				data.name.TextColor3 = color
			end
			if data.hpBg then
				data.hpBg.Visible = showHp
			end
			if data.hpFill and hum then
				local pct = math.clamp(hum.Health / math.max(hum.MaxHealth, 1), 0, 1)
				data.hpFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(pct, 1)
				if pct > 0.55 then
					data.hpFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 100)
				elseif pct > 0.25 then
					data.hpFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 180, 60)
				else
					data.hpFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 70, 70)
				end
			end
			if data.dist then
				data.dist.Visible = showDist
				data.dist.Text = showDist and string.format("%dm", math.floor(dist + 0.5)) or ""
			end
		end
	end)

	if K and K.onUnload then
		K.onUnload(clearAll)
	end

end


-- ============================================================
-- SHK Rage v2 · bajo patas + adelante + acostado · desync CFrame
-- Independiente de Kicia (Method = "Rage v2")
-- ============================================================
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

	local lastFire = 0
	local realCF = nil
	local desyncOn = false

	local function cfg()
		local ok, data = pcall(function() return tbl17.bG().Data end)
		if not ok or not data or not data.Ragebot then return nil end
		return data.Ragebot
	end

	local function isEnabled(c)
		if not c or not c.Enabled then return false end
		if tostring(c.Method or "Kicia") ~= "Rage v2" then return false end
		local kb = c.Keybind
		if type(kb) == "table" then
			if kb.Kind == "Always" then return true end
			return kb.State == true
		end
		return true
	end

	local function inMatch()
		-- no lobby: need EnvironmentID / fighter / not menu-only
		local ok, env = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID") end)
		if ok and (env == nil or env == "" or env == 0) then
			-- still allow if character in workspace with weapon systems
		end
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return false end
		-- Kicia-style: if arcade/lobby attribute
		local ok2, lobby = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("InLobby") end)
		if ok2 and lobby == true then return false end
		local ok3, place = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("PlaceType") end)
		if ok3 and type(place) == "string" and place:lower():find("lobby") then return false end
		-- no enemy fighters nearby still ok - we just idle
		local fc = nil
		pcall(function()
			local ps = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
			local c = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("Controllers")
			local m = c and c:FindFirstChild("FighterController")
			if m then fc = require(m) end
		end)
		if fc and fc.LocalFighter == nil then
			-- might be lobby
			local ok4, st = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("GameState") end)
			if ok4 and type(st) == "string" and (st:lower():find("lobby") or st:lower():find("menu")) then
				return false
			end
		end
		return true
	end

	local function isTeammate(plr)
		if not plr or plr == LocalPlayer then return true end
		local ok1, a = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("TeamID") end)
		local ok2, b = pcall(function() return plr:GetAttribute("TeamID") end)
		if ok1 and ok2 and a ~= nil and b ~= nil then return a == b end
		local mc, oc = LocalPlayer.Character, plr.Character
		if mc and oc then
			local ok3, x = pcall(function() return mc:GetAttribute("TeamID") end)
			local ok4, y = pcall(function() return oc:GetAttribute("TeamID") end)
			if ok3 and ok4 and x ~= nil and y ~= nil then return x == y end
		end
		if LocalPlayer.Team and plr.Team and LocalPlayer.Team == plr.Team then return true end
		return false
	end

	local function sameMatch(plr)
		local ok1, a = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID") end)
		local ok2, b = pcall(function() return plr:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID") end)
		if ok1 and ok2 and a ~= nil and b ~= nil and a ~= b then return false end
		return true
	end

	local function getTarget()
		local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
		local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not myRoot then return nil end
		local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
		for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character and sameMatch(plr) and not isTeammate(plr) then
				local hum = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local root = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local head = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
				if hum and hum.Health > 0 and root and head then
					local d = (myRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
					if d < bestD then
						bestD = d
						best = { plr = plr, root = root, head = head, hum = hum }
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return best
	end

	local function getFighter()
		local fc
		pcall(function()
			local ps = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
