			local c = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("Controllers")
			local m = c and c:FindFirstChild("FighterController")
			if m then fc = require(m) end
		end)
		return fc and fc.LocalFighter
	end

	local function shootHead(head)
		local fighter = getFighter()
		if not fighter or not fighter.EquippedItem then return end
		local item = fighter.EquippedItem
		local util, enumLib
		pcall(function()
			util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Utility)
			enumLib = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.EnumLibrary)
		end)
		if not util or not enumLib then return end
		local objectId
		pcall(function() objectId = item:Get("ObjectID") or item.ObjectId end)
		if not objectId then return end
		local origin = head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.05, 0)
		local aimCF = CFrame.lookAt(origin, head.Position)
		local targetCF = head.CFrame
		local objSpace = head.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(CFrame.new(head.Position))
		local cameradata = {}
		cameradata[utf8.char(1)] = {
			[utf8.char(0)] = util:EncodeCFrame(aimCF),
			[utf8.char(1)] = util:EncodeCFrame(targetCF),
			[utf8.char(2)] = head,
			[utf8.char(3)] = util:EncodeCFrame(objSpace),
		}
		pcall(function()
			ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Replication.Fighter.UseItem:FireServer(
				objectId,
				enumLib:ToEnum("StartShooting"),
				cameradata,
				nil
			)
		end)
	end

	local function applyDesyncPose(hrp, char, targetCF)
		-- server/world position = targetCF (under enemy)
		-- local restore next frame so YOU don't see the TP
		realCF = hrp.CFrame
		hrp.CFrame = targetCF
		hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		-- joint reconstruction
		local lower = char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")
		local rootJoint = lower and lower:FindFirstChild("Root")
		if rootJoint and rootJoint:IsA("Motor6D") then
			rootJoint.Transform = CFrame.new()
		end
		local upper = char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
		local waist = upper and upper:FindFirstChild("Waist")
		if waist and waist:IsA("Motor6D") then
			waist.Transform = CFrame.new()
		end
		desyncOn = true
	end

	-- restore visual before camera
	RunService:BindToRenderStep("ShakoRageV2Desync", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value - 1, function()
		if not desyncOn then return end
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if hrp and realCF then
			hrp.CFrame = realCF
		end
	end)

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local c = cfg()
		if not isEnabled(c) then
			desyncOn = false
			realCF = nil
			return
		end
		if not inMatch() then
			desyncOn = false
			realCF = nil
			return
		end
		-- mientras Reload Void: no stick / no shoot
		if getgenv().__SHK_ReloadVoiding or getgenv().__SHK_DamageVoiding or getgenv().__SHK_RageHiding then
			desyncOn = false
			return
		end

		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not hrp then return end

		local t = getTarget()
		if not t then
			desyncOn = false
			return
		end

		local depth = tonumber(c.V2Depth) or 4.5
		local forward = tonumber(c.V2Forward) or 2.2
		local look = t.root.CFrame.LookVector
		local flat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
		if flat.Magnitude < 0.05 then
			flat = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
		else
			flat = flat.Unit
		end
		-- abajo de las patas + un poco adelante + acostado (pitch 90)
		local pos = t.root.Position + Vector3.new(0, -depth, 0) + flat * forward
		local headPos = t.head.Position
		local yaw = math.atan2(-(headPos.X - pos.X), -(headPos.Z - pos.Z))
		local targetCF = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)

		pcall(function()
			if hum then
				hum.AutoRotate = false
			end
			for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
				if p:IsA("BasePart") then
					p.CanCollide = false
				end
			end
			applyDesyncPose(hrp, char, targetCF)
		end)

		local rate = tonumber(c.V2FireRate) or 0.03
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - lastFire >= rate then
			lastFire = now
			shootHead(t.head)
		end
	end)

	if K and K.onUnload then
		K.onUnload(function()
			pcall(function()
				RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ShakoRageV2Desync")
			end)
			desyncOn = false
		end)
	end

end


-- ============================================================
-- SHK Underground V2 · Absense Under the map + PITCH 90 (acostado)
-- ============================================================
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

	local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
	rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local groundHome, groundUntil, groundY = nil, 0, nil
	local realCF, desyncOn = nil, false

	local function cfg()
		local ok, data = pcall(function() return tbl17.bG().Data end)
		if not ok or not data or not data.Ragebot then return nil end
		local ev = data.Ragebot.Evasion
		return ev and ev.UndergroundV2
	end

	local function isOn(c)
		if not c or not c.Enabled then return false end
		local kb = c.Keybind
		if type(kb) == "table" then
			if kb.Kind == "Always" then return true end
			return kb.State == true
		end
		return true
	end

	local function groundHit(position, character)
		local ignored = { character }
		for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if plr.Character then
				ignored[#ignored + 1] = plr.Character
			end
		end
		rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
		return Workspace:Raycast(position + Vector3.yAxis * 2, -Vector3.yAxis * 502, rayParams)
	end

	-- pose ABSENSE under map + SIEMPRE pitch 90 (acostado)
	local function underPose(homeCF, character, depth, cacheTime)
		local now = os.clock()
		local homePos = homeCF.Position
		local d = tonumber(depth) or 1.5

		if not (groundHome and (groundHome - homePos).Magnitude < 2 and now < (groundUntil or 0) and groundY) then
			groundHome = homePos
			groundUntil = now + (tonumber(cacheTime) or 0.25)
			local hit = groundHit(homePos, character)
			if hit then
				groundY = hit.Position.Y - d
			else
				groundY = homePos.Y - d - 3
			end
		end

		-- yaw del movimiento real para no girar al azar
		local look = homeCF.LookVector
		local yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
		-- Absense: CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2, 0, 0) = pitch 90° acostado
		return CFrame.new(homePos.X, groundY, homePos.Z)
			* CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
			* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
	end

	RunService:BindToRenderStep("ShakoUGV2_Restore", Enum.RenderPriority.First.Value, function()
		if not desyncOn or not realCF then return end
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if hrp then
			hrp.CFrame = realCF
		end
	end)

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local c = cfg()
		if not isOn(c) then
			desyncOn = false
			realCF = nil
			groundY = nil
			local char = LocalPlayer.Character
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum then pcall(function() hum.AutoRotate = true end) end
			return
		end

		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not hrp then return end

		-- posición real (caminas normal)
		realCF = hrp.CFrame
		desyncOn = true

		if hum then
			pcall(function() hum.AutoRotate = false end)
		end

		local pose = underPose(realCF, char, c.Depth, c.CacheTime)
		-- mundo / otros te ven ACOSTADO pitch 90 bajo el mapa
		hrp.CFrame = pose
	end)

	if K and K.onUnload then
		K.onUnload(function()
			pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ShakoUGV2_Restore") end)
			desyncOn = false
			realCF = nil
		end)
	end

end




-- ============================================================
-- SHK Rage v3 · Absense Cover Strategy EXACTO
-- UE = Adaptive | Solix = Hide below | Inside = Close to target
-- Kicia se apaga cuando Method = Rage v3
-- ============================================================
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

	local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
	rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local lastFire, realCF, desyncOn = 0, nil, false

	local function cfg()
		local ok, data = pcall(function() return tbl17.bG().Data end)
		if not ok or not data then return nil end
		return data.Ragebot
	end

	local function isOn(c)
		if not c or not c.Enabled then return false end
		if tostring(c.Method or "") ~= "Rage v3" then return false end
		local kb = c.Keybind
		if type(kb) == "table" then
			if kb.Kind == "Always" then return true end
			return kb.State == true
		end
		return true
	end

	local function isTeammate(plr)
		if not plr or plr == LocalPlayer then return true end
		local ok1, a = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("TeamID") end)
		local ok2, b = pcall(function() return plr:GetAttribute("TeamID") end)
		if ok1 and ok2 and a ~= nil and b ~= nil then return a == b end
		if LocalPlayer.Team and plr.Team and LocalPlayer.Team == plr.Team then return true end
		return false
	end

	local function sameMatch(plr)
		local ok1, a = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID") end)
		local ok2, b = pcall(function() return plr:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID") end)
		if ok1 and ok2 and a ~= nil and b ~= nil and a ~= b then return false end
		return true
	end

	local function getTarget()
		local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not myRoot then return nil end
		local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
		for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character and sameMatch(plr) and not isTeammate(plr) then
				local hum = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local root = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local head = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
				if hum and hum.Health > 0 and root and head then
					local d = (myRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
					if d < bestD then
						bestD = d
						best = { plr = plr, root = root, head = head, model = plr.Character, part = head }
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return best
	end

	local function groundHit(position, character, targetModel)
		local ignored = { character, targetModel }
		for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if plr.Character then ignored[#ignored + 1] = plr.Character end
		end
		local filter = {}
		for _, inst in pairs(ignored) do
			if inst then filter[#filter + 1] = inst end
		end
		rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = filter
		return Workspace:Raycast(position + Vector3.yAxis * 2, -Vector3.yAxis * 502, rayParams)
	end

	-- Absense Tactics:Position + Adaptive fallback (engine default points)
	local function absensePose(strategy, target, myChar, myRoot)
		strategy = tostring(strategy or "UE")
		local root, head, part = target.root, target.head, target.part or target.head

		-- Solix = Absense "Hide"
		if strategy == "Solix" or strategy == "Hide" then
			local position = root.Position
			local hit = groundHit(position, myChar, target.model)
			local y = math.max(position.Y - 5.5, hit and hit.Position.Y - 1.2 or -math.huge)
			if y == -math.huge then y = position.Y - 7.99 end
			return CFrame.new(position.X, y, position.Z) * CFrame.Angles(math.pi / 2, 0, 0)
		end

		-- Inside = Absense exact
		if strategy == "Inside" then
			return CFrame.lookAt((root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -0.8, 0.4)).Position, head.Position)
		end

		-- Nebula = lados + atrás CERCA (3 studs) para hitreg
		if strategy == "Nebula" then
			local gap = 3.0
			local hp = head.Position
			local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
			local right = root.CFrame.RightVector
			local pts = {
				hp - look * gap,
				hp + right * gap * 0.85,
				hp - right * gap * 0.85,
				hp - look * (gap * 0.65) + right * (gap * 0.55),
				hp - look * (gap * 0.65) - right * (gap * 0.55),
			}
			local idx = (math.floor(os.clock() / 0.22) % #pts) + 1
			return CFrame.lookAt(pts[idx], hp)
		end

		-- UE = Adaptive inteligente: cerca de head, rota entre puntos buenos
		local hp = head.Position
		local gap = 3.2
		local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
		local right = root.CFrame.RightVector
		local points = {
			hp + Vector3.new(0, 2.2, 0), -- above
			hp - look * gap + Vector3.new(0, 0.2, 0), -- behind
			hp + right * gap,
			hp - right * gap,
			hp - look * 2.2 + right * 2.0,
			hp - look * 2.2 - right * 2.0,
			hp + Vector3.new(0, -2.5, 0), -- under (anti-aa)
		}
		-- ciclo lento + preferir el más cercano usable a head
		local idx = (math.floor(os.clock() / 0.25) % #points) + 1
		local bestP = points[idx]
		local bestScore = -math.huge
		for i, p in ipairs(points) do
			local d = (p - hp).Magnitude
			local score = -d
			if d >= 2.0 and d <= 6.0 then score = score + 2 end -- rango hitreg bueno
			if score > bestScore then bestScore, bestP = score, p end
		end
		-- mezcla: 60% punto del ciclo, 40% mejor score (anti-preaim)
		if (math.floor(os.clock() * 2) % 5) ~= 0 then
			bestP = points[idx]
		end
		return CFrame.lookAt(bestP, hp)
	end

	local function getFighter()
		local fc
		pcall(function()
			local ps = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
			local c = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("Controllers")
			local m = c and c:FindFirstChild("FighterController")
			if m then fc = require(m) end
		end)
		return fc and fc.LocalFighter
	end

	local function shootHead(head)
		local fighter = getFighter()
		if not fighter or not fighter.EquippedItem then return end
		local item = fighter.EquippedItem
		local util, enumLib
		pcall(function()
			util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Utility)
			enumLib = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.EnumLibrary)
		end)
		if not util or not enumLib then return end
		local objectId
		pcall(function() objectId = item:Get("ObjectID") or item.ObjectId end)
		if not objectId then return end
		local aimCF = CFrame.lookAt(head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.05, 0), head.Position)
		local cameradata = {}
		cameradata[utf8.char(1)] = {
			[utf8.char(0)] = util:EncodeCFrame(aimCF),
			[utf8.char(1)] = util:EncodeCFrame(head.CFrame),
			[utf8.char(2)] = head,
			[utf8.char(3)] = util:EncodeCFrame(head.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(CFrame.new(head.Position))),
		}
		pcall(function()
			ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Replication.Fighter.UseItem:FireServer(
				objectId,
				enumLib:ToEnum("StartShooting"),
				cameradata,
				nil
			)
		end)
	end

	-- desync: restore real for local (como antes, no tocar lógica de desync)
	RunService:BindToRenderStep("ShakoRageV3Desync", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value - 1, function()
		if not desyncOn or not realCF then return end
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if hrp then hrp.CFrame = realCF end
	end)

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local c = cfg()
		if not isOn(c) then
			desyncOn = false
			realCF = nil
			return
		end
		if getgenv().__SHK_ReloadVoiding or getgenv().__SHK_DamageVoiding or getgenv().__SHK_RageHiding then
			desyncOn = false
			return
		end
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not hrp then return end

		local t = getTarget()
		if not t then
			desyncOn = false
			return
		end

		local strategy = c.CoverStrategy
		if not strategy and c.Engine then strategy = c.Engine.Positioning end
		strategy = strategy or "UE"

		local pose = absensePose(strategy, t, char, hrp)
		if not pose then return end

		if not realCF then realCF = hrp.CFrame end
		-- NO actualizar realCF cada frame desde hrp under pose
		hrp.CFrame = pose
		desyncOn = true

		local rate = tonumber(c.V2FireRate) or 0.03
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - lastFire >= rate then
			lastFire = now
			shootHead(t.head)
		end
	end)

	-- capturar movimiento local en First
	RunService:BindToRenderStep("ShakoRageV3_Move", Enum.RenderPriority.First.Value, function()
		if not desyncOn then return end
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not hrp then return end
		if realCF then
			hrp.CFrame = realCF
		end
	end)

	-- realCF SOLO se actualiza por MoveDirection (no desde pose de ataque)
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		if not desyncOn or not realCF then return end
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not hum then return end
		local md = hum.MoveDirection
		if md.Magnitude > 0.05 then
			local spd = hum.WalkSpeed or 16
			local pos = realCF.Position + md.Unit * spd * (dt or 0.016)
			realCF = CFrame.new(pos) * (realCF - realCF.Position)
		end
	end)

	if K and K.onUnload then
		K.onUnload(function()
			pcall(function()
				RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ShakoRageV3Desync")
				RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ShakoRageV3_Move")
			end)
			desyncOn = false
		end)
	end

end




-- ============================================================
-- SHK Reload Void · al recargar → vacío; al terminar → rage de nuevo
-- Aplica con cualquier Method (Kicia / V2 / V3) si Ragebot.Enabled
-- ============================================================
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

	local realCF, active = nil, false
	local VOID_DIST = 1e8

	local function cfg()
		local ok, data = pcall(function() return tbl17.bG().Data end)
		if not ok or not data then return nil end
		return data.Ragebot
	end

	local function rageOn(c)
		if not c or not c.Enabled then return false end
		local kb = c.Keybind
		if type(kb) == "table" then
			if kb.Kind == "Always" then return true end
			return kb.State == true
		end
		return true
	end

	local function reloadVoidOn(c)
		if c.ReloadVoid == false then return false end
		return true -- default on
	end

	local function getGun()
		local fighter
		pcall(function()
			local ps = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
			local c = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("Controllers")
			local m = c and c:FindFirstChild("FighterController")
			if m then
				local fc = require(m)
				fighter = fc and fc.LocalFighter
			end
		end)
		if not fighter then return nil end
		local item = fighter.EquippedItem
		if not item then return nil end
		-- solo armas con mag
		local okType, t = pcall(function() return item.__type or item.Type end)
		if okType and t and tostring(t) ~= "Gun" then
			-- still try IsReloading
		end
		return item
	end

	local function isReloading(item)
		if not item then return false end
		local ok, r = pcall(function()
			if item.IsReloading then return item:IsReloading() end
		end)
		if ok and r then return true end
		ok, r = pcall(function()
			if item.GetReloadTimeRemaining then return item:GetReloadTimeRemaining() end
		end)
		if ok and type(r) == "number" and r > 0.02 then return true end
		ok, r = pcall(function()
			return item:Get("IsReloading") or item:Get("Reloading")
		end)
		if ok and r then return true end
		-- cooldown inner
		ok, r = pcall(function()
			local inner = rawget(item, "Inner") or item.Inner
			if type(inner) == "table" and inner._reload_cooldown then
				return true
			end
		end)
		if ok and r then return true end
		return false
	end

	local function voidCF(from)
		local base = from or CFrame.new()
		-- lejos en Y/X aleatorio estable por segundo
		local t = math.floor(os.clock() * 2)
		local rng = Random.new(t)
		local x = (rng:NextNumber() - 0.5) * VOID_DIST
		local z = (rng:NextNumber() - 0.5) * VOID_DIST
		local y = 50000 + rng:NextNumber() * 10000
		return CFrame.new(x, y, z)
	end

	-- flag global para que V2/V3 no disparen ni stick mientras recargas
	getgenv().__SHK_ReloadVoiding = false

	RunService:BindToRenderStep("ShakoReloadVoid_Restore", Enum.RenderPriority.First.Value, function()
		if not active or not realCF then return end
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if hrp then
			hrp.CFrame = realCF
		end
	end)

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local c = cfg()
		if not c or not rageOn(c) or not reloadVoidOn(c) then
			active = false
			realCF = nil
			getgenv().__SHK_ReloadVoiding = false
			return
		end

		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not hrp then return end

		local gun = getGun()
		local reloading = isReloading(gun)

		if reloading then
			-- guardar pos real solo al entrar al void
			if not active then
				realCF = hrp.CFrame
			else
				-- mantener realCF desde restore+movimiento
				-- realCF updated in First restore cycle via humanoid
			end
			-- actualizar real desde current si restore ya aplicó
			if realCF then
				-- ok
			else
				realCF = hrp.CFrame
			end
			active = true
			getgenv().__SHK_ReloadVoiding = true
			hrp.CFrame = voidCF(realCF)
			hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		else
			-- terminó de recargar → rage vuelve al enemigo (V2/V3/Kicia siguen)
			if active then
				active = false
				getgenv().__SHK_ReloadVoiding = false
				if realCF then
					hrp.CFrame = realCF
				end
				realCF = nil
			end
		end
	end)

	-- después de restore First, capturar movimiento real
	RunService:BindToRenderStep("ShakoReloadVoid_Capture", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value - 2, function()
		if not active then return end
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if hrp and realCF then
			-- tras restore, humanoid pos = real
			realCF = hrp.CFrame
		end
	end)

	if K and K.onUnload then
		K.onUnload(function()
			pcall(function()
				RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ShakoReloadVoid_Restore")
				RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ShakoReloadVoid_Capture")
			end)
			getgenv().__SHK_ReloadVoiding = false
			active = false
		end)
	end

end


-- ============================================================





-- ============================================================
-- SHK Rage built-in: No Spread + No Recoil (sin toggles en UI)
-- Mientras rage esté activo, Items.* → spread/recoil a 0
-- ============================================================
do
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local lastOn = false

	local function rageActive()
		local ok, data = pcall(function() return tbl17.bG().Data end)
		if not ok or not data or not data.Ragebot then return false end
		local rb = data.Ragebot
		if not rb.Enabled then return false end
		local kb = rb.Keybind
		if type(kb) == "table" and kb.Kind ~= "Always" and kb.State ~= true then return false end
		return true
	end

	local function applyItemLibraryZero()
		pcall(function()
			local mod = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Modules")
			local lib = mod and mod:FindFirstChild("ItemLibrary")
			if not lib then return end
			local ok, pack = pcall(require, lib)
			if not ok or type(pack) ~= "table" then return end
			local items = pack.Items or pack
			if type(items) ~= "table" then return end
			for _, data in pairs(items) do
				if type(data) == "table" then
					if data.ShootSpread ~= nil then data.ShootSpread = 0 end
					if data.ShootRecoil ~= nil then data.ShootRecoil = 0 end
					if data.ShootAccuracy ~= nil then data.ShootAccuracy = 0 end
					if data.Spread ~= nil then data.Spread = 0 end
					if data.Recoil ~= nil then data.Recoil = 0 end
					if data.HipSpread ~= nil then data.HipSpread = 0 end
					if data.AimSpread ~= nil then data.AimSpread = 0 end
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local on = rageActive()
		if on then
			applyItemLibraryZero()
			lastOn = true
		elseif lastOn then
			lastOn = false
			-- al apagar rage no restauramos tablas (el modifier system vuelve a mandar)
		end
	end)

end


-- ============================================================
-- SHK Damage Void · DESYNC CFrame reconstrucción (no ves el TP)
-- Server/otros: vacío | Tú: te quedas en realCF
-- ============================================================
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

	local realCF, voidPose, active = nil, nil, false
	local lastHP = {}
	local dealtAccum = {}
	local retreatUntil = 0
	local foreverTarget, foreverHP = nil, nil
	local healthConns = {}
	local VOID_DIST = 1e8

	local function cfgDV()
		local ok, data = pcall(function() return tbl17.bG().Data end)
		if not ok or not data or not data.Ragebot then return nil end
		return data.Ragebot.DamageVoid
	end

	local function rageOn()
		local ok, data = pcall(function() return tbl17.bG().Data end)
		if not ok or not data or not data.Ragebot then return false end
		local rb = data.Ragebot
		if not rb.Enabled then return false end
		local kb = rb.Keybind
		if type(kb) == "table" then
			if kb.Kind == "Always" then return true end
			return kb.State == true
		end
		return true
	end

	local function dvOn(dv)
		if not dv then return false end
		if dv == true then return true end
		if type(dv) ~= "table" then return false end
		if dv.Enabled == false then return false end
		local kb = dv.Keybind
		if type(kb) == "table" then
			if kb.Kind == "Always" then return true end
			if kb.Kind == "Toggle" or kb.Kind == "Hold" then
				return kb.State == true
			end
		end
		return true
	end

	local function isTeammate(plr)
		if not plr or plr == LocalPlayer then return true end
		local ok1, a = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("TeamID") end)
		local ok2, b = pcall(function() return plr:GetAttribute("TeamID") end)
		if ok1 and ok2 and a ~= nil and b ~= nil then return a == b end
		if LocalPlayer.Team and plr.Team and LocalPlayer.Team == plr.Team then return true end
		return false
	end

	local function sameMatch(plr)
		local ok1, a = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID") end)
		local ok2, b = pcall(function() return plr:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID") end)
		if ok1 and ok2 and a ~= nil and b ~= nil and a ~= b then return false end
		return true
	end

	local function makeVoidPose()
		local t = math.floor(os.clock() * 5)
		local rng = Random.new(t + 77)
		return CFrame.new(
			(rng:NextNumber() - 0.5) * VOID_DIST,
			95000 + rng:NextNumber() * 25000,
			(rng:NextNumber() - 0.5) * VOID_DIST
		)
	end

	local function triggerVoid(plr, hp, forever, hold)
		if getgenv().__SHK_HealthPushing then return end
		local now = os.clock()
		if forever then
			foreverTarget = plr
			foreverHP = hp
			retreatUntil = math.huge
		else
			foreverTarget = nil
			foreverHP = nil
			retreatUntil = now + (hold or 0.9)
		end
		dealtAccum[plr] = 0
		getgenv().__SHK_DamageVoiding = true
	end

	local function onEnemyHealth(plr, newHP)
		local dv = cfgDV()
		if not rageOn() or not dvOn(dv) then return end
		if type(newHP) ~= "number" then return end

		local needed = tonumber(dv.Needed) or 6
		local hold = tonumber(dv.Time) or 0.9
		local forever = dv.ForeverTime == true

		local prev = lastHP[plr]
		lastHP[plr] = newHP
		if prev == nil then return end

		if newHP < prev then
			dealtAccum[plr] = (dealtAccum[plr] or 0) + (prev - newHP)
			if dealtAccum[plr] >= needed then
				triggerVoid(plr, newHP, forever, hold)
			end
		elseif newHP > prev + 0.5 then
			dealtAccum[plr] = 0
			if foreverTarget == plr then
				retreatUntil = 0
				foreverTarget = nil
				foreverHP = nil
			end
		end
	end

	local function hookPlayer(plr)
		if plr == LocalPlayer then return end
		if healthConns[plr] then
			pcall(function() healthConns[plr]:Disconnect() end)
			healthConns[plr] = nil
		end
		local function bindChar(char)
			if not char then return end
			local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 3)
			if not hum then return end
			lastHP[plr] = hum.Health
			dealtAccum[plr] = dealtAccum[plr] or 0
			if healthConns[plr] then pcall(function() healthConns[plr]:Disconnect() end) end
			healthConns[plr] = hum:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Health"):Connect(function()
				onEnemyHealth(plr, hum.Health)
			end)
		end
		if plr.Character then bindChar(plr.Character) end
		plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
			task.defer(bindChar, char)
		end)
	end

	for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		task.defer(hookPlayer, plr)
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr) task.defer(hookPlayer, plr) end)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
		if healthConns[plr] then pcall(function() healthConns[plr]:Disconnect() end) end
		healthConns[plr] = nil
		lastHP[plr] = nil
		dealtAccum[plr] = nil
		if foreverTarget == plr then
			foreverTarget = nil
			foreverHP = nil
			retreatUntil = 0
		end
	end)

	getgenv().__SHK_DamageVoiding = false

	-- DESYNC: cliente ve realCF (First)
	RunService:BindToRenderStep("ShakoDV_Restore", Enum.RenderPriority.First.Value, function()
		if not active or not realCF then return end
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if hrp then
			hrp.CFrame = realCF
			pcall(function()
				hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			end)
		end
	end)

	-- Después de input/cámara: actualizar realCF (solo posición local)
	RunService:BindToRenderStep("ShakoDV_Capture", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value - 1, function()
		if not active then return end
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if hrp then
			realCF = hrp.CFrame
		end
	end)

	-- Al final del frame: pose de vacío para red/servidor (no la ves)
	RunService:BindToRenderStep("ShakoDV_NetVoid", Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value, function()
		if not active then return end
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not hrp then return end
		voidPose = voidPose or makeVoidPose()
		-- micro-jitter para no congelar el mismo CF en anti-cheat simple
		if os.clock() % 0.2 < 0.03 then
			voidPose = makeVoidPose()
		end
		hrp.CFrame = voidPose
	end)

	LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		table.clear(lastHP)
		table.clear(dealtAccum)
		retreatUntil = 0
		foreverTarget = nil
		foreverHP = nil
		active = false
		realCF = nil
		voidPose = nil
		getgenv().__SHK_DamageVoiding = false
	end)

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local dv = cfgDV()
		local on = rageOn() and dvOn(dv)

		if not on then
			if active then
				active = false
				getgenv().__SHK_DamageVoiding = false
				local hrp = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if hrp and realCF then hrp.CFrame = realCF end
				realCF = nil
				voidPose = nil
			end
			retreatUntil = 0
			foreverTarget = nil
			foreverHP = nil
			getgenv().__SHK_DamageVoiding = false
			return
		end

		for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character and sameMatch(plr) and not isTeammate(plr) then
				local hum = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
					onEnemyHealth(plr, hum.Health)
				elseif hum and hum.Health <= 0 then
					dealtAccum[plr] = 0
					if foreverTarget == plr then
						foreverTarget = nil
						foreverHP = nil
						retreatUntil = 0
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if foreverTarget then
			local char = foreverTarget.Character
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
				retreatUntil = 0
				foreverTarget = nil
				foreverHP = nil
			elseif foreverHP and hum.Health > foreverHP + 0.5 then
				retreatUntil = 0
				foreverTarget = nil
				foreverHP = nil
			else
				retreatUntil = math.huge
			end
		end

		if getgenv().__SHK_HealthPushing then
			retreatUntil = 0
			foreverTarget = nil
			foreverHP = nil
			getgenv().__SHK_DamageVoiding = false
		end

		local now = os.clock()
		local shouldVoid = (now < retreatUntil) and not getgenv().__SHK_HealthPushing
		local hrp = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

		if shouldVoid and hrp then
			if not active then
				-- snapshot posición REAL al entrar (no ves el tp)
				realCF = hrp.CFrame
				voidPose = makeVoidPose()
			end
			active = true
			getgenv().__SHK_DamageVoiding = true
			if hum then
				pcall(function() hum.AutoRotate = false end)
			end
			-- Heartbeat: pose red (desync)
			voidPose = voidPose or makeVoidPose()
			hrp.CFrame = voidPose
			pcall(function()
				hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			end)
		else
			if active then
				active = false
				getgenv().__SHK_DamageVoiding = false
				if hrp and realCF then
					hrp.CFrame = realCF
				end
				realCF = nil
				voidPose = nil
				if hum then
					pcall(function() hum.AutoRotate = true end)
				end
			else
				getgenv().__SHK_DamageVoiding = false
			end
		end
	end)

	if K and K.onUnload then
		K.onUnload(function()
			pcall(function()
				RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ShakoDV_Restore")
				RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ShakoDV_Capture")
				RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ShakoDV_NetVoid")
			end)
			for _, c in pairs(healthConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
			table.clear(healthConns)
			getgenv().__SHK_DamageVoiding = false
			active = false
		end)
	end

end






-- ============================================================
-- SHK Health Push
-- Si TU HP < HP enemigo → rage va a por él hasta que TÚ tengas más HP
-- Cancela Damage Void mientras estés en desventaja
-- ============================================================
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

	local function cfgHP()
		local ok, data = pcall(function() return tbl17.bG().Data end)
		if not ok or not data or not data.Ragebot then return nil end
		return data.Ragebot.HealthPush
	end

	local function rageOn()
		local ok, data = pcall(function() return tbl17.bG().Data end)
		if not ok or not data or not data.Ragebot then return false end
		local rb = data.Ragebot
		if not rb.Enabled then return false end
		local kb = rb.Keybind
		if type(kb) == "table" then
			if kb.Kind == "Always" then return true end
			return kb.State == true
		end
		return true
	end

	local function featureOn(ft)
		if not ft then return false end
		if ft == true then return true end
		if type(ft) ~= "table" then return false end
		if ft.Enabled == false then return false end
		local kb = ft.Keybind
		if type(kb) == "table" then
			if kb.Kind == "Always" then return true end
			return kb.State == true
		end
		return true
	end

	local function isTeammate(plr)
		if not plr or plr == LocalPlayer then return true end
		local ok1, a = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("TeamID") end)
		local ok2, b = pcall(function() return plr:GetAttribute("TeamID") end)
		if ok1 and ok2 and a ~= nil and b ~= nil then return a == b end
		if LocalPlayer.Team and plr.Team and LocalPlayer.Team == plr.Team then return true end
		return false
	end

	local function sameMatch(plr)
		local ok1, a = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID") end)
		local ok2, b = pcall(function() return plr:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID") end)
		if ok1 and ok2 and a ~= nil and b ~= nil and a ~= b then return false end
		return true
	end

	local function getTargetEnemy()
		local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not myRoot then return nil end
		local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
		for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character and sameMatch(plr) and not isTeammate(plr) then
				local hum = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local root = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if hum and hum.Health > 0 and root then
					local d = (myRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
					if d < bestD then
						bestD = d
						best = { plr = plr, hum = hum }
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return best
	end

	getgenv().__SHK_HealthPushing = false

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local hpCfg = cfgHP()
		if not rageOn() or not featureOn(hpCfg) then
			getgenv().__SHK_HealthPushing = false
			return
		end

		local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
		local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not myHum or myHum.Health <= 0 then
			getgenv().__SHK_HealthPushing = false
			return
		end

		local t = getTargetEnemy()
		if not t or not t.hum then
			getgenv().__SHK_HealthPushing = false
			return
		end

		local myHP = myHum.Health
		local enHP = t.hum.Health

		-- Menos vida que el enemigo → push rage hasta recuperar lead
		if myHP < enHP then
			getgenv().__SHK_HealthPushing = true
			-- cancelar damage void mientras empujas
			getgenv().__SHK_DamageVoiding = false
		else
			-- ya tienes igual o más vida → modo normal
			getgenv().__SHK_HealthPushing = false
		end
	end)

	if K and K.onUnload then
		K.onUnload(function()
			getgenv().__SHK_HealthPushing = false
		end)
	end

end


-- ============================================================
-- SHK Rage DESYNC · CFrame reconstruction (estilo Kicia/void)
-- Red ve el stick del rage; tú te mueves normal (realCF)
-- ============================================================
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

	local realCF = nil
	local active = false
	local BIND = "ShakoRageDesync_Local"
	local BIND2 = "ShakoRageDesync_First"

	local function cfg()
		local ok, d = pcall(function() return tbl17.bG().Data end)
		if not ok or not d then return nil end
		return d.Ragebot
	end

	local function rageOn()
		local c = cfg()
		if not c or not c.Enabled then return false end
		local kb = c.Keybind
		if type(kb) == "table" then
			if kb.Kind == "Always" then return true end
			return kb.State == true
		end
		return true
	end

	local function clear()
		active = false
		realCF = nil
		pcall(function()
			RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(BIND)
			RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(BIND2)
		end)
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then pcall(function() hum.AutoRotate = true end) end
	end

	local function ensureBinds()
		pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(BIND) end)
		pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(BIND2) end)

		-- First: restaurar antes de física/cámara
		RunService:BindToRenderStep(BIND2, Enum.RenderPriority.First.Value, function()
			if not active or not realCF then return end
			local hrp = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if hrp then
				hrp.CFrame = realCF
				hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			end
		end)

		-- Camera: restaurar de nuevo para que no veas el stick
		RunService:BindToRenderStep(BIND, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value - 1, function()
			if not active or not realCF then return end
			local hrp = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if hrp then
				hrp.CFrame = realCF
			end
		end)
	end

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		if not rageOn() then
			if active then clear() end
			return
		end
		-- damage/reload void ya tienen su desync
		if getgenv().__SHK_ReloadVoiding or getgenv().__SHK_DamageVoiding then
			return
		end

		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not hrp then return end

		if not active then
			realCF = hrp.CFrame
			active = true
			ensureBinds()
		end

		if hum then
			pcall(function() hum.AutoRotate = false end)
			local md = hum.MoveDirection
			if md.Magnitude > 0.05 then
				local spd = hum.WalkSpeed or 16
				local pos = realCF.Position + md.Unit * spd * (dt or 0.016)
				-- mantener orientación de cámara aproximada
				local look = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector or realCF.LookVector
				local flat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
				if flat.Magnitude > 0.05 then
					realCF = CFrame.new(pos, pos + flat)
				else
					realCF = CFrame.new(pos) * (realCF - realCF.Position)
				end
			end
		end

		-- No escribimos pose de ataque aquí: Kicia/V2/V3 ya la escriben en su Plan/Heartbeat.
		-- Solo reconstruimos local en RenderStep (arriba).
	end)

	-- Post-physics: si el controller escribió pose de rage, el bind First/Camera lo tapa el frame siguiente.
	-- Un tick extra al final del Heartbeat ayuda a que la red vea la pose antes de restaurar.
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not active then return end
		-- dejar que otros handlers del rage escriban primero; no tocar
	end)

	LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		clear()
	end)

	if K and K.onUnload then
		K.onUnload(clear)
	end

end


-- ============================================================
-- SHK Rage Spectate · estilo Solix
-- Cámara sigue al target del rage (independiente del desync body)
-- ============================================================
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
	local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

	local savedType = nil
	local savedFOV = nil
	local savedSubject = nil
	local camCF = nil
	local active = false
	local lastTarget = nil

	local function cfg()
		local ok, d = pcall(function()
			return tbl17.bG().Data
		end)
		if not ok or not d then
			return nil
		end
		return d.Ragebot
	end

	local function spectateCfg(c)
		local s = c and c.Spectate
		if type(s) ~= "table" then
			return { Enabled = false, Distance = 10, Height = 4, Smooth = 0.18, FOV = 90 }
		end
		return s
	end

	local function rageOn(c)
		if not c or not c.Enabled then
			return false
		end
		local kb = c.Keybind
		if type(kb) == "table" then
			if kb.Kind == "Always" then
				return true
			end
			return kb.State == true
		end
		return true
	end

	local function isTeammate(plr)
		if not plr or plr == LocalPlayer then
			return true
		end
		local ok1, a = pcall(function()
			return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("TeamID")
		end)
		local ok2, b = pcall(function()
			return plr:GetAttribute("TeamID")
		end)
		if ok1 and ok2 and a ~= nil and b ~= nil then
			return a == b
		end
		if LocalPlayer.Team and plr.Team and LocalPlayer.Team == plr.Team then
			return true
		end
		return false
	end

	local function sameMatch(plr)
		local ok1, a = pcall(function()
			return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID")
		end)
		local ok2, b = pcall(function()
			return plr:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID")
		end)
		if ok1 and ok2 and a ~= nil and b ~= nil and a ~= b then
			return false
		end
		return true
	end

	local function getTarget()
		-- SIN límite de distancia: sticky + cualquier enemigo en partida
		local function valid(plr)
			if not plr or plr == LocalPlayer or not plr.Parent then return nil end
			if isTeammate(plr) or not sameMatch(plr) then return nil end
			local ch = plr.Character
			local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local root = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local head = ch and (ch:FindFirstChild("Head") or root)
			if hum and hum.Health > 0 and head then
				return plr, head, root or head
			end
			return nil
		end

		-- 1) sticky / shared (sin chequear distancia)
		local shared = getgenv().__SHK_RageTarget or lastTarget
		if shared then
			local p, h, r = valid(shared)
			if p then return p, h, r end
		end

		-- 2) todos los enemigos válidos, el más cercano al origen de cámara o al world
		local origin = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
		local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if myRoot then origin = myRoot.Position end
		if not origin then origin = Vector3.zero end

		local best, bestHead, bestRoot, bestD = nil, nil, nil, math.huge
		for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local p, h, r = valid(plr)
			if p then
				local d = (origin - (r or h).Position).Magnitude
				if d < bestD then
					bestD = d
					best, bestHead, bestRoot = p, h, r
				end
			end
		end
		-- sin cutoff: bestD puede ser 1e9 y sigue valiendo
		return best, bestHead, bestRoot
	end

	local function restoreCam()
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not cam then
			return
		end
		if savedType ~= nil then
			pcall(function()
				cam.CameraType = savedType
			end)
		else
			pcall(function()
				cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
			end)
		end
		if savedFOV ~= nil then
			pcall(function()
				cam.FieldOfView = savedFOV
			end)
		end
		if savedSubject ~= nil then
			pcall(function()
				cam.CameraSubject = savedSubject
			end)
		else
			local char = LocalPlayer.Character
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum then
				pcall(function()
					cam.CameraSubject = hum
				end)
			end
		end
		savedType, savedFOV, savedSubject = nil, nil, nil
		camCF = nil
		active = false
		lastTarget = nil
	end

	local function beginCam(s)
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not cam then
			return
		end
		if not active then
			savedType = cam.CameraType
			savedFOV = cam.FieldOfView
			savedSubject = cam.CameraSubject
			camCF = cam.CFrame
			active = true
		end
		pcall(function()
			cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
		end)
		local fov = tonumber(s.FOV) or 90
		pcall(function()
			cam.FieldOfView = fov
		end)
	end

	RunService:BindToRenderStep("ShakoRageSpectate", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 2, function(dt)
		local c = cfg()
		local s = spectateCfg(c)
		if not s.Enabled or not rageOn(c) then
			if active then
				restoreCam()
			end
			return
		end

		local plr, head, root = getTarget()
		if not plr or not head then
			if active then
				restoreCam()
			end
			return
		end

		beginCam(s)
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not cam then
			return
		end

		lastTarget = plr
		getgenv().__SHK_RageTarget = plr

		local dist = tonumber(s.Distance) or 10
		local height = tonumber(s.Height) or 4
		local smooth = tonumber(s.Smooth) or 0.18
		smooth = math.clamp(smooth, 0.02, 1)

		-- Cámara detrás del enemigo según su look, mirando a la head
		local basis = root and root.CFrame or head.CFrame
		local back = -basis.LookVector
		local focus = head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0)
		local goalPos = focus + back * dist + Vector3.new(0, height, 0)
		-- Si el enemigo mira raro, fallback atrás del vector cámara→target
		if back.Magnitude < 0.1 then
			goalPos = focus + Vector3.new(0, height, dist)
		end
		local goalCF = CFrame.lookAt(goalPos, focus)

		if not camCF then
			camCF = goalCF
		else
			-- lerp suave estilo Solix
			local alpha = 1 - math.exp(-dt / math.max(smooth, 0.02))
			camCF = camCF:Lerp(goalCF, alpha)
		end

		cam.CFrame = camCF
	end)

	LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		if active then
			restoreCam()
		end
	end)

	if K and K.onUnload then
		K.onUnload(function()
			pcall(function()
				RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ShakoRageSpectate")
			end)
			restoreCam()
		end)
	end

end


-- ============================================================
-- SHK ESP Preview · maniquí en pantalla con box/name/health/skeleton
-- ============================================================
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
	local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

	local gui, box, fill, nameL, distL, hpBack, hpFill, skLines
	local active = false

	local function getEsp()
		local ok, d = pcall(function()
			return tbl17.bG().Data
		end)
		if not ok or not d then
			return nil
		end
		return d.Esp
	end

	local function col3(c, fallback)
		if typeof(c) == "Color3" then
			return c
		end
		return fallback or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	end

	local function destroy()
		active = false
		if gui then
			pcall(function()
				gui:Destroy()
			end)
		end
		gui, box, fill, nameL, distL, hpBack, hpFill, skLines = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
	end

	local function ensure()
		if gui and gui.Parent then
			return
		end
		local pg = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") or CoreGui
		gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		gui.Name = "ShakoESPPreview"
		gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
		gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
		gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
		gui.Parent = pg

		local root = Instance.new("Frame")
		root.Name = "PreviewRoot"
		root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(160, 280)
		root.Position = UDim2.new(1, -180, 0.5, -140)
		root.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 14)
		root.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
		root.BorderSizePixel = 0
		root.Parent = gui
		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
		corner.Parent = root
		local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 70)
		stroke.Thickness = 1
		stroke.Parent = root

		local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 20)
		title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4)
		title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		title.Text = "ESP PREVIEW"
		title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 230)
		title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		title.TextSize = 12
		title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		title.Parent = root

		-- body area
		local body = Instance.new("Frame")
		body.Name = "Body"
		body.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(90, 180)
		body.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -45, 0, 36)
		body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		body.Parent = root

		box = Instance.new("Frame")
		box.Name = "Box"
		box.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		box.BorderSizePixel = 0
		box.Parent = body
		local bs = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		bs.Name = "BoxStroke"
		bs.Thickness = 1.5
		bs.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
		bs.Parent = box

		fill = Instance.new("Frame")
		fill.Name = "Fill"
		fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
		fill.BackgroundTransparency = 0.85
		fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
		fill.Parent = box

		-- health bar left
		hpBack = Instance.new("Frame")
		hpBack.Size = UDim2.new(0, 4, 1, 0)
		hpBack.Position = UDim2.new(0, -8, 0, 0)
		hpBack.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
		hpBack.BorderSizePixel = 0
		hpBack.Parent = body
		hpFill = Instance.new("Frame")
		hpFill.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.72, 0)
		hpFill.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.28, 0)
		hpFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 220, 80)
		hpFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
		hpFill.Parent = hpBack

		nameL = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		nameL.Size = UDim2.new(1, 20, 0, 16)
		nameL.Position = UDim2.new(0, -10, 0, -18)
		nameL.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		nameL.Text = "Enemy"
		nameL.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		nameL.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
		nameL.TextSize = 13
		nameL.Parent = body

		distL = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		distL.Size = UDim2.new(1, 20, 0, 14)
		distL.Position = UDim2.new(0, -10, 1, 2)
		distL.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		distL.Text = "42m"
		distL.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
		distL.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		distL.TextSize = 11
		distL.Parent = body

		-- simple skeleton lines
		skLines = Instance.new("Frame")
		skLines.Name = "Skeleton"
		skLines.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		skLines.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		skLines.Parent = body
		local function mkLine(x0, y0, x1, y1)
			local f = Instance.new("Frame")
			f.BorderSizePixel = 0
			f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			local dx, dy = x1 - x0, y1 - y0
			local len = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
			local ang = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx))
			f.Size = UDim2.new(0, len, 0, 1)
			f.Position = UDim2.new(x0 / 90 + (dx / 90) / 2, 0, y0 / 180 + (dy / 180) / 2, 0)
			f.Rotation = ang
			f.Parent = skLines
			return f
		end
		-- proportions inside 90x180
		mkLine(45, 18, 45, 70) -- spine
		mkLine(45, 30, 20, 55) -- L arm
		mkLine(45, 30, 70, 55) -- R arm
		mkLine(45, 70, 28, 120) -- L leg
		mkLine(45, 70, 62, 120) -- R leg
		mkLine(45, 12, 45, 18) -- neck
		local headF = Instance.new("Frame")
		headF.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16)
		headF.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(37, 2)
		headF.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		headF.Parent = skLines
		local hs = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		hs.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		hs.Thickness = 1
		hs.Parent = headF
		local hc = Instance.new("UICorner")
		hc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
		hc.Parent = headF
	end

	local function applyFromConfig()
		if not gui then
			return
		end
		local esp = getEsp()
		local main = esp and esp.Main
		local boxC = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
		local nameC = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		local skC = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		if main then
			if main.Box and main.Box.Color then
				boxC = col3(main.Box.Color, boxC)
			end
			if main.Name and main.Name.Color then
				nameC = col3(main.Name.Color, nameC)
			end
			if main.Skeleton and main.Skeleton.Color then
				-- ColorSequence or Color3
				local sc = main.Skeleton.Color
				if typeof(sc) == "Color3" then
					skC = sc
				elseif typeof(sc) == "ColorSequence" then
					pcall(function()
						skC = sc.Keypoints[1].Value
					end)
				end
			end
		end
		if box then
			local st = box:FindFirstChild("BoxStroke")
			if st then
				st.Color = boxC
			end
		end
		if fill then
			fill.BackgroundColor3 = boxC
			local showFill = main and main.FilledBox and main.FilledBox.Enabled
			fill.Visible = showFill and true or false
			if main and main.FilledBox and main.FilledBox.Transparency then
				fill.BackgroundTransparency = tonumber(main.FilledBox.Transparency) or 0.85
			end
		end
		if nameL then
			nameL.TextColor3 = nameC
			nameL.Visible = not (main and main.Name and main.Name.Enabled == false)
		end
		if distL then
			distL.Visible = not (main and main.Distance and main.Distance.Enabled == false)
		end
		if hpBack then
			hpBack.Visible = not (main and main.HealthBar and main.HealthBar.Enabled == false)
		end
		if skLines then
			skLines.Visible = not (main and main.Skeleton and main.Skeleton.Enabled == false)
			for _, f in ipairs(skLines:GetDescendants()) do
				if f:IsA("Frame") then
					f.BackgroundColor3 = skC
				elseif f:IsA("UIStroke") then
					f.Color = skC
				end
			end
		end
		if box then
			box.Visible = not (main and main.Box and main.Box.Enabled == false)
		end
	end

	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local esp = getEsp()
		local want = esp and esp.Preview and esp.Preview.Enabled == true
		-- also allow if nested wrong
		if not want and esp and type(esp.Preview) == "boolean" then
			want = esp.Preview
		end
		if not want then
			if active then
				destroy()
			end
			return
		end
		if not active then
			ensure()
			active = true
		end
		applyFromConfig()
	end)

	if K and K.onUnload then
		K.onUnload(destroy)
	end

end


-- ============================================================
-- SHK UE Counter · vuelo vertical SIN límite + Auto Hit
-- ============================================================
do
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

	local active = false
	local lastFire = 0
	local util, enumLib

	pcall(function()
		util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Utility)
		enumLib = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.EnumLibrary)
	end)

	local function cfg()
		local ok, data = pcall(function()
			return tbl17.bG().Data
		end)
		if not ok or not data or not data.Ragebot or not data.Ragebot.Evasion then
			return nil
		end
		return data.Ragebot.Evasion.UECounter
	end

	local function isOn(c)
		if not c or not c.Enabled then
			return false
		end
		local kb = c.Keybind
		if type(kb) == "table" then
			if kb.Kind == "Always" then
				return true
			end
			return kb.State == true
		end
		return true
	end

	local function isTeammate(plr)
		if not plr or plr == LocalPlayer then
			return true
		end
		local ok1, a = pcall(function()
			return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("TeamID")
		end)
		local ok2, b = pcall(function()
			return plr:GetAttribute("TeamID")
		end)
		if ok1 and ok2 and a ~= nil and b ~= nil then
			return a == b
		end
		if LocalPlayer.Team and plr.Team and LocalPlayer.Team == plr.Team then
			return true
		end
		return false
	end

	local function sameMatch(plr)
		local ok1, a = pcall(function()
			return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID")
		end)
		local ok2, b = pcall(function()
			return plr:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID")
		end)
		if ok1 and ok2 and a ~= nil and b ~= nil and a ~= b then
			return false
		end
		return true
	end

	local function getEnemyHead()
		local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
		local origin = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position or Vector3.zero
		local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if myRoot then
			origin = myRoot.Position
		end
		for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if plr ~= LocalPlayer and sameMatch(plr) and not isTeammate(plr) then
				local ch = plr.Character
				local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local head = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("Head")
				if hum and hum.Health > 0 and head then
					local d = (origin - head.Position).Magnitude
					if d < bestD then
						bestD = d
						best = head
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return best
	end

	local function getFighter()
		local fc
		pcall(function()
			local ps = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
			local c = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("Controllers")
			local m = c and c:FindFirstChild("FighterController")
			if m then
				fc = require(m)
			end
		end)
		return fc and fc.LocalFighter
	end

	local function shootHead(head)
		if not head or not util or not enumLib then
			return
		end
		local fighter = getFighter()
		if not fighter or not fighter.EquippedItem then
			return
		end
		local item = fighter.EquippedItem
		local objectId
		pcall(function()
			objectId = item:Get("ObjectID") or item.ObjectId
		end)
		if not objectId then
			return
		end
		local origin = head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.05, 0)
		local aimCF = CFrame.lookAt(origin, head.Position)
		local cameradata = {}
		cameradata[utf8.char(1)] = {
			[utf8.char(0)] = util:EncodeCFrame(aimCF),
			[utf8.char(1)] = util:EncodeCFrame(head.CFrame),
			[utf8.char(2)] = head,
			[utf8.char(3)] = util:EncodeCFrame(head.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(CFrame.new(head.Position))),
		}
		pcall(function()
			ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Replication.Fighter.UseItem:FireServer(
				objectId,
				enumLib:ToEnum("StartShooting"),
				cameradata,
				nil
			)
		end)
	end

	local function stop()
		active = false
		getgenv().__SHK_UECounterFlying = false
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then
			pcall(function()
				hum.PlatformStand = false
				hum.AutoRotate = true
			end)
		end
	end

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		local c = cfg()
		if not isOn(c) then
			if active then
				stop()
			end
			return
		end

		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not hrp then
			return
		end

		active = true
		getgenv().__SHK_UECounterFlying = true

		local speed = math.max(tonumber(c.Speed) or 120, 1)
		if c.Boost then
			speed = speed * 1.5
		end

		if hum then
			pcall(function()
				hum.PlatformStand = true
				hum.AutoRotate = false
			end)
		end
		for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
			if p:IsA("BasePart") then
				p.CanCollide = false
			end
		end

		local pos = hrp.Position
		local step = speed * math.clamp(dt or 0.016, 0.001, 0.05)
		local newY = pos.Y + step

		hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos.X, newY, pos.Z)
		hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, speed, 0)
		hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

		-- Auto Hit mientras sube
		if c.AutoHit ~= false then
			local rate = tonumber(c.FireRate) or 0.05
			local now = os.clock()
			if now - lastFire >= rate then
				local head = getEnemyHead()
				if head then
					lastFire = now
					shootHead(head)
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(stop)

	if K and K.onUnload then
		K.onUnload(stop)
	end

end
